izzyondroid:com.beemdevelopment.aegis.name: Aegis Authenticator
izzyondroid:com.beemdevelopment.aegis.summary: Free, secure and open source 2FA app to manage tokens for your online services
izzyondroid:com.beemdevelopment.aegis.description:
Aegis Authenticator is a free, secure and open source app to manage your 2-step verification tokens for your online services.
 Compatibility Aegis supports the HOTP and TOTP algorithms. These two algorithms are industry-standard and widely supported, making Aegis compatible with thousands of services. Any web service that supports Google Authenticator will also work with Aegis Authenticator.
 Encryption and biometric unlock All of your one-time passwords are stored in a vault. If you choose to set a password (highly recommended), the vault will be encrypted using strong cryptography. If someone with malicious intent gets a hold of the vault file, it’s impossible for them to retrieve the contents without knowing the password. Entering your password each time you need access to a one-time password can be cumbersome. Fortunately, you can also enable biometric unlock if your device has a biometrics sensor (i.e. fingerprint or face unlock).
 Organization Over time, you'll likely accumulate tens of entries in your vault. Aegis Authenticator has lots of organization options to make finding the one you need at a particular moment easier. Set a custom icon for an entry to make it easier to find. Search by account name or service name. Have a lot of one-time passwords? Add them to custom groups for easier access. Personal, Work and Social can each get their own group.
 Backups To make sure you will never lose access to your online accounts, Aegis Authenticator can create automatic backups of the vault to a location of your choosing. If your cloud provider supports the Storage Access Framework of Android (like Nextcloud does), it can even create automatic backups to the cloud. Creating manual exports of the vault is also supported.
 Making the switch To make the switch easier, Aegis Authenticator can import the entries of lots of other authenticators, including: 2FAS Authenticator, Authenticator Plus, Authy, andOTP, FreeOTP, FreeOTP+, Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Steam, TOTP Authenticator and WinAuth (root access is required for the apps that don't have an option to export).
 Feature overview 
 Free and open source
 Secure Encrypted, can be unlocked with a password or biometrics
 Screen capture prevention
 Tap to reveal
 Compatible with Google Authenticator
 Supports industry standard algorithms: HOTP and TOTP
 Lots of ways to add new entries Scan a QR code or an image of one
 Enter details manually
 Import from other popular authenticator apps
 Organization Alphabetic/custom sorting
 Custom or automatically generated icons
 Group entries together
 Advanced entry editing
 Search by name/issuer
 Material design with multiple themes: Light, Dark, AMOLED
 Export (plaintext or encrypted)
 Automatic backups of the vault to a location of your choosing
 Open source and license Aegis Authenticator is open source (licensed under GPL v3) and the source code can be found here: http://github.com/beemdevelopment/Aegis

izzyondroid:dev.medzik.librepass.android.name: LibrePass
izzyondroid:dev.medzik.librepass.android.description:
LibrePass represents an innovative cloud-based password manager known for its user-friendly simplicity and performance. It functions not only as a tool for generating secure passwords but also facilitates their synchronization across various devices.
 Password leaks from online websites pose a significant threat, especially considering that most people use a limited number of passwords. Using the same passwords for multiple services carries the risk of unauthorized access, jeopardizing bank accounts, social media profiles, and other online services. Therefore, it is recommended to use long and complex passwords for each of our accounts. Nevertheless, maintaining control over multiple passwords can be challenging. LibrePass addresses this issue by providing a straightforward and enjoyable way to generate, store, and access passwords.
 All passwords stored in LibrePass are securely placed in an encrypted vault. This ensures that users can have full confidence that their passwords will remain private and inaccessible to unauthorized individuals.
 LibrePass is an open-source project, meaning the complete source code is available to everyone. This openness allows anyone to review, verify, and make their own changes, emphasizing the transparency and trust associated with using this tool.
 Features: 
 Advanced password encryption
 Generating secure passwords
 Face and fingerprint unlocking
 Native system theme (Android 12+)
 Native performance
 Various settings options
 And more with incoming updates!

izzyondroid:org.wisso.newpipematerial.name: WizeStream
izzyondroid:org.wisso.newpipematerial.description:
WizeStream is an independent, privacy-friendly NewPipe-based Android client with a modern interface, local-first features, and multiple services. It requires no platform account or Google Play Services.
 Services include YouTube, YouTube Music, Bilibili, Niconico, PeerTube, Bandcamp, SoundCloud, and media.ccc.de.
 Core features include:
 Watch videos and live streams from supported services
 Audio-only Listen mode with 15 visualizers
 Background and popup playback
 Android Auto browsing, voice search, controls, and resumption
 Local playlists
 Subscriptions without a platform account, kept separate for each service
 Service-specific channel groups and What's New feeds with independent refresh states
 Search and browse supported services
 Video details, related videos, and comments where available
 Download video, audio, and captions where available
 Bulk-download complete playlists and play queues
 Import and export app data for backup and migration
 Additional WizeStream features:
 Material 3-inspired surfaces, dialogs, settings, tabs, and navigation
 Dynamic Material You colors and manual theme color presets
 Bottom navigation with a configurable default main tab
 Secure peer-to-peer synchronization for subscriptions, groups, playlists, history, progress, selected settings, playback profiles, and download metadata
 Manual and automatic synchronization between trusted devices on the same network
 "Download on this device" for synchronized download records whose media file is missing locally; media files are not transferred
 Search filters, channel sorting, and search within channel tabs and local or remote playlists
 Local blocking for videos, channels, and title or uploader keywords
 Podcast tabs, per-channel playback profiles, and labeled multi-audio tracks
 SponsorBlock, optional DeArrow titles and thumbnails, and YouTube dislike counts
 FCast and Chromecast-compatible TV casting on Android 8 and newer
 Player gestures, configurable pinch-to-zoom and panning, swipe-down miniplayer, optional visible-video mode, native picture-in-picture, and live-speed retention
 Embedded metadata in generated M4A, MP4, and Opus downloads
 A separate application ID for side-by-side installation with official NewPipe
 WizeStream maintains its app and integrated extractor. Report service and extractor failures to WizeStream first. Releases are available through GitHub and IzzyOnDroid.
 Storage permissions:
 On Android 6-9, WizeStream can optionally use legacy storage instead of Android's Storage Access Framework. Some Fire TV devices also use it because of a platform SAF issue. It allows reading existing files and saving downloads and backups. On Android 10 and newer, SAF is always used and these permissions are not requested.
 Camera permission:
 WizeStream optionally uses the CAMERA permission only when the user selects Scan pairing code for local device synchronization. It lets one device scan the one-time QR code displayed by another for secure pairing. The permission is requested only when the scanner opens. WizeStream does not capture, store, or upload camera images, and camera hardware is optional.
 Important project notice:
 WizeStream is based on NewPipe but is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the official NewPipe project, TeamNewPipe, or NewPipe e.V.
 WizeStream is free software distributed under the GNU General Public License version 3 or later. It preserves upstream NewPipe credits, license notices, and third-party license information.

fdroid:co.electriccoin.zcash.foss.name: Zodl: Zcash Wallet
fdroid:co.electriccoin.zcash.foss.summary: The most private crypto wallet. Built for financial sovereignty.
fdroid:co.electriccoin.zcash.foss.description:
Powered by Zcash, the most private cryptocurrency ever designed, also known as encrypted Bitcoin. With Zodl, you don’t need to know how blockchains work to use private money. Zodl hides the complexity while holding the line on security, making it an easy, low-risk way to get started.
Our Why
We envision a world without mass financial surveillance, where law-abiding people can transact freely and privately, without fear that their data will be exploited, sold, or weaponized by criminals, corporations, or governments. A world where financial privacy is the default and access to markets is a human right. Because the ability to make transactions that sustain life and liberty should belong to everyone. There is no sovereignty without privacy.
Built Different
Our wallet feels simple on the surface, but is powered by engineering depth other Zcash wallets simply don’t reach. Zodl’s engineers are the original creators of Zcash, with a level of cryptography and protocol mastery unmatched by any other wallet team. Paired with the product team that set the standard for Zcash UX, Zodl innovates with a full grasp of the blockchain’s requirements, capabilities, potential, and risks.
Open-Source Development
Our work is open source because reliable financial privacy requires transparent development. Anyone can inspect the protocol code, audit the wallet, and verify our work. We don’t ask for trust. We show our work.
Privacy by Design
Unlike most apps that claim to prioritize privacy, Zodl is built for it. We go out of our way to know nothing about you. Zodl does not see, collect, or track your wallet activity, balances, transaction history, clicks, or habits. We don’t profile.
Self-Custody
Zodl puts you in complete control of your funds: no gatekeepers, no middlemen, just true financial sovereignty. Only you can access and manage your ZEC. Your keys, your crypto.
The Most Private P2P Payments
Zcash is the most private cryptocurrency ever designed, and Zodl is built by a team of developers uniquely equipped to honor that design. Shielded ZEC keeps transaction details hidden on the blockchain, and Zodl extends that protection at the wallet level.
Private Cross-Chain Payments
Just because your friends expose their financial data on public blockchains, doesn’t mean you should. With Zodl CrossPay, you can use shielded ZEC to make payments in whatever asset your recipient prefers, like BTC or a stablecoin. Stay private.
Swaps to and from Shielded ZEC
Zodl’s built-in swaps are the simplest, most privacy-preserving way to fund your Zodl wallet or move from Zcash to another cryptocurrency.
User Feedback
Zodl is shaped by its users. Every update reflects what our community wants most. Whether you're requesting a new feature or sharing a bug report, your voice helps make the wallet better for everyone.
Tags:
Cryptocurrency, peer-to-peer payments, financial tools, finance, wallet, payments, privacy, personal finance, encryptions

fdroid:com.moi.lumine.name: Lumine
fdroid:com.moi.lumine.summary: A lightweight local HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy server protects TLS connections over TCP.
fdroid:com.moi.lumine.description:
lumine-mobile is a Clash-style Android implementation built on top of enimul (formerly lumine ).
 It brings enimul's core to Android with a VPN/TUN pipeline and a mobile-friendly UI, offering a more Clash-like experience with smarter routing and rule management.
You can also view it as a mobile-side functional extension of SniShaper .
 Features
 Native Android implementation built with Kotlin and gomobile 
 Proxying and routing powered by enimul core
 Clash-style configuration management UI
 Subscription URL import and rule switching
 Dedicated rule page for viewing, editing, and creating rules
 Blacklist-driven routing based on GFWlist for smarter traffic splitting
 Flexible Fake IP implementation
 Upstream
 enimul (formerly lumine): https://github.com/lzpls/enimul 
 This project uses enimul as its core and includes a number of local modifications. Some modes may still be unstable. The configuration file syntax remains compatible with upstream. To optimize mobile performance, some original IP-range rules were removed and the routing behavior was adjusted.
 Notes
 This repository is not the official upstream enimul repository. It is an Android-focused implementation and adaptation layer. The project is still in an early stage, and some websites may behave unstably. Feedback is welcome.

fdroid:com.yinmik.waterquality.name: Water Quality
fdroid:com.yinmik.waterquality.summary: Monitor pool and hot tub water quality with a BLE-YC01 Bluetooth sensor
fdroid:com.yinmik.waterquality.description:
An open-source Android app for the BLE-YC01 Bluetooth water quality tester. Connects via BLE to read real-time sensor data and track water quality over time — ideal for swimming pools and hot tubs.
 Features 
* Live dashboard with real-time readings for pH, ORP, EC, TDS, Free Chlorine, and Temperature
* Battery status displayed in the navigation bar
* Percentage change shown on each parameter card based on recent history
* Temperature chart on the dashboard (last 5 hours)
* Pool and hot tub reference lines on all charts (ideal ranges for pH, ORP, Chlorine, TDS, Temperature)
* History screen with time-series charts for all parameters (5h, 10h, 2d, 7d, 14d)
* Configurable poll interval (default 4 min, max ~5 min before device auto-off)
* Configurable save interval for persisting readings to local database
* Temperature alert with notification when a target temperature is reached
* Auto-reconnect to the last paired device on app launch
* All data stays on your device (Room database) — no cloud, no tracking
 Supported Device 
Model: BLE-YC01 (6-in-1 Bluetooth Water Quality Tester)
This is a white-label device sold under several brand names including Yinmik, Yieryi, Eujgoov, ANKROYU, and RCYAGO. All variants use the same BLE protocol and are compatible with this app. Look for model name BLE-YC01 in the product listing.
 Sensors 
* pH: 0.1 – 14.0
* ORP: -1200 – +1200 mV
* EC: 0 – 20,000 uS/cm
* TDS: 0 – 9,990 ppm
* Free Chlorine: 0.1 – 4.0 mg/L
* Temperature: 0.1 – 80.0 °C
 Device Notes 
* Powered by 3x AAA batteries
* The device auto-powers-off after ~5 minutes without an active BLE connection
* Continuous polling drains batteries faster; at the default 4-minute interval, batteries should last several months

apple-macos:6478960914.name: Local Calendar Sync
apple-macos:6478960914.description:
Dealing with multiple calendars in your life? Keep them in sync without exposing confidential information and get rid of cross-calendar conflicts! Whenever you have an appointment in one calendar, this app creates a Blocker or a full copy of that event in your other calendars automatically in the background.
What problem does this solve?
By keeping your calendars in sync, you ensure that your colleagues or family members can see your correct availability. Your availability status only gets shown based on the events that you have in a single calendar. So your colleagues at work might see you as “free”, even though you have an appointment on another calendar at that time.
Why not use an online service?
There are several online services that offer to sync your calendars for you. They all require you to provide them with access to your calendar so that they can manage your calendars, which most security departments won’t allow. This app though works fully offline on your computer, uses native tools to access your calendar and does not collect any data.
Please note, that this app can only synchronize calendars, that have been added to your device's Internet Accounts in the System Settings.

flathub:com.opera.opera-gx.name: Opera GX
flathub:com.opera.opera-gx.description:
Opera GX: THE gaming browser for powerful players
 Opera GX doesn't play by regular browser rules. It isn't here to blend in. It's here to take
 over. Designed from the ground up for gamers, streamers, modders, and anyone who wants more say
 in how their browser looks, sounds, and performs. GX puts you in the driver's seat with unique
 performance features:
 GX Control → limit RAM, and network usage, so your games stay smooth while your browser stays
 light.
 GX Cleaner → clear out old files and junk with one click and keep your browser running like
 new.
 Hot Tabs Killer → spot resource-draining tabs and shut them down instantly.
 Personalize every pixel of GX with GX Mods. Customize your themes, sounds, wallpapers, shaders,
 splash screens, icons and more. Build your own mod or browse thousands of community creations in
 the GX Store. Stay connected with your crew directly in the sidebar. Built-in Discord, Twitch,
 TikTok, WhatsApp, Instagram, Bluesky, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, or Slack — all fully integrated
 so you chat, stream and scroll without losing focus. Forget any tab overload. GX Corner keeps you
 ahead of the game with free games, release calendars, gaming news and the hottest deals — all in
 one spot, updated daily. Tune your audio with the built-in Music Player supporting Spotify, Apple
 Music, YouTube Music and more — no extra apps, no switching tabs. Protect your privacy with built-in
 Free VPN, Ad Blocker, Tracker Blocker, and Cryptomining Protection. And when things get awkward,
 hit Panic Button (F12) to instantly hide your session. Your data stays yours — Opera GX follows
 strict security standards, with no-log VPN independently audited by Deloitte. Opera GX also includes:
 Split Screen browsing
 Video Pop-Out for floating video windows
 Tab Islands & Tab Emojis to keep your tabs organized and easy to spot
 Aria browser AI — free, built-in AI assistant for instant answers
 My Flow for seamless file and link sharing across devices
 Workspaces & Pinboards to keep your projects tidy
 With 30+ million users worldwide and a global Discord community shaping GX every day, Opera
 GX is way more than a browser. It becomes your personalized control room for gaming, creating,
 streaming… and getting things done. Download Opera GX and enjoy the Internet from your own POV.

flathub:com.pinegrow.Pinegrow.name: Pinegrow
flathub:com.pinegrow.Pinegrow.description:
Pinegrow lets you work faster with HTML, CSS / SASS, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, GreenSock Interactions,
 WordPress and WooCommerce.
 Pinegrow works with standard web files and easily integrates into your existing workflow.
 Quickly build the layout of your webpage with powerful visual tools for adding, editing, moving,
 cloning and deleting HTML elements. Insert multiple elements with repeater and modify the layout
 of all selected elements with one move.
 Inspect active CSS rules, use rich visual controls, CSS Grid editor, Dev tools-like editor or
 code - all working together as one. Edit SASS and LESS, live, without any external tools.
 Turn hundreds of framework classes into powerful visual controls. Use the complete library of
 ready-to-use components and work with dynamic components like modals. Resize columns on the page
 and visualize the layout with display helpers.
 An add-on for Pinegrow Web Editor that lets you visually work with Tailwind CSS projects including
 those that use a custom theme.
 Use multi-page editing to edit your pages at multiple device sizes. Easily design responsive
 websites with Media query helper tool. Add custom breakpoints or let Pinegrow detect them by analyzing
 stylesheets.
 Pinegrow Pro lets you speed up your work even more with smart features such as master pages
 that let you define templates for your project. Turn page elements into reusable components with
 custom editable areas. Use Pinegrow as CMS for static HTML websites.
 Pinegrow lets you create powerful interactions and scroll scenes with custom animations designed
 with the timeline editor. Animations are powered by GreenSock GSAP, a proven high-performance animation
 library.
 Pinegrow is also the perfect tool for creating production-ready WordPress themes and plugins.
 Take any HTML page and turn it into a WordPress theme or Gutenberg blocks by assigning WordPress
 actions to individual elements on the page. Pinegrow exports the standard PHP WordPress files.

This is the official flatpak for PokeMMO, a turn-based MMORPG. PokeMMO is an online-only emulator for several popular Nintendo DS & Game Boy Advance games, allowing you to play, talk, fight, and trade with other players in real time. PokeMMO supports Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS, with tens of thousands of players online daily in a cross-play environment

flathub:io.github.shundhammer.qdirstat.description:
QDirStat is a graphical application to show where your disk space has gone and to help you to
 clean it up.
 It shows the total size of directories and of their files both in a traditional tree view and
 in a colored treemap graphics where a large file is shown as a large rectangle, and small files

flathub:io.github.voxelcubes.deepqt.description:
DeepQt is a user-friendly application that harnesses the power of the DeepL API for translation purposes. 
 With a clean interface and support for batch processing of plain text files and EPUB books, 
 DeepQt makes it easy to translate texts efficiently and effectively.
 DeepQt also features higher-level glossaries allowing you to make replacements before translation,

flathub:it.astrogods.AstroGods.name: AstroGods
flathub:it.astrogods.AstroGods.description:
AstroGods starts from the position of the planets at the moment of your birth to offer
 you a portrait of who you are: your way of loving, thinking, acting. You can explore
 compatibility with another person or understand what energies characterize a period of your life.
 Here, Astrology is taken seriously. The astronomical calculations are the most precise
 available, the methodology adheres to the original Egyptian tradition, the interpretations
 are in-depth. No generic horoscopes: each reading goes into the detail of your unique configuration.
 Your first birth chart reading is completely free. Additional birth charts require a Standard
 subscription (from 1.99 €/month). Synastry (compatibility analysis) and transit readings
 require a Premium subscription (from 2.99 €/month). All subscriptions include a 7-day free trial.

flathub:net.sourceforge.uqm_mods.UQM-Meg.description:
Here you will find The Ur-Quan Masters HD MEGAMOD, a mod that takes the best of the Ur-Quan
 Master's mods and rolls them up into one big "Mega" mod. Building upon the latest Ur-Quan
 Masters source code I've made an expansive mod which includes HD-mod, HD-Remix,

flathub:org.cloudcompare.CloudCompare.name: CloudCompare
flathub:org.cloudcompare.CloudCompare.description:
CloudCompare is a 3D point cloud (and triangular mesh) processing software. It has been originally
 designed to perform comparison between two dense 3D points clouds (such as the ones acquired with
 a laser scanner) or between a point cloud and a triangular mesh. It relies on a specific octree
 structure dedicated to this task. Afterwards, it has been extended to a more generic point cloud
 processing software, including many advanced algorithms (registration, resampling, color/normal/scalar
 fields handling, statistics computation, sensor management, interactive or automatic segmentation,
 display enhancement, etc.).

flathub:org.kde.kolourpaint.name: KolourPaint

 touch-up tool and for simple image editing tasks.
 Features:
 Support for drawing various shapes - lines, rectangles, rounded rectangles, ovals and polygons
 Curves, lines and text
 Color picker
 Selections
 Rotation, monochrome and other advanced effects

flathub:org.scummvm.ScummVM.name: ScummVM
flathub:org.scummvm.ScummVM.summary: Interpreter for numerous adventure games and role-playing games
flathub:org.scummvm.ScummVM.description:
ScummVM is a program which allows you to run a wide variety of classic graphical point-and-click
 adventure games and role-playing games, provided you already have their data files. The clever
 part about this: ScummVM just replaces the executables shipped with the game, allowing you to play
 them on systems for which they were never designed!
 Currently, ScummVM supports a huge library of adventures with over 250 games in total. It supports
 many classics published by legendary studios like LucasArts, Sierra On-Line, Revolution Software,
 Cyan, Inc. and Westwood Studios.
 Next to ground-breaking titles like the Monkey Island series, Broken Sword, Myst, Blade Runner
 and countless other games you will find some really obscure adventures and truly hidden gems to
 explore.

fedora-packages:edac-utils/edac-util.name: edac-util
fedora-packages:edac-utils/edac-util.summary: Command-line tool to generate standard EDAC reports
fedora-packages:edac-utils/edac-util.description: EDAC (Error Detection and Correction) is a set of Linux kernel modules that handle reporting of hardware-related errors. Currently these modules mainly handle detection of ECC memory errors for many x86 and x86-64 chipsets and PCI bus parity errors. The edac-utils project currently has three components: libedac, edac-util, and edac-ctl. The libedac library presents a standard API for reading EDAC error counts and other information from sysfs, and edac-util uses this API to generate standard reports from the commandline. The edac-ctl utility is a perl script which uses config files to load the appropriate EDAC driver for a given chipset and register motherboard DIMM labels if they are configured. An init script is also provided which uses edac-ctl to initialize EDAC at system startup. This package provides the edac-util command-line tool.

fedora-packages:ghc-basic-prelude/ghc-ba.name: ghc-basic-prelude
fedora-packages:ghc-basic-prelude/ghc-ba.description: The premise of basic-prelude is that there are a lot of very commonly desired features missing from the standard Prelude, such as commonly used operators (<$> and >=>, for instance) and imports for common datatypes (e.g., ByteString and Vector). At the same time, there are lots of other components which are more debatable, such as providing polymorphic versions of common functions. So basic-prelude is intended to give a common foundation for a number of alternate preludes. The package provides two modules: CorePrelude provides the common ground for other preludes to build on top of, while BasicPrelude exports CorePrelude together with commonly used list functions to provide a drop-in replacement for the standard Prelude. Users wishing to have an improved Prelude can use BasicPrelude. Developers wishing to create a new prelude should use CorePrelude.

firefox-addons:3044658.name: Keystone Privacy Shield
firefox-addons:3044658.summary: Zero-knowledge privacy for AI chats. Redacts PII before it reaches ChatGPT, Claude, or any LLM.
firefox-addons:3044658.description:
eystone Privacy Shield protects your sensitive data when using AI tools. It works as a local privacy layer between you and cloud AI services — all processing happens on your machine.
 Features: 
 - Automatic PII detection (names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, and more)
 - Real-time highlighting of detected entities while you type
 - One-click redaction before sending to AI
 - Smart restoration with interactive badges in AI responses
 - Right-click context menu for manual redaction
 - Per-site safe lists — mark words as safe so they're never redacted
 - Zero-knowledge architecture — your data never leaves your machine
 How it works: 
 1. Type a message in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity
 2. Keystone detects personal information automatically
 3. PII is replaced with safe placeholders before sending
 4. When the AI responds, Keystone restores your real data locally
 Requires the Keystone desktop application running locally for PII detection.
 Supported sites: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity

firefox-addons:2984639.name: TTV AB - Lightweight Twitch.tv Ad Blocker
firefox-addons:2984639.summary: Block ads on Twitch.tv live streams and VODs. No prerolls, midrolls, purple screens, or playback interruptions.
firefox-addons:2984639.description:
TTV AB - Twitch Ad Blocker is a lightweight Firefox extension built to block Twitch ads on live streams and VODs.
It helps block preroll ads, midroll ads, and Twitch video ads on live streams and VODs while keeping playback stable. It is designed for Twitch.tv users who want no ad interruptions and a smoother viewing experience.
✨ Key Features:
✅ Twitch ad blocker for live streams
✅ Twitch VOD ad blocker for /videos pages
✅ Blocks preroll and midroll ads
✅ Helps reduce purple-screen playback interruptions
✅ Buffer Fix toggle for smoother Twitch playback recovery
✅ Restores your selected video quality after ad recovery
✅ Simple enable/disable toggle
✅ Live Ads Blocked counter
✅ Estimated Time Saved counter
✅ Expandable statistics panel
✅ Statistics dashboard with time saved, weekly charts, and achievements
✅ 12 achievement badges to unlock
✅ Per-channel Twitch ad blocking breakdown
✅ Language selector with 11 supported languages: EN, ES, FR, DE, PT, IT, JA, KO, ZH-CN, ZH-TW, RU
✅ Modern animated popup UI
✅ Lightweight and fast
🚀 How to Use:
1. Install TTV AB and open Twitch.tv 
2. Open any live stream or VOD
3. Ads are blocked automatically no configuration needed
4. Click the TTV AB icon to view stats or toggle Ad Blocking, Ad Spoofing, and Low Quality Fallback
5. Change language via the dropdown at the bottom of the popup
⚙️ How It Works:
TTV AB works locally in your browser by handling Twitch HLS video playlists.
It can:
• Remove ad-marked segments from M3U8 playlists
• Switch to backup playback paths when Twitch ads are detected
• Help clean up stale Twitch ad overlays after recovery
• Restore normal playback and your selected quality after the ad window ends
During active ad recovery, Twitch may briefly fall back to a lower-quality backup stream, such as 360p. Once the ad window ends and native playback returns, TTV AB restores your selected stream quality.
🔒 Privacy:
TTV AB works entirely locally in your Firefox browser. It does not send your browsing activity, Twitch viewing activity, or usage data off your device.

firefox-addons:467098.name: Proper Menubar for Firefox

firefox-addons:467098.description:
Get everything you need from your browser with Proper Menubar – the ultimate browser extension for a streamlined browsing experience! The extension brings all essential browser functions, including File, Edit, View, History, Bookmarks, Window, and Help, into one convenient horizontal bar. Plus, with just one click on the X icon, you can easily hide the bar for a clutter-free interface.
The Proper Menubar is a lightweight and efficient add-on designed to streamline your browsing experience. It categorizes every function under the appropriate menu for easy access, whether you are saving files, editing text, muting the current tab, or toggling full screen mode. With the option to choose between the classic Web Browser menu bar or the Google Products menu bar, you can tailor your browsing setup to suit your preferences. Plus, with the ability to display the bar on all websites, your browsing experience remains consistent no matter where you go.
Choose between the following bars:
◆ Web Browser menu bar (default option)
◆ Google Products menu bar
Browser extension features:
◆ Browser Menu Customization:
Customize your browsing experience with the option to choose between the browser menu or the Google Products list, giving you control over your navigation preferences.
◆ Sound Control:
Easily mute or unmute the sound on the current tab, providing convenient audio management while browsing.
◆ View Mode:
Quickly access zoom controls to adjust the magnification of the current web page. Choose to zoom in or out for optimal readability, or effortlessly bring the entire page to full-screen mode.
◆ Google Products Order Adjustment:
Tailor your browsing bar by changing the order of Google Products, ensuring quick access to your preferred services. Such as Google Calendar, Google Translate, Gmail, YouTube, Gemini, etc.
◆ Country-Specific URL:
Switch seamlessly between Google country domains (UK, US, NL, ES, FR, JP, RU, etc.) with the option to customize your URL, enhancing your localized browsing experience.
◆ Search Keyword Retrieval:
Gain quick access to search keywords with an intuitive option to retrieve them effortlessly.
◆ Visual Customization:
Personalize your browsing interface by customizing background and color schemes, making it uniquely yours.
◆ Drop Shadow Addition:
Enhance the visual appeal of your browsing bar with the option to add a drop shadow effect, adding depth to its appearance.
◆ Screen Placement Flexibility:
Choose between placing the bar on the top or bottom of your screen, optimizing space and accessibility according to your preference.
◆ Tab Link Behavior:
Control how links behave with the option to open them in the existing tab, streamlining your browsing workflow.
◆ Context Menu Integration:
Access the context menu to toggle the visibility of the Proper Menubar on the current web page.
◆ Custom Toolbar Icon:
Select your preferred toolbar icon in either light or dark mode, adapting to your visual preferences.
◆ Define custom keyboard combinations to activate the Proper Menubar swiftly
◆ Support for Dark Mode
Project Information:
 https://www.stefanvd.net/project/proper-menubar/browser-extension/ 
Required Permissions:
◆ "contextMenus": Add a context menu to instantly toggle the Proper Menubar visibility.
◆ "activeTab": This permission is necessary for the following features: displaying or hiding the toolbar and executing context menu actions on the currently open tab.
◆ "storage": Save settings locally and sync with your web browser account.
◆ "pageCapture": This permission enables saving the currently open web page as an MHTML file.

◆ "downloads": This permission allows saving the current file to your Downloads folder.

Detective Rick Rogers is called in the middle of the night by a mysterious girl to the town of Ashen Valley that can only be found on an old map. This time the fate of the whole town lies in Rick's hands. But the case turns out to be more complicated, and town inhabitants seem very unwelcome, which makes Rick wonder.. Who hides behind the Hook Man figure?
HELP DETECTIVE RICK ROGERS SOLVE THE MYSTERY OF HAUNTED ASHEN VALLEY TOWN
Ashen Valley residents see ghosts at nights haunting their town. Are the ghosts victims of a maniac who lived there before? Do they seek revenge now? And the town residents seem like they are hiding something. Can Rick separate facts from fiction and save the town in time? An exciting plot that will be enjoyed by fans of hidden adventure games and secret mystery games for adults.
UNCOVER THE DARK SECRET OF THE TOWN RESIDENTS
Search for hidden objects to solve puzzles to escape and help the ever-fun Detective Rick Rogers in his investigation! Be a detective, find items, artifacts and solve the mystery. Enjoy locations, paranormal activity and complete mini-games in the paranormal investigation!
IN BONUS CHAPTER: FIND OUT WHY FARMER’S SON STARTED ACTING STRANGELY AND SHOWING PARANORMAL ABILITIES
A month past since Rick got rid of the Hook Man, and everything was peaceful. Until Greg Odell, a farmer Rick met before, asks him for help. His son Lewis began acting strange. He stopped talking and could move things without touching them. Now only Rick can find out why this is happening and help the boy!
Paranormal Files 4: The Hook Man's Legends is one of the find items games where you need to search for hidden objects like a detective. Learn all the secrets of the small town and solve puzzles to escape!
Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, and more! Zoom in on the scenes to help seek and find hidden items, and use clues if you get stuck. Explore the mystery of halloween as you progress!

bluejetty:00182882:ios.description:
Think you know words? Prove it — LIVE against real players!
Hangman Online: Word Game takes the classic hangman word game and turns it into a competitive multiplayer experience. Guess words, outsmart opponents, learn something new after every round, and build your own in-game friend circle.
WHY PLAYERS LOVE IT
 REAL-TIME MULTIPLAYER — Go head-to-head with real opponents in this online word game. It's a turn-based 2 player game where every letter counts — one wrong guess and you lose instantly!
 LEARN WHILE YOU PLAY — Every word comes with an educational fun fact. This is not just a word puzzle — it's a trivia and brain game too. Build your vocabulary while having fun. Guess "Conquest of Istanbul"? You'll learn who conquered it and when.
 DAILY LEADERBOARD — Climb the Top list. Show your name and photo to the entire community. Can you become the #1 word master?
 SOCIALIZE & MAKE FRIENDS — This is more than a game. Send friend requests after matches, build your friend list, and chat with them anytime — even outside of games. It's a social hangman experience!
 400 SOLO LEVELS — Test yourself offline with increasingly difficult word puzzles. Perfect for practicing before you challenge real players.
 PLAY IN ENGLISH OR TURKISH — Two full word databases with thousands of words to guess.
HOW IT WORKS
You and your opponent take turns picking letters to uncover the hidden word. Only you see your correct guesses. Six wrong picks and your man hangs — game over. First to guess the full word wins!
SOCIAL & CHAT FEATURES
Add friends after every match and grow your in-game community. Chat with friends from the messaging section anytime you want. Block or mute anyone with one tap. Unfriending is mutual — no unwanted messages. Your game, your rules.
FREE TO PLAY
Download this free word game now and join thousands of players worldwide. New words, features, and challenges added regularly!

Never Lose Your Bluetooth Devices Again with AirTracker!
Discover AirTracker, the Ultimate Bluetooth Tracker! Our app turns your smartphone into a powerful locator using advanced signal radar technology.
With AirTracker, losing your wireless headphones or any other Bluetooth-enabled devices (smartwatch, wireless charging case, fitness band, portable speaker, etc.) is a thing of the past. Plus, you can detect and manage spyware and unwanted Bluetooth devices in your vicinity.

* Interactive Search: Experience dynamic audio and tactile feedback that guides you to your device.
* Device Ping: Locate devices faster with the ability to send high-pitched sounds to them.

bluejetty:00017113:ios.description:
Shield is a powerful Safari plugin designed to block pornographic and explicit content, keeping your browsing safe and family-friendly. No need for an extra browser—Shield works seamlessly with Safari. For optimal results, delete other apps or browsers that might allow porn content access.
TOP FEATURES
PASSCODE PROTECTION
Shield is tamper-proof! Set up a passcode through your device’s restrictions to prevent anyone from disabling or deleting the app. Let your accountability partner manage the passcode for added security.
BLOCKS EXPLICIT IMAGES & WEBSITES
Shield blocks pornographic and explicit content, including adult images from search engines and sites like Tumblr, Reddit, and Flickr. It’s designed to keep unwanted content away.
PERFECT FOR FAMILIES
Protect your family with confidence. Use Family Sharing to install Shield on all devices in your household. Ensure that all devices are connected through the same Family Sharing group to let Shield safeguard your loved ones while browsing the web.
CUSTOM BLACKLIST & DEDICATED SUPPORT
Enhance protection by adding websites to your custom blacklist via Restrictions. Found explicit content? Our support team is here to help: support@shield-app.com.
SAFE BROWSING MADE EASY
Shield is perfect for accountability groups, NoFap supporters, and families who value a safe and distraction-free browsing experience.
SUBSCRIPTIONS & PRICING
Shield requires a subscription to operate:
 • Monthly: $2.99 USD
 • Annual: $24.99 USD (Save more with yearly billing!)
Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal anytime in your account settings.
REQUIREMENTS
Compatible with devices featuring a 64-bit processor. Devices must be connected via Family Sharing to enable protection across all household devices.
Learn More
shield-app.com

Shield offers best-in-class web filtering and porn blocking, ensuring your browser is safe for families, work, and personal growth. Whether you’re looking for a Net Nanny alternative, a safe web browser plugin, or extra accountability, Shield is your ultimate solution.

bluejetty:00187036:ios.name: World Clock - Local Time
bluejetty:00187036:ios.summary:
Time & Sun is a world clock that tells you the local time in over a million places around the world, from the biggest cities to the tiniest villages. 
If you're in business, this app's essential for calling other timezones at the precise l
bluejetty:00187036:ios.description:
Time & Sun is a world clock that tells you the local time in over a million places around the world, from the biggest cities to the tiniest villages. 
If you're in business, this app's essential for calling other timezones at the precise local time. You might have to call across the US when it's 10am in New York, then have a teleconference with overseas colleagues at 3.30pm Paris time. Use Time & Sun to make sure you phone at the exact local time, and don't miss a vital call from abroad.
This app also gives the sunrise and sunset times for every location – handy for outdoor enthusiasts, or if you're lying on a beach and want to plan your evening.
With today's global economy and affordable holiday travel, there have never been so many people globe-trotting at any one time. Simply tell Time & Sun where you are, and you can check if friends and family are awake to call or Skype.
Time & Sun has every location available in Google maps. It also recognises place names in other languages used by Google maps; for example, if you enter "Лондон", which is the Russian name for London, you will get the results in Russian!
Features of this app include:
• Support for all iPhone and iPad formats
• Immediate Daylight Saving Time Changes worldwide
• Find the exact time in over 1,000,000 cities, towns and villages
• Ability to rename locations, e.g. change your home town to “Family”
• Day and nighttime clock indicators – white clock faces for day, black for night 
• Times of sunrise and sunset in every location worldwide
• Easy to use and accurate – always!
• Customizable and adjustable
Terms of Use: https://www.theorytestrevolution.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://www.theorytestrevolution.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00027199:ios.description:
Слушайте аудиокниги на вашем iPhone, iPod Touch или iPad.
«Слушай» входит в топ-10 приложений 2016 года: https://developer.apple.com/app-store/best-of-2016/universal-book-technology-inc.
• Самый большой каталог аудиокниг в App Store, доступный по подписке.
• Бесплатный недельный доступ ко всем функциям и книгам в приложении.
• Никаких скрытых платежей — заплати за подписку и слушай все, что угодно когда угодно.
Слушай аудиокниги, а не читай — это простой и удобный способ слушать любимые аудиокниги, не задумываясь о их цене. Скачав приложение, вы получаете доступ к огромной библиотеке с самым обширным каталогом аудиокниг в русском App Store, доступной по подписке. Библиотека включает более 3000 наименований. Самые интересные новинки, прекрасные аудиоспектакли с участием известных актеров, актуальные бизнес-книги, фантастика, детективы, исторические романы, сказки для детей и нестареющая классика.
Функции и особенности:
• Слушайте и оценивайте отрывки книг, прежде чем оформить подписку либо оформите подписку и слушайте любые книги без ограничений.
• Мои книги: все аудиокниги, что вы когда либо выбирали доступны на всех устройствах (при условии использования одной учетной записи Apple ID).
• Подробные аннотации книг.
• Возможность фонового воспроизведения аудиокниг.
• Таймер сна, перемотка +/- 30 секунд.
• Возможность ускоренного воспроизведения.
• Страница автора с биографией и удобным доступом ко всем его книгам.
• Возможность слушать скачанные книги без наличия связи с интернет.
• Возможность стриминга аудиокниг через 3G-сети — начните слушать книгу прямо сейчас!
Если у вас есть пожелания или вопросы по работе приложения, если вы столкнулись с проблемой — купили подписку, а она не активировалась или появились проблемы со списанием денег — пожалуйста, напишите нам на support@anyreads.com.
Получите полный доступ к каталогу, воспользовавшись любой из подписок:
– Подписка на неделю за 219 ₽
– Подписка на месяц за 599 ₽
– Подписка на три месяца за 1390 ₽
– Подписка на год за 4490 ₽
Эти подписки продлеваются автоматически, пока не будут отменены пользователем (как минимум за 24 часа до окончания действия текущей подписки). Управление подписками и их отмена осуществляются в настройках учётной записи. Средства будут списаны с вашей учётной записи в момент подтверждения покупки.
Условия использования: https://patephone.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00126582:ios.name: ToDo List - Daily Task Planner
bluejetty:00126582:ios.summary:
ToDo List is a simple to-do list app that leaves out multiple lists, due dates, and sharing, letting you focus on one list on one screen, with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.
Check your tasks at a glance on your Home Screen or Lock Sc
bluejetty:00126582:ios.description:
ToDo List is a simple to-do list app that leaves out multiple lists, due dates, and sharing, letting you focus on one list on one screen, with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.
Check your tasks at a glance on your Home Screen or Lock Screen, and manage everything in one clear list. The app works offline, needs no account or sign-up, and is useful for capturing errands, shopping items, work tasks, study notes, chores, and anything you do not want to forget.
The app is built around one simple list and a clean single-screen design. No complex projects, folders, or setup. Just add a task, check it off, and keep your list organized.
[Main Features]
* Home Screen widget that updates in real time
* Lock Screen widget to see your tasks without unlocking
* Apple Watch app to view tasks, check them off, and add new ones by voice
* Add tasks with just one tap
* Enter tasks with the keyboard or iOS Dictation (voice input)
* Color-code tasks with 6 colors by swiping right
* Reorder tasks by dragging and dropping them (long-press)
* Swipe left on a task to delete it
* Clear all completed tasks by tapping the trash button
* Mark all tasks as completed or incomplete at once
* Works offline, no account required
* Supports Dark Mode and VoiceOver
[One List, One Screen]
ToDo List is made for people who find most to-do apps too complicated, and for anyone who prefers a minimalist approach to task management. There is no support for multiple lists, projects, folders, due dates, reminders, syncing, or sharing.
Everything stays in one clear list on one screen, so you can focus on what needs to be done today. If you have tried feature-heavy task managers and given up, this app takes the opposite approach: open it, write down a task, and you’re done.
[Home Screen & Lock Screen Widgets]
Place the widget on your Home Screen to see your list at a glance — like a sticky note that is always in view. The widget updates in real time, reflecting changes as they happen.
With the Lock Screen widget, your tasks are visible whenever you pick up your iPhone—without unlocking it or opening the app.
[Color-Coded Tasks]
Swipe right on a task to give it one of 6 colors.
Use colors to mark urgent items, separate work and personal tasks, group shopping items, or highlight what you want to do first. Colors help keep the single list easy to scan, even when it gets long.
[For Everyday Life]
ToDo List can be used for work tasks, school assignments, homework, shopping lists, chores, errands, personal goals, and daily routines. It also works as a simple checklist — for packing before a trip, for moving or spring cleaning, for daily habits you want to keep up, or for anything you tick off one item at a time.
Because past tasks do not pile up in folders or archives, you can use it as a daily reset list: write down today’s tasks in the morning, check them off during the day, and clear the list for tomorrow. You can also use it to write down everything on your mind and clear your head, to break a big task into smaller steps, or as a second, short-term list alongside your main task manager.
[Accessibility & More]
The app opens straight to your list. It supports Dark Mode and VoiceOver, allowing tasks to be read aloud and managed with the screen reader.
[Free to Use]
ToDo List is free to download and use. It shows ads, which you can remove with a one-time purchase — there is no subscription.
Download ToDo List and keep today’s tasks on one simple screen.

bluejetty:00184082:ios.name: Financial Calculator++
bluejetty:00184082:ios.summary: The creators of 5-star Scientific++, Statistics Calculator++, and Statistics Calculator+++ for iPad present Financial Calculator++, a financial calculator that has all the financial capabilities of the popular Texas Instruments BA II Plus (
bluejetty:00184082:ios.description:
The creators of 5-star Scientific++, Statistics Calculator++, and Statistics Calculator+++ for iPad present Financial Calculator++, a financial calculator that has all the financial capabilities of the popular Texas Instruments BA II Plus (except for a few features that are outlined in this description and will be available in a later update.) 
If you have used BA II Plus or any other mainstream financial calculator, you will feel right at home since we designed Financial Calculator++ as consistent as possible with those products. As a user of a financial calculator or a new user, you will find out that a lot of features in this app are implemented to simplify tasks and reduce the number of keystrokes. 
All financial calculations can be performed on the keypad mode of the calculator. The bottom part of the screen shows the relevant variables depending on the type of the calculation being performed. Resetting, recalling, deleting, or reordering of the parameters and changing the settings are done in the menu mode which can be accessed by pressing the arrow keys.
Instructions for each financial calculation is included in the menu mode within the app. Visit our website for keystroke by keystroke examples for varieties of financial calculations at www.dogahe.com.
Details:
- Time value of money (TVM) calculations useful for mortgages, loans, leases, savings, and annuities. It can also produce amortization schedules. 
- Cash flow analysis with capability of entering uneven cash flows with frequencies. Capability of reordering or deleting the cash flow values in a table view presentation and seeing the NPV and IRR updated as reordering or deleting of cash flow values happen. 
- Depreciation calculates depreciation, remaining book value (RBV) and depreciable value (RDV) with different methods (Straight Line, Sum of the Years Digits, Declining Balance, and Declining Balance with cross-over to Straight Line)
- Statistics performs statistics and regression analysis for one or two variables with four regression models. (In fact, Financial Calculator++ has all the statistics capabilities that earned our Statistics Calculator++ 5-star rating).
- Date calculates number of days between dates. Dates can be entered using the keypad or using a date picker.
- Percent change, compound interest, interest conversion, profit margin, breakeven are all included in the capabilities of Financial Calculator++.
- If you are wondering how all of these fit on the screen, well, the left half of the screen scrolls to reveal more functions.
- Bond calculations are not available in this version. 
Other major features of Financial Calculator++ are as follows:
- Shows the expression as you enter and keeps a history of your calculations (Swipe up on the screen to reveal the history)
- Capability of calculating permutation, combination, Least Common Multiple (LCM), and Greatest Common Divisor (GCD).
You are going to love the simplicity of the user interface and you will get used to the way financial calculations are performed in Financial Calculator++ very quickly. 
Please do not hesitate to contact us for any questions, comments, to report any bugs, or to suggest additional functions you would like to see in the upcoming updates.
Visit our website www.dogahe.com for more screen shots and other product descriptions.

bluejetty:00035478:ios.description:
Never miss a moment of inspiration!
The lyricist, rapper, song writer, or other creative genius in you thrives on inspiration. On the bus, hanging with friends, or even when you’re in the bathroom — inspiration can strike anywhere. Will you be prepared to capture it? Miss the opportunity and it may be lost forever! Rhymer’s Block is a unique app that allows you to quickly and easily capture your words of inspiration anywhere your life takes you. And if you have a creative block, it can help you with that too!
The experts say to keep a notebook handy to jot down ideas for your raps, poems, and song lyrics. Just try and lug around one of those when you’re out with friends! Since you download Rhymer’s Block on your iPhone, iPod, or iPad—it’s with you wherever you go. When the inspiration flows, open the app and make your notes. Nobody has to know that you’re in the midst of creating your next masterpiece!
You can create a Rhymer’s Block account and have your work automatically uploaded to the cloud to make sure it’s safe and sound! 
There are apps that are similar to Rhymer’s Block, but they just don’t compare. Here are the features that make Rhymer’s Block the best choice:
• Real-Time Rhyme Suggestions
Who has time to search for rhymes? Rhymer’s Block instantly suggests words that rhyme as you type. Keep that inspiration flowing!
• Rhyme ANY word
We know creative people have a language of their own, so Rhymer’s Block is designed to figure out what a word sounds like phonetically even if it’s not in the dictionary. fo shizzle!
• Slant / Near Rhymes
Finds rhymes that sound good without being a perfect rhyme. For example 'dark' rhymes with 'heart' - but they are not perfect rhymes.
• Word Frequency Analysis
Rhymer’s Block will show you rhyme suggestions for words most commonly used first! No need to waste your time sifting through words no one uses.
• Color-Coded Rhymes
Rhyming words in each entry are highlighted with corresponding colors. At a glance you see the words that rhyme. See your lyrics visually!
• Works Offline
On a plane, subway, or somewhere else you have to take your mobile device offline? With Rhymer’s Block you can keep working with your rhymes. Never put your creativity on hold! 
• Cloud Sync
Create a Rhymer’s Block account to keep your work safe and have it automatically uploaded to “the cloud.” You can create and access your Rhymer’s Block account directly from the app. 
• The Block
A Rhyming app with a social network? Yes! The best way to be inspired is by connecting with others. Share your work on The Block and get feedback. Explore the creativity of others. Give Respect and add comments. It's like a 24/7 Poetry Slam.
• Customize Your View
The app includes several customization options. Connect to friends on Facebook, create a Rhymer’s Block profile, or hide those “colorful” words in your rhyme. It’s up to you!
Download Rhymer’s Block today and become the envy of your creative friends who are still carrying around notebooks to create the words for their rap, poem, or song!
Terms of Use: https://bit.ly/rb_tos
Privacy Policy: https://bit.ly/rb_privacy

bluejetty:00164827:ios.description:
► PUT THE PEDAL TO THE METAL
Drivers, rev your engines! Get ready for a heart-pounding nonstop thrill-fest packed with fast cars, powerful guns, and more road rage than downtown New York City during rush hour. Download Desert Riders now and start living life in the fast lane!
Fight enemies as you race side-by-side down the road in this exhilarating car shooting game. Just press on your screen to fire your weapon and drag your finger to aim. Blow apart enemy vehicles piece by piece and eliminate enemy shooters to make them spin out of control and explode!
Be careful to avoid enemy fire and make sure to dodge before the other vehicles ram into you. If you take too much damage, your car will be the one to blow up! The better your shooting and driving skills, the more in-game money you’ll be rewarded with!
► PIMP YOUR RIDE
No car game is complete without customization, and Desert Riders is no exception! Choose a booster at the beginning of each level to add awesome extra weapons, armor, and health before you hit the street and bring the heat.
Take personalization to the next level by saving up currency to unlock tons of new cars and swappable parts at the garage. And remember to get a sweet new paint job while you’re at it!
► GAME FEATURES
• This action-packed car shooting game combines easy-to-learn controls with challenging goals.
• Take down enemies in all types of vehicles, from motorcycles and sports coupes to police cars and armored trucks. For bonus cash, wipe out enemies as you drive by buildings in slow motion! Rack up kills to complete levels, and score extra points for well-aimed headshots!
• As you progress, you’ll travel through different apocalyptic worlds with varying terrains! See if you can prove your skills in especially tough boss levels.
• Choose a new booster in each level to play to your strengths. Laser and plasma guns, lightning, armor, money, extra health—all this and more is at your disposal!
• Complete levels and missions to open chests and get rewards that you can use to modify your vehicle.
• Make a pit stop at the auto shop to upgrade your ride. Unlock dozens of cars, including retro and rare models!
• Customize your vehicle with over 70 wheels, bumpers, exhaust pipes, and engines. Plus, paint your car any color you want!
• Enjoy the awesome soundtrack, fun sound effects, and cool graphics!
• Turn up the thrill factor with the optional vibration setting.
This shooter and car game has it all: fast-paced gameplay, mind-blowing excitement, and cool cars and weapons. Get behind the wheel and jump into the action! Install Desert Riders now and go for a spin!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00153497:ios.description:
In the nuanced dance of modern courtship, words are your most powerful instrument. 
This app is designed for those who understand that true connection lies at the intersection of wit, timing, and emotional intelligence. 
With our AI-driven platform, you no longer need to rely on chance - every message becomes an opportunity to engage, intrigue, and leave a lasting impression. 
Precision-Tailored Responses, Engineered for Impact.
- Intelligent Reply Generation:
Our advanced artificial intelligence analyzes conversational context in real time, crafting responses that balance charm with authenticity. No more generic lines—just perceptive, context-aware replies designed to captivate. 
- Profile-Driven Personalization: 
By uploading a screenshot of your match’s bio or conversation, our system deciphers their interests, tone, and subtle cues, allowing you to respond with precision. Speak their language, effortlessly. 
- Effortless Integration:
A seamless copy-and-send workflow ensures you spend less time agonizing over words and more time fostering genuine connections. Watch as your matches respond with heightened interest, drawn to your effortless conversational mastery. 
This is more than an auto-reply tool - it’s a mentorship in the art of digital seduction. 
Over time, you’ll internalize the principles of compelling communication: what elicits intrigue, what sustains engagement, and what to avoid. 
Hesitation fades, replaced by the quiet confidence of someone who knows exactly what to say - and when to say it. 
Imagine a reality where every exchange is fluid, every response calibrated for maximum resonance. No more missed opportunities, no more second-guessing. 
Our AI acts as your discreet conversational strategist, ensuring you remain intriguing, articulate, and always one step ahead - whether your goal is profound connection or lighthearted repartee. 
The right words can alter the course of a relationship. Why leave them to chance? Download now and redefine what it means to truly connect.

Your chosen subscription plan will automatically renew at the end of each billing cycle, ensuring uninterrupted access.

You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime through your Apple ID settings.

bluejetty:00016910:ios.description:
Design your own dream city on this exotic and tropic island paradise!
Looking for a highly addictive city building game with awesome graphics on a tropical island? The City Island: Paradise Sim game is the best escape for you! Your goal is to build a beautiful metropolis on this paridise of islands, just starting with some farm land on an exotic island bay. Build it your way, starting with a little village, adding lots of resorts and buildings and grow your own city island!
The City Island: Paradise Sim building game is a free city builder that makes you feel like a mayor of a big city or the resort owner on an island paradise. This game is playable offline and online so you can always play this amazing resort tycoon game with a tropical island twist. 
City Island: Paradise Sim - Build your own city offline game
This highly addictive game is developed by Sparkling Society, well known for its other city building games such as the City Island sim games played by over 75 million players worldwide. When starting Paradice City Island Sim you will start small on an empty island and step by step from a simple town, to a village you will build your own amazing town city and eventually a metropolis. There are different kinds of tropical islands with their own surfaces. However, there are also more challenging islands with snow, desert, wood, and so on. It is very important to keep your citizens happy. When your citizens aren't happy, you will not get the 100% profits of the commercial buildings. 
- Online & Offline playable
- Tropical Paradise setting
- Seaside Hotel & Resort game 
- Your virtual tycoon game 
- Highly addictive in a good way :)
- This farm & building game is playable for the entire family, a real family game
- Build your own tropic paradice city island escape
- 9 different islands paradises and 200+ buildings and farms to unlock
- Awesome graphics 
- Expand your town along the beaches
- Free family game with fun for all ages

Privacy-Focused: Your data stays private with no third-party access. We prioritize security so you can scan with confidence.

bluejetty:00178017:ios.description:
Be a web hero!
Unleash your inner web-slinging hero in Web Hero, an adrenaline-pumping mobile game reminiscent of your favorite wall-crawling champion! Protect your neighborhood from peril and be the beacon of hope in this thrilling web-slinging simulator.
As the Web Hero, equipped with spider-like abilities, your mission is clear: thwart villains, prevent accidents, and keep the city safe from harm. Prepare for heart-racing action as you swing into action to rescue the innocent!
The adventure awaits! Take control of the Web Hero as you navigate through the bustling city streets, using your agile skills to turn every obstacle into a swinging spectacle. But beware! From lightning-fast trains to unexpected hazards, danger lurks around every corner.
Experience the exhilaration of being a superhero with extraordinary powers at your fingertips. Tap to unleash your sticky spider ropes and ensnare obstacles, but tread carefully - strategic tapping strengthens your grip, ensuring nothing slips through your grasp.
With every press of your screen, seize the moment and swing into action before it's too late. Are you up to the challenge of being the ultimate protector of your neighbors?
Become the hero your city deserves - become the Super Web Hero! Download now and embark on your heroic journey.
Go! YOU SUPER WEB HERO!

bluejetty:00044151:ios.name: The Game of Life 2+
bluejetty:00044151:ios.summary:
Pocket Gamer award winner The Game of Life 2+ arrives on Apple Arcade, with exclusive jobs and a brand-new outfit for Apple Arcade players! 
The official sequel to the world-famous board game, The Game of Life 2+ opens up a thousand lives
bluejetty:00044151:ios.description:
Pocket Gamer award winner The Game of Life 2+ arrives on Apple Arcade, with exclusive jobs and a brand-new outfit for Apple Arcade players! 
The official sequel to the world-famous board game, The Game of Life 2+ opens up a thousand lives to live! Will you seek out your soulmate or stay single? Have kids or adopt a kitten? Dive right into your dream career or switch it up? The choice is yours!
Exclusive to Apple Arcade players, dress up in the P.E.G. outfit – that’s the Perfect Electronic Gamer outfit, which turns your peg into a sleek robot ready to calculate the best route to victory. 
Plus, enjoy even more possibilities with ten different job titles exclusive to Apple Arcade! Become a Zookeeper, a knight’s Squire or a Pumpkin Carver. Live out your life as a Hot Cocoa Barista, a Chieftain or an Underwater Treasure Hunter. Experience adventures as a Terraformer, a Chocolate River Gondolier or a Dolphin Trainer. Or play as a Shovel Seller or a Quantum Mechanic! 
CUSTOMISE YOUR CHARACTER – Pick out your perfect peg! Choose from pink, blue or purple, dress for your dream, then head out in your chosen vehicle! 
SPIN THE SPINNER – Life’s all about choices and a little random chance. That’s where the iconic Spinner comes in! Whether you head to college or straight into your chosen career, the Spinner will influence your life path…
FACE NEW CROSSROADS – Crossroad moments can change the outcome of your life path. These important decisions arise at all stages, so worry not! Enjoy the ride!
WIN YOUR WAY – In this sequel, there’s more to life than wealth. Win by earning points in Happiness, Knowledge, Wealth, or a mix of the three! 
PLAY PAST RETIREMENT – Enjoy your well-earned retirement with a wide array of options. Tick everything off your bucket list!
CROSS-PLATFORM PLAY – Play with your friends and family, whatever their preferred platform. The Game of Life 2+ is available on mobile, consoles and PC.
DISCOVER 10 ADDITIONAL WORLDS – More realities mean more lives! Whether you’ve dreamt of becoming an astronaut or ruling as a beautiful princess, there’s a World in The Game of Life 2+ for you!
LUNAR AGE: Blast off to a new frontier and discover life among the stars!
FROZEN LANDS: Brave the cold and behold the sparkling, snowy landscape!
SUPERHERO WORLD: Live your life as a superhero!
EL DORADO: Explore the hidden city of El Dorado and decide your own legend!
UNDER THE SEA: Swim into a new life under the sea and enjoy wave after wave of choices!
SWEET HAVEN: Bake up a brand-new life in Sweet Haven! Life can be so sweet… 
SANDY SHORES: Relax on the beach or become a busy marine biologist on the golden sands of Sandy Shores!
AGE OF GIANTS: Head back in time and live among the dinosaurs! 
HAUNTED HILLS: Choose a life in the shadows and embrace the spooky world of Haunted Hills!
FAIRYTALE KINGDOM: Will you become a brave knight or a wondrous wizard? Tell your story!

bluejetty:00065303:ios.description:
Managing your Security Finance account has never been easier with the Security Finance℠ Mobile App, which offers a range of features designed to help you stay on top of things while on the go. With our app, you can easily make secure payments, check your next due date, contact your local branch, explore financial education tools, easily sign up and change a password, and more. Moreover, you can enable notification reminders, so you never miss a payment.
The Security Finance℠ Mobile App provides the following features:
• Make secure payments without convenience fees 
• Receive notification reminders
• Check your payment amount and next due date
• Verify your loan balance
• View your last payment and amount
• View loan documents 
• Upload verification documents 
• Improved sign-up, log-in, and user id/password change experience 
• Find a nearby branch
• Renew your loan by phone
• Contact your local branch easily
• Schedule your Tax appointment 
At Security Finance, we are committed to providing fast financial solutions that cater to your busy schedule. For over 65 years, we have proudly served our community with easy and safe installment loans, and now we are bringing you even more convenience with our mobile app. With our conveniently located branches, you can receive personal service from people you know and trust. And now, with the app, you can easily manage your account and make fast, secure payments, right at your fingertips.
If you are not currently a customer with Security Finance, you can still access the app as a guest to explore branch locations and contact information. However, to enjoy the app's full functionality, you must open a loan account.
Security Finance is licensed to offer traditional installment loans, which vary in amounts, terms, and available ancillary products based on the states of operation.
Any account activity processed on a given day will not be reflected until the next business day.
All Rights Reserved 2023
You can find our Privacy Policy, Privacy Notice, and Security Finance℠ Mobile App Terms of Use on our website at www.securityfinance.com

bluejetty:00153729:ios.description:
SOVL is a ruleset for playing fantasy wargames. It can be played with miniatures on a table or on your phone/tablet.
Fantasy armies meet on the battlefield and fight until one side is the bloody victor. Units of soldiers maneuver on the table and the outcome of melee combat, volleys of arrows and destructive spells is decided with dice rolls.
Features in the digital version:
Campaign mode: "Trail of Death" is a procedural campaign with roguelite elements. Start with a small warband and develop it into a grand army that can challenge the final boss.
SOVL Army Builder: Create and customize your army for any of SOVLs factions. Choose a Commander to lead, select units and their equipment, and design a color scheme.
AI Battle: Take your custom army and try it out against an AI opponent. Test your unit compositions and optimize your strategies. 
Multiplayer: Play games online against other players. Challenge your friends and crush them on the battlefield!

bluejetty:00158570:ios.description:
L'application mobile AFMA c’est votre assurance à portée de main. L’application vous permet de consulter et suivre vos dossiers de remboursement d’assurance en ligne, de poser vos questions et envoyer vos réclamations directement à AFMA, de trouver et contacter les agences AFMA partout au Maroc, à tout moment, où que vous soyez.
Pour profiter pleinement de toutes les fonctionnalités de l’application mobile AFMA, il vous suffit de créer un compte avec votre n° de CIN et de choisir votre mot de passe. En vous authentifiant, vous accédez à votre Espace assurance qui vous donne l’accès à plusieurs services :
#Assurance Santé :
• Consultez les remboursements de vos dossiers maladie.
• Consultez la liste de vos bénéficiaires.
#Mes Réclamations :
• Renseignez une nouvelle réclamation.
• Suivez le traitement de vos réclamations.
#Besoin d’aide ?
• Contactez le service support sur notre Hotline H24.
• Retrouvez les adresses et n° des agences AFMA partout au Maroc.
# Mais aussi :
• Mettez à jour vos coordonnées (adresse, Téléphone, e-mail), dans l’onglet « Profil ».
• Retrouvez nos articles et vidéos conseils en assurance.
NOTE : Si vous ne parvenez pas à vous connecter, nous vous invitons à nous contacter pour vérifier l’éligibilité de votre contrat, via l’application mobile, par téléphone au 08 02 00 22 23 ou en ligne sur la rubrique réclamation de notre site web : https://afma.ma/reclamation

bluejetty:00186157:ios.name: Sudoku Quest - Puzzle Games
bluejetty:00186157:ios.summary:
Sudoku Quest: Classic Sudoku & Logic Puzzles
Sudoku Quest is a classic sudoku puzzle game for players who enjoy logic puzzles, brain training, and relaxing offline play. Solve more than 2,000 challenging levels, choose from multiple grid s
bluejetty:00186157:ios.description:
Sudoku Quest: Classic Sudoku & Logic Puzzles
Sudoku Quest is a classic sudoku puzzle game for players who enjoy logic puzzles, brain training, and relaxing offline play. Solve more than 2,000 challenging levels, choose from multiple grid sizes, and explore special sudoku variations designed for every skill level, from Beginner to Advanced.
Whether you want a quick number game, a calm mental exercise, or a more advanced logic challenge, Sudoku Quest offers a smooth and rewarding way to play every day.
SOLVE SUDOKU PUZZLES YOUR WAY
Each sudoku puzzle is a logic-based number challenge that tests your focus, strategy, and problem-solving skills. Fill every row, column, and section with the correct numbers while avoiding duplicates.
Play on 4x4, 6x6, 8x8, 10x10, and 12x12 grids. Start with smaller boards, develop your solving strategy, and progress to larger, more challenging puzzles at your own pace.
CLASSIC SUDOKU AND SPECIAL VARIATIONS
Enjoy classic sudoku or try special puzzle variations inspired by Killer Sudoku and Math Sudoku. Different grid sizes, difficulty levels, and puzzle types add variety while keeping the familiar logic gameplay that sudoku players enjoy.
KEY FEATURES
• More than 2,000 sudoku puzzle levels
• Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert difficulty levels
• Multiple grid sizes: 4x4, 6x6, 8x8, 10x10, and 12x12
• Classic sudoku, Killer Sudoku, and Math Sudoku-inspired puzzles
• Clean interface with simple, intuitive controls
• Sudoku offline play without an internet connection
• Daily Challenge with no timer and varied difficulty
• Lucky Spin with daily rewards
• Auto Save to protect your progress
• Sound controls for better concentration
• Facebook connection for playing and exchanging gifts with friends
DAILY CHALLENGES AND BRAIN TRAINING
Complete a new Daily Challenge, practice without a timer, and build a regular brain training routine. Each challenge offers a fresh logic puzzle with a different difficulty level, giving you a new reason to return every day.
Play sudoku offline whenever you want to relax, improve your concentration, or keep your mind active.
NEW BOOSTER SYSTEM
Use in-game currency to choose the exact type of help you need. Preboosters prepare the puzzle before you begin, while boosters provide assistance during gameplay.
PREBOOSTERS
• Draft Block adds correct pencil marks to a random block, row, or column.
• Number X adds correct pencil marks to a random cell.
• Shield gives you three shields. Each shield prevents you from losing one life after a mistake.
BOOSTERS
• Master Hint lets you select an empty cell and explains the logic behind a clear move.
• Quick Assist highlights a possible move in a selected empty cell.
• Draft Master instantly adds correct pencil marks to all empty cells, saving time and making the board easier to read.
• Focus highlights all valid positions for a selected number.
WHY PLAY SUDOKU QUEST?
Sudoku Quest is easy to start and rewarding to master. It combines classic sudoku, relaxing offline play, daily logic puzzles, helpful boosters, and steady progression in one seamless puzzle experience.
If you are looking for a good sudoku game, you can select the grid size and difficulty level that match your experience. Beginners can learn the basics on smaller boards, while advanced players can take on larger grids and more complex logic challenges.
Searching for sudoku no ads? Enjoy a focused puzzle experience that lets you concentrate on what matters most: solving each sudoku puzzle.
START YOUR SUDOKU QUEST
Play sudoku offline, train your brain, improve your logic skills, complete Daily Challenges, collect rewards, and work your way toward becoming a Sudoku Master.
