bluejetty:00134314:ios.name: Farming Fever - Cooking game
bluejetty:00134314:ios.summary: Torn between farm games and cooking games? You don't have to choose between being a farmer and being a chef. Embark on a country escape and experience cooking fever right on the farm! You'll love this exciting time management game 'cause yo
bluejetty:00134314:ios.description:
Torn between farm games and cooking games? You don't have to choose between being a farmer and being a chef. Embark on a country escape and experience cooking fever right on the farm! You'll love this exciting time management game 'cause you can keep both your chef's hat and your pitchfork!
Put yourself to the test in this exciting farming simulator game with a business side. Harvest crops, cook food, and take care of your customers. Travel the world and get a taste of rural life! Go from being a family farm owner to running all kinds of unique businesses and diner dashes:
● Golden Farm: harvest fruit and berries to make sweet pastries and jam. Open an authentic village bakery!
● Fish Farm: hone your culinary skills at the House by the Lake. Surprise your customers with exquisite seafood options!
● Township: build a barn and raise all kinds of animals, from chickens and cows to fluffy alpacas!
● Green Farm: grow rare flowers and make your own flowerpots. Become a gardening legend!
● Be a mountain farmer, start an apiary in a flower field, or launch your own unique business at a seaside resort. Cooking and entrepreneurship have never been this exciting!
Enjoy classic TIME MANAGEMENT gameplay. Harvest crops and cook delicious meals in just a few taps. Give it a try—it's easy and fun!
Cooking Farm: Hay & Cook game
● Cooking and farming in one casual game! 
● Real farmers will fall in love with the serene backdrop of this country escape! Spend the day in the sun enjoying village landscapes sprinkled with wildflowers, rustic barns, and bales of hay. 
● Stay on your toes 'cause you're about to experience real cooking fever during peak business hours! 
● Cook tasty meals made exclusively from natural ingredients grown on your own farm. Make sure nobody ever leaves hungry! 
● Earn tips by fulfilling orders quickly. 
● Modernize your farm, upgrade your equipment, and maximize profit to take your farmstead to the next level.
● Go on a farm adventure with an enterprising main character and open new farms across the globe! 
● Try your hand at everything from diner dash management to gardening and baking!
● Treat your customers to mouthwatering candy apples! 
● Play hundreds of exciting time management levels. 
Develop your own strategy and make it big in this unique farming simulator. Set off for the village and start your very own farm adventure! 
You can find the answers to many questions in the FAQ, or by contacting our in-game support team. The FAQ is available here: 
https://matryoshka.helpshift.com/hc/en/5-farming-fever/
Reach out to us regarding any questions or suggestions you have. We read all messages!
Sincerely, the Matryoshka Games team

bluejetty:00095953:ios.description:
Food Scanner – Ingredient & Health Checker
Scan food, detect harmful ingredients, and eat smarter.
Your Personal Food and Health Advisor
Make informed choices about what you eat with Food Scanner — the intelligent tool that helps you evaluate the health impact of food in seconds. Whether it’s a packaged snack, home-cooked meal, or restaurant dish, instantly learn how healthy (or harmful) it really is.
Scan and Analyze Any Food
Just snap a photo or scan to get:
• A breakdown of ingredients and additives;
• Evaluation of food safety and nutritional quality;
• Identification of harmful chemicals, E-numbers, and processed content;
• Calorie, fat, sugar, and nutrient info (as secondary insight).
Designed for anyone who wants to avoid hidden risks and eat cleaner — without needing a nutrition degree.
Harmful Ingredient & Allergen Alerts
Receive instant warnings if your food contains:
• Common allergens (like gluten, dairy, soy, nuts)
• Harmful additives, preservatives, colorants, or sweeteners
• Ingredients to avoid based on your dietary preferences or health goals
The app simplifies safe and mindful eating in one scan.
Health Recommendations & Alternatives
Learn how to improve your meals:
• See food Health Scores based on quality, ingredients, and risk level;
• Get suggestions for healthier alternatives;
• Discover better options while shopping, dining, or cooking.
Perfect for clean eating, anti-inflammatory diets, kids’ health, or managing conditions like diabetes, IBS, or food intolerances.
• Track What You Scan;
• Save scan history automatically;
• Build your personal list of healthy (and unhealthy) foods.
Review past meals and decisions to stay on track
Eat Smarter. Avoid Hidden Risks.
Food Scanner is more than a calorie counter — it’s your guide to eating safe, healthy, and clean, every day.
You can purchase an auto-renewable subscription to get full access. Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews for the same price and the duration period depends on the selected plan (weekly, yearly) unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off the auto-renewal feature at any time by changing your account settings.
Please choose from our standard subscription options below: 1-week subscription from $5.99; 12-month subscription from $34.99. Prices may change depending on your country.
Privacy Policy: https://appliks.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://appliks.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00081877:ios.summary:

Feature Highlights. Everything is designed for better reading.
1. Rich format support: supports popular formats including TXT, EPUB, MOBI, AZW3
bluejetty:00081877:ios.description:
PureLibro is a multi-format reader for novels, comics, PDFs, local files, and remote libraries.
Feature Highlights. Everything is designed for better reading.
1. Rich format support: supports popular formats including TXT, EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, AZW, CBZ, CBR, PDF, ZIP, and RAR (DRM-free files only).
2. Comic reader: supports ZIP, RAR, CBZ, and CBR comic archives. PDF, EPUB, and MOBI files can also be switched to comic mode with one tap, making it ideal for comics, art books, and image-rich content.
3. Remote library streaming reading (comic mode): supports remote libraries such as SMB, OPDS and WebDAV. On servers that support streaming access, ZIP, RAR, CBZ, CBR, and PDF files can be opened without fully downloading them first, saving local storage space.
4. AI-based image enhancement: supports Waifu2x / Anime4K to improve comic image quality (comic mode only).
5. iCloud sync: keeps reading progress and book data consistent across your devices.
6. Data backup: package your reading data with one tap and save it to cloud drives or other storage locations for extra peace of mind.
7. TXT file editing: edit TXT content directly for easier reading and organization.
8. Multiple import methods: import books via WebDAV, cloud drives, Wi-Fi transfer, iCloud, and more.
9. Auto reading: free your hands and make long reading sessions more comfortable.
10. Personalized layout: customize character spacing, paragraph layout, background images, and text colors to create your own reading style.
11. Eye-friendly reading: supports dark mode, page curl, slide, scrolling, and other reading modes, with Simplified/Traditional Chinese conversion.
12. Privacy protection: supports password, gesture, and Face ID unlock, and allows you to encrypt or hide books to protect your personal reading space.
13. Reading statistics: records reading duration, frequency, progress, and more to help you understand your reading habits.
14. Flexible book management: supports custom groups, title editing, and sorting for a clearer library.
15. Custom covers: customize covers for TXT and other books to make your bookshelf look better.
16. Automatic chapter detection: TXT novels can also be divided into chapters with one tap, improving the long-form reading experience.
17. Multiple font options: use system fonts or import custom fonts.
18. Multiple listening voices: supports system text-to-speech and Alibaba Cloud speech synthesis, with multiple voices to choose from.
-- Pro benefits: After subscribing to Pro, you can use all Pro advanced features during the service period and remove all ads.
-- Monthly subscription (1 month), quarterly subscription (3 months), and yearly subscription (1 year) are auto-renewable subscriptions.
-- The actual product price applies. The purchase price will be charged in your local currency according to the current exchange rate defined by iTunes. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase.
【Monthly, Quarterly, and Yearly Auto-Renewable Subscription Services】
-- If you subscribe to the monthly, quarterly, or yearly auto-renewable service, you authorize Window Reading to charge your iTunes account (the “Account”) for the next billing cycle of the Pro service within 24 hours before the current subscription period expires. If the charge fails due to insufficient account balance, Window Reading reserves the right to suspend or terminate your Pro service without further notice.
-- To cancel an active auto-renewable subscription, go to “Settings” on your iOS device → “iTunes Store & App Store” → select “Apple ID” → tap “View Apple ID” → tap “Subscriptions” on the account settings page → cancel the subscription.
-- Privacy Policy: https://gitee.com/coder_to/luck/blob/master/App/Privacy.md
-- Terms of Service and Auto-Renewal Terms: https://gitee.com/coder_to/luck/blob/master/App/serviceForMembers.md

• Suivez votre consommation en France et à l’étranger :
o En France : consultez vos achats multimédia avec la possibilité de modifier votre plafond d’achat, consultez les tarifs appliqués depuis et vers l’étranger pour votre ligne mobile
o A l’étranger : suivez votre consommation internet, appels et envois SMS/MMS.

MON OFFRE
• Accédez et gérez vos comptes
• Un seul compte pour toute la famille ? C’est possible !
Avec l’application RED & Moi, regroupez l’ensemble de vos lignes et celles de vos proches en toute simplicité.
MES INFOS 
• Accédez facilement à vos informations personnelles
• Un changement d’adresse ? Un nouveau RIB modifiez directement toutes vos informations personnelles dans la rubrique « Mes infos »
AIDE 
• Carte SIM bloquée ? « Dépanner mon mobile » en trouvant vos réponses en cas de perte, vol, désimlockage entre autres.
• Trouvez toutes les réponses à vos questions avec une aide en ligne sur la FAQ 24h/24 et 7j/7 et auprès de vos conseillers clients RED du lundi au vendredi de 8h à 21h.
• Déjà en contact avec notre service client? Consultez vos notifications, votre conseiller RED vous a probablement déjà répondu !
• Suivez toutes les étapes de votre commande mobile et box : de l’enregistrement à la préparation de votre commande, en passant par la livraison de vos équipements, jusqu’à l’activation de vos services et de votre ligne.
Client RED Box ?
• Modifiez en quelques clics un RDV depuis la rubrique « Aide ». Busy, busy ? Un imprévu ? Annulez ou modifiez votre RDV en choisissant un nouveau créneau.
• Une panne, un incident ? « Dépanner ma box » en consultant l’état de votre ligne pour faire un bilan sur le réseau.
• Lancez le diagnostic pour vérifier l’état de votre box et trouver la solution pour la dépanner.
• Accédez directement au suivi de l’incident après l’avoir déclaré avec l’historique des actions en cours ou réalisées.
CENTRE DE NOTIFICATIONS
• Restez informé.e.s de vos actus RED via le centre de notification (nouvelle facture, suivi de commande, etc.)
• Il est accessible directement en haut à droite de votre écran.
*****
Téléchargement et usage gratuit en France métropolitaine (hors coût de connexion internet mobile selon l’offre souscrite). L’application RED & Moi est accessible uniquement aux clients RED by SFR disposant d’un forfait mobile ou d’une offre internet.

bluejetty:00178722:ios.summary: Farm and mine idle tycoon combines the most fun features from idle farm tycoon games and clicker mine simulators. You have a vegetable farm at start. But as you grow more food, build a house, another one, drill for coal and oil, you can cre
bluejetty:00178722:ios.description:
Farm and mine idle tycoon combines the most fun features from idle farm tycoon games and clicker mine simulators. You have a vegetable farm at start. But as you grow more food, build a house, another one, drill for coal and oil, you can create a farming empire and become a millionaire tycoon
Unlike other incremental tycoon games this idle game has 3 main interconnected branches:
Agriculture. Farms grow crops and provide food to grow city population. Some crops (like veggies) can be sold directly at the market, while others will need a longer production chain. For example, wheat in our farm tycoon simulator should be brought to the windmill to produce flour, then the bakery uses flour to bake bread and sell it to the people. Sell more and earn more money to become rich. As you sell food your population grows brining more citizens in your city
Population. Like in city building games you gain more workforce the more inhabitants live in your city. Workforce is a currency to upgrade automation of production. While farms fertility is upgraded by spending money, to hire farm workers you'll need to spend workforce. After than you'll get an idle farm which will work by itself even when you are offline. However, you can always additionally speed-up the production of facilities by pressing on them. Simply tap to build or dig faster
Industry. As your city population grows you'll need to build houses for more people (otherwise population growth would stop). Build houses by expanding your Industry. Initially you mine clay and produce bricks from it. Later on you'll unlock other materials, including reinforced concrete for the skyscrapers, which will need mining iron ore and coal and smelting iron. Industry will also provide additional production chains to produce goods for your population, earn money from it and provide special growth boosts
This idle tycoon game has over 50 facilities which will make you rich: farm, windmill, coal mine, forge, oil well, fishing boat, pumpkin farm, pizzeria, truck
Once you feel that your progression has slowed down, you can restart the game and earn prestige points, just like in a common idle clicker game. What is unique is that you can select, which aspect of your city building should be increased by prestige points: Tap effect, Housing capacity, Population growth, Prices level, Production efficiency, Transport capacity, Inventions speed. Every aspect unlocks new city building strategy with new ways of becoming a millionaire tycoon
Why this incremental game stands out among the other idle clickers:
- No extensive clicking is needed: the game has auto-clicker. No need of tap tap to build - just press on the screen once and the autoclicker will do the construction work for you
- This is the offline game, no wifi is needed to play and develop your farm and mine. You can enjoy your offline money earnings without the internet connection
- No intrusive ads: ads will be shown only if you want it (in the exchange of bonus such as free upgrade or more idle money)
- Idle time is unlimited: return to the game whenever you like and enjoy your idle incomes (just make sure to automate production by hiring workers and making upgrades before leaving the game)
- The game graphics lets you actually see how do different facilities interact, and how do the production chains work. You'll see how workers plough soil and water plants, how trucks transport goods, miners mine for ore, shepherds take care of cows and sheep
- You can select your prestige bonus when restarting the game and redistribute previously assigned prestige points. This lets you try different strategies of growing farm and expanding mine and industry
The game was made by Airapport: award winning indie game development team from Ukraine. Millions of players have installed our games on phones and tablets. You are welcome to share your results and ask questions in our Discord, which has 9500 members now: https://discord.gg/qpDbwpF5un

- No extensive clicking is needed: the game has auto-clicker. No need of tap tap to build - just press on the screen once and the autoclicker will do the construction work for you

- No intrusive ads: ads will be shown only if you want it (in the exchange of bonus such as free upgrade or more idle money)

- The game graphics lets you actually see how do different facilities interact, and how do the production chains work. You'll see how workers plough soil and water plants, how trucks transport goods, miners mine for ore, shepherds take care of cows and sheep

bluejetty:00039831:ios.description:
iCareFone is an incredibly practical data transfer and backup tool that simplifies how you manage your Apple devices. With just a few clicks, you can transfer, organize, and clean up your iPhone, like photos, videos & more effortlessly and fast without iCloud and iTunes.
【Main Functions】
1. File Transfer
- Support batch transfer of photos, videos, files, and 10+ other types between iOS, Pad, and computers—fully cross-platform over LAN.
2. Photo Management
- Quickly categorize and organize photos in your device;
-Compress oversized photos/videos in your device to free up space on your device;
3. Smart Cleanup
- Quickly clean up the space of your device and slim down your device;
4. Photo Screening
- Quickly screen out similar, blurred, oversized, screenshot, etc. photos or videos in your device;
5. Privacy
- Privacy space can provide privacy protection for private photos and files in your device;
6. Other Functions
- New folder, rename, move and delete files/folders;
- Support multiple files for preview;
- Detect the performance of the device, one key to improve the speed of the device;
iCareFone iOS APP member automatic subscription instructions
1. Service name: iCareFone iOS App members automatically subscribe.

3. For accounts with continuous membership, the fee will be automatically deducted from your iTunes account 24 hours before the end of each week/year, and the membership validity period will be extended by 1 week/year.
4. To cancel your subscription, go to iOS "Settings" --> "iTunes and App Store" --> click "Apple ID" --> select "View Apple ID" --> go to the "Account Settings" page --> Click "Subscribe" and choose to cancel iCareFone iOS APP membership. If the subscription is not canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period, it will be automatically renewed.
5. Terms and Conditions:
www.tenorshare.com/tenorshare-app-end-user-license-agreement.html
6. Privacy Policy:
www.tenorshare.com/tenorshare-app-privacy-policy.html
- iCareFone iOS APP members can purchase directly through iTunes account.
- Once a subscription is activated, it is non-refundable.

bluejetty:00068270:ios.description:
Pill Alert is your full time secretary whose sole duty is making sure you take meds on time. 
It supports multiple profiles, so you can use it for both you and your family members. 
Just need to enter the schedules, Pill Alert will remind you takings meds on due time, and you can keep the pill taken logs, email them to yourself or your doctors. 
So you don’t need to always keep in mind that you should take those meds on those different times, it makes you stress relief in daily life. 
Here are the key feathers of this app: 
⁃ Add schedules with frequency, dosage, time, times a day, and date range. 
⁃ Calendar overview to check reminders or pill taken logs. 
⁃ Check upcoming due meds. 
⁃ Mark pill log as taken or skip. 
⁃ Snooze reminder to make it alert later. 
⁃ Turn ON or OFF schedule. 
⁃ 15 free reminder sounds available. 
⁃ Supports sound recording as a reminder.
⁃ Track quantity of each meds and remind when it’s time to refill. 
⁃ Add Taken as Needed meds and check their logs separately with other meds. 
⁃ Add pictures for each med. 
⁃ Check logs by date or by medications. 
⁃ Email pill taken logs by date or by mediations. 
⁃ Email all the pills need to take info. 
⁃ Customize unit, form and route. 
⁃ Support multiple profiles and manager their data separately. 
⁃ Passcode protection. 
⁃ Supports Touch ID as passcode.
⁃ iCloud auto sync between iOS devices. 
⁃ iCloud Backup and Restore.

bluejetty:00131048:ios.description:
Gujarati Calendar 2026 – Your Complete Guide to Festivals, Auspicious Days, and Spiritual Insights!
Discover all the important dates, festivals, and daily astrological details with the Gujarati Calendar 2026 app. This app helps you stay on top of your spiritual practices and cultural celebrations, offering complete information about each day, including Tithi (lunar date), Nakshatra (star), and other important events.
You can easily check today's Tithi, Rashifal (horoscope), and Choghadiya (auspicious times) to plan your day better. It also provides accurate information on sunrise, sunset, moonrise, and much more, all in Gujarati.
Key Features:
Complete Gujarati Calendar: View daily, monthly, and yearly events in the Gujarati Calendar.
Today’s Tithi & Panchang: Check today’s Tithi, Panchang, Nakshatra, Rashi (horoscope), and other important details.
Daily Rashifal: Read today’s horoscope (Rashifal) based on your zodiac sign.
Choghadiya Timings: Find auspicious timings (Choghadiya) for today and the week to perform rituals and activities.
Sunrise & Sunset Times: Know sunrise and sunset timings to plan your day accordingly.
Moonrise Information: Get moonrise timings for today.
Vrat Kathas & Aartis: Read religious stories (Vrat Kathas) and recite Aartis (devotional songs) of popular hindu gods like Hanuman, Shiva, Ganesha.
Banking Holidays: Check bank holidays and see if the banks are open or closed.
Festivals & Holidays: Discover information about Ekadashi, Panchak, and other important festivals.
Gujarati News: Stay updated with daily Gujarati news—from city, state, business, sports, to astrology.
Offline Access: Enjoy offline access to all features, even without an internet connection.
Ad-Free Experience: Use the app with minimal ads for a smooth experience.
Light and Dark Modes: Switch between light and dark modes to suit your preference.
Complete Month View: View a complete month-wise calendar to easily plan your events and festivals.
Bank Holidays List: Get a list of bank holidays for better financial planning.
Whether you're looking for spiritual guidance, festival dates, or daily astrological information, the Gujarati Calendar 2026 app is your go-to tool. It's designed to make your daily life easier and more informed in the most convenient way.
Download now and experience the perfect blend of tradition and modern convenience.

You awake in a cold, damp morgue reeking of death and with no recollection of who you are, where you are, or why you're here. As you solve puzzles across an increasingly disturbing world, abundant yet disjointed clues will offer insights into those seemingly simple questions. 
Will you Remember?
This horrifying new room escape experience from inDgenious is intended for adult audiences! Immerse yourself in our handcrafted world through our eerily beautiful 3D environments, formidable puzzles, intriguing story, and our expertly-crafted auditory experience! Objectives range from routine hidden object / item finds to interactive puzzles that will challenge you both in mind and manual dexterity. 
* This is the FULL version of the game. You get absolutely everything unlocked upfront with NO ads or In App Purchases! *
What are you waiting for? It's OK to be scared.
FEATURES:
+ An intense Horror Room Escape adventure intended for mature audiences!
+ 100+ challenging and interactive puzzles!
+ Intriguing story wrapped in eerily beautiful 3D environments!
+ Expertly crafted sound effects and music!
+ Built-in hint system so you never get stuck! 
+ All hints and objectives available in FULL version, LITE version requires unlocking with reward videos or a one-time in app purchase.
IMPORTANT NOTE: This is our biggest game yet and has a huge amount of high quality, pre-rendered graphics. An additional ~100MB of FREE downloadable content is required to play the entire game.
DETAILS:
See this game and more at: https://www.indgenious.com/

bluejetty:00058327:android.description:
🔥 ISO 2 USB— ISO Burner for Android
Burn full operating system images directly to USB—no PC required.
ISO 2 USB is a standalone ISO burning utility built for Android. Whether you're preparing a bootable Windows installer or flashing a Raspberry Pi image, ISO 2 USB gives you full control over partition schemes, file systems, and image handling. Designed for speed, precision, and manual configuration.
🧨 Core Features
Supported Image Types
• Burn ISO, DMG, and IMG files directly to USB
• Compatible with:
– Windows 7, 8, 8.1, 10, 11
– FreeDOS / MS-DOS
– Non-bootable formats
– Modern GNU/Linux distributions released after 2010 (e.g., Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, Arch, etc.)
– macOS DMG (Intel-based only)
– Raspberry Pi OS and other ARM-based images
Windows ISO Handling
• Manual selection of partition scheme and file system
– GPT (UEFI) or MBR (Legacy BIOS)
– NTFS or FAT32
• Bypass Windows 11 minimum requirements
• Automated Windows setup customization (Win10/11)
• Split large install.wim files for FAT32 compatibility
• Compatible with official Microsoft ISOs—no modification needed
Other Image Types
• Linux, macOS DMG, and Raspberry Pi images are written as raw blocks
– No customization or partition changes
– Preserves original layout and boot structure
USB Compatibility
• Works with USB flash drives, SD card adapters, external SSDs, and HDDs
• OTG support required
• Root access only needed for internal SD slot
💰 Coin Usage
Coins are used for advanced image types and formats. You can earn coins by watching rewarded ads or buy them directly.
Coin-required actions:
• Burn Windows ISO → 2 coins
• FreeDOS / MS-DOS → 1 coin
• Non-bootable formats → 1 coin for FAT32, 2 coins for others
Free actions:
• Burn Linux ISOs, Raspberry Pi images, and macOS DMG
• Write raw blocks without customization
• Use all manual configuration tools for supported formats
📢 Ad-Supported Experience
ISO 2 USB includes banner ads and rewarded video ads to keep core features free.
Upgrade to Pro to:
• Remove all ads
• Unlock unlimited access
• Disable the coin system
• Use offline or with ad blockers
⚠️ Technical Notes
• Internet required unless using Pro
• Disable ad blockers unless using Pro
• Keep the app in the foreground during USB operations
Download ISO 2 USB now and burn smarter—right from your Android device.

bluejetty:00043636:ios.name: ClickClack - Typing Trainer
bluejetty:00043636:ios.summary:
Improve your typing speed, accuracy, and technique with a powerful typing test and trainer built around a clean, distraction-free experience. Upgrade to Pro for extra challenges, stats, themes and unlimited custom text.
Key Features:
Typi
bluejetty:00043636:ios.description:
Improve your typing speed, accuracy, and technique with a powerful typing test and trainer built around a clean, distraction-free experience. Upgrade to Pro for extra challenges, stats, themes and unlimited custom text.
Key Features:
Typing Speed Test:
• Timer-Based Session.
• Word Count-Based Session.
Lessons Practice Mode:
• Structured Learning: Improve your typing with guided lessons covering the home, top, bottom, symbol, and number keys.
• Progress Tracking: Monitor accuracy, WPM, and high scores for each lesson.
N-Gram Word Focus Lab:
• Precision Training: Build fluid muscle memory by focusing on "sticky" character sequences (N-Grams) that cause frequent mistakes.
• Intelligent Drill Logic: Use Targeted (PRO), Smart Mix (PRO), or Expansion strategies to eliminate accuracy gaps and master challenging patterns.
On-Device AI Text Generator & Typing Insights (Requires iOS 26 & Apple Intelligence Enabled)
• Infinite Content: Instantly generate unique practice passages from various topics and supported languages.
• Typing Insights: Receive on-device AI analysis of speed, with deeper accuracy and consistency insights in Pro.
• Privacy First: All AI generation and analysis run locally on-device with zero data collection.
Detailed Typing Analytics:
• Performance Metrics: Calculates WPM (Net & Gross), Accuracy, and Consistency.
• Error Tracking: Tracks correct, incorrect, and missed characters.
• Level Progression: Earn XP from each typing session and unlock new levels.
• WPM Graph: Track your progress across sessions.
• Mistyped Keys & N-Gram Analysis: View key-error heatmaps and missing bigram/trigram patterns to target weaknesses.
• Key Latency & Bottlenecks: Measure delays across keys, bigrams, and trigrams to pinpoint hesitation patterns.
Typing Replays & Ghost Practice:
• Live Playback: Replay typing sessions as they happened.
• Free Replay Library: Save favorite sessions.
• Replay Sharing: Export and share replay files—free for everyone.
• Ghost Practice: Type alongside past runs in timed or word mode.
• Versus Races: Race CPUs or compatible recordings in Ghost Race.
• Track Improvement: Beat a replay, then save or replace your attempt.
• Ghost Customization: Change or hide your ghost cursor.
• Free Practice & Racing: Replays up to 45 seconds or 75 words. Pro removes both limits.
• Import Replays: Import recordings to watch, practice, or race when compatible.
Multiplayer Mode:
• Real-Time Matches: Compete in 60-second English typing challenges with 2–4 players.
• Play With Anyone: Invite friends or use automatch to find opponents worldwide.
• Game Center Integration: Earn achievements and climb multiplayer leaderboards.
VS CPU Mode:
• Race Simulated Opponents: Race multiple AI opponents with adjustable difficulty. Choose how many CPUs to face, set individual speeds, or use Smart Difficulty based on your recent performance.
Custom Typing Text:
• Personalized Practice: Create and manage your own typing texts using quotes, song lyrics, or any text. Import directly from a webpage URL.
Customizable Style:
• Typography: Choose your font, size, line spacing, letter spacing, line break mode, and text alignment.
• Themes: Choose from gorgeous color profiles, including animated liquid gradients (iOS 26), to match your mood and focus.
Keyboard & Hand Guide Overlay:
• Activate the Keymap Overlay to visualize keystrokes and next key targets in real time.
• Enable the Hand Guide to see correct finger placement — perfect for mastering 10-finger typing.
Typing Sound Effects:
• Enjoy satisfying keyboard sounds including mechanical switches, typewriters, or your own sound packs.
iCloud Sync:
• Sync your typing stats across iPhone, iPad, and macOS.
Rated for ages 13+ by the Indonesia Game Rating System (IGRS)

Maybe the most feature-rich and challenging implementation of the classic Boxes and Dots simple game on Google Play.

Also the application is very lightweight with the apk size not exceeding the 4MB.
Features:
1) Play against friends or against computer. 
2) Clever Artificial Intelligence which anticipates future moves.

6) Quick match. No irritating menus just hit the launch icon and you are inside the action.

bluejetty:00131262:ios.name: Infinity 8 Ball™
bluejetty:00131262:ios.summary: Tired of boring games full of cheating and unappealing rules? We would like to say to world players of the 8-ball game: Thank you for your patience! Infinity 8 Ball™ is now officially available online. It will offer all 8-ball, 9-ball, and
bluejetty:00131262:ios.description:
Tired of boring games full of cheating and unappealing rules? We would like to say to world players of the 8-ball game: Thank you for your patience! Infinity 8 Ball™ is now officially available online. It will offer all 8-ball, 9-ball, and snooker players a refreshingly different experience. 
With Infinity 8 Ball™ you will experience:
Easier aiming, and more pot chances on your phone
No more shooting against a ruler. With Infinity 8 Ball™, the target line is longer, the angle is easier to adjust and the power control is more precise. Even a beginner can give amazing shots. All you have to do is have fun. 
A true physical experience with authentic shots
We have gone to great lengths to simulate the experience of hitting a real billiard ball so that the force, direction, collision, spin and lighting are precisely the same as in the physical world. Parameters from the coefficient of friction of the tablecloth to the feedback from the collisions between the balls and the table, to the cue itself have all gone through numerous iterations.
The gear must be constantly upgraded, even for an excellent player
The more powerful the gear, the better you will be able to win a competition. You can keep earning coins and chests as you play to keep upgrading your cue and props, allowing you to enjoy playing 8-ball in many different scenarios with different rules.
A more exciting Challenge mode in addition to the regular games
Special-shaped tables, special scoring rules, one-shot challenges, special events... Join the 24/7 exciting challenge with updates from time to time. You will be ranked in the rankings of global players and have the chance to win exclusive prizes. What is your global ranking in your expert Challenge mode?
24-hour global PvPs
Well-matched players can greatly improve your skills. We have introduced the matching algorithm, which selects the best match from global online players, to help you progress in competitions. 
You are welcome to follow us on https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100075883630039

Become a pastry chef and create sweet donuts or bake a birthday cake for a friend.

- Cocobi Farm: Grow crops and take care of lots of cute animals.

In addition to our Cocobi apps, you can download and play other popular games such as Pororo, Tayo, and Robocar Poli. 
■ Welcome to the Cocobi universe, where dinosaurs never became extinct! Cocobi is the fun compound name for brave Coco and cute Lobi! Play with the little dinosaurs and experience the world with various jobs, duties, and places.

Swimtopia Mobile helps keep team members and meet spectators better informed. Members of teams
bluejetty:00073951:ios.description:
Stay in touch with your Swimtopia team and receive live meet results from meets run using Meet Maestro with our companion app, Swimtopia Mobile.
Swimtopia Mobile helps keep team members and meet spectators better informed. Members of teams using Swimtopia can receive notifications from their team and view their team and swimmer info for free, all season long. The Live Event/Heat Indicator** broadcasts what’s happening in the pool during meets in real time, so no one ever needs to miss a swim again! When meets are run in Meet Maestro, Swimtopia Mobile provides all the info spectators need to stay up-to-date on meet days when they have a Pro subscription.
== Free Features for Swimtopia Team Members ==
* Push notification alerts from your team
* Personalized view of upcoming meets and events
* Personalized Meet Overview for your family (including swim events and volunteer jobs)
* Sign up for swim meets and jobs
* Your swimmers’ best times
* Your swimmers’ swim history
* Post-meet results for your family’s swimmers
== Free Features for Guests & Swimtopia Team Members ==
* Public Meet Search*
* Live Event/Heat Indicator**
Add a Pro subscription to enhance your meet day experience. Access live results, scores, and heat sheets. View up-to-date estimated start times and receive reminders before each of your favorite athletes’ events.
IMPORTANT NOTE: Pro features require the meet host to use Meet Maestro software.
== Pro Features for Meets Run in Meet Maestro == **Free 7 Day Trial**
* Heat sheets*
* Heat/lane assignments and estimated start times for each of your favorite athletes’ events*
* Estimated start times for all events that update as the meet progresses*
* Upcoming swim reminder alerts for favorited swimmers*
* Results notification alerts for favorited swimmers*
* Live results for all swimmers*
* Team scores*
== Pro Subscription Details ==
* When you upgrade to a Pro subscription, the fee for the first subscription period will be charged to your iTunes account at the end of the 7-day free trial.
* Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
* You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
* Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
* See our Terms of Service: https://www.swimtopia.com/terms-of-service/
* See our Privacy Policy: https://www.swimtopia.com/privacy/
* For more information see: https://www.swimtopia.com/products/swim-meet-app/
---
* These features require the swim meet to be run using Meet Maestro software.
** Your team can access the Swimtopia Live Event/Heat Indicator in the mobile app when your team admins perform a few simple steps. For team admin instructions on using the Live Event/Heat Indicator see: https://www.swimtopia.com/swimtopia-live

bluejetty:00008624:android.name: Warhammer Horus Heresy Legions
bluejetty:00008624:android.summary: Choose your Legion, build your deck and fight to become a legendary Warmaster! Collect your favourite characters from The Horus Heresy, a key setting of the Warhammer 40,000 universe, and fight in fast and brutal matches. An epic card game
bluejetty:00008624:android.description:
Choose your Legion, build your deck and fight to become a legendary Warmaster! Collect your favourite characters from The Horus Heresy, a key setting of the Warhammer 40,000 universe, and fight in fast and brutal matches. An epic card game (TCG / CCG) with a growing collection of over 1000 cards!
Create a warrior lodge with your friends, discuss deck building, tactics and strategy, and fight in PvP card battles. Choose a side in faction-based card wars that determine which new cards are added to the game. The fate of the Galaxy is in your hands – become a legend!
THE HORUS HERESY CARD WARS: Discover The Horus Heresy, one of the richest settings in the Warhammer 40,000 universe by Games Workshop, for the first time as an online TCG / CCG card game. The legendary forces of Ultramarines, Space Wolves and Blood Angels fight against the traitor Legions of the Warmaster. Hordes of Daemons, once dismissed as mere tales and legends, come forth and slay billions of innocent lives. Play an epic solo campaign, ranked PvP, multiplayer card wars and PvE raids based on battles, stories and legends from the Black Library novels about the Warhammer 40,000 universe.
CARD COMBAT AND DECK BUILDING: Join epic card wars as new Legions from the Warhammer 40,000 lore are added. Play as the Ultramarines, Space Wolves, Blood Angels and many other legendary Warhammer 40,000 factions, each featuring distinct card combat styles and unique abilities to slay their enemies. The card wars and deck building challenges keep growing as new cards are released!
TRUE CARD COMBAT SKILL: Battle in ranked or friendly PvP card wars to prove your card combat and deck building skills. Master the Sealed Deck format, where only tactics and skill determine the outcome of your card combat. Build your best deck and slay the enemy troops before they slay yours. Become a legend!
GUILD WARS: Coordinate with your warrior lodge in epic PvP Arena card battles that determine the evolution of this TCG / CCG strategy card game. Show your knowledge of TCG / CCG games and deck building tips, and try your deck in friendly card duels. Battle other guilds and grow your card collection. Create your own legends!
The Horus Heresy, the legendary background of Warhammer 40,000, now as an online strategy card game (TCG / CCG).
The Horus Heresy: Legions © Copyright Games Workshop Limited 2020. The Horus

bluejetty:00157180:ios.description:
hbd is the app for celebrations! It's the best way to remember and celebrate birthdays.
Stay Notified:
hbd sends you birthday reminder notifications so you'll never have to use the word "belated" again.
Add our widgets to keep track of upcoming birthdays right from your home screen.
Send Cards:
When the day comes, send your friend a thoughtful card with hbd — choose from dozens of original designs and personalize your card with photos, text, and drawings. Send it instantly; your recipient doesn't need to have hbd installed.
Add Birthdays:
hbd makes it super easy to add new birthdays or import them from other services. Add via:
• Contacts
• Facebook birthdays
• Calendar events
• Collect birthdays via a link
• Enter info manually
• File import
If one of your contacts uses hbd too, their birthday is automatically shared with you, so no need to memorize the birthdays of every person you add.
Other Fun Stuff:
• Widgets for your home screen
• Save your cards forever. Any card you receive will be saved to your collection, which you can look back at at any time.
• Sync across devices — one account, access from any Apple device
hbd Pro
If you're looking for more features and customization, you can upgrade to hbd pro:
• Add unlimited birthdays, up from the free limit of 50
• Send unlimited cards, and access exclusive card designs
• Sync birthdays to your calendar
• Customize reminders for one day or one week in advance, get text reminders
• All widget styles — track birthdays on your home screen
• 7 secret hbd app icons
Subscriptions renew automatically and can be canceled anytime up to 24 hours before renewal.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

• Easy to access past programs.
• The South Carolina ETV App displays the web page associated with the program or program segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The South Carolina ETV App is brought to you by the people at SCETV and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.

bluejetty:00128964:ios.description:
Dominate your fantasy baseball draft on iPhone and iPad!
Draft Wizard® is a suite of tools to help you draft like an expert and win your leagues.
Created by FantasyPros, the #1 fantasy sports advice provider in the world, and powered by award-winning draft technology, this is the only app that will give you expert advice for every single pick and assist you during your real live draft.
What do you get with Draft Wizard?
*Mock Draft Simulator™*
Fast and realistic snake and auction mock draft simulations to practice for your real fantasy baseball draft.
*Live Mock Drafts*
Mock draft against real LIVE opponents on-the-go, using settings from your league host.
*Expert Advice*
See who the experts would draft for every single pick to help you make the best decision.
*Cheat Sheets*
Built in cheat sheets based on our ECR (Expert Consensus Rankings) and ADP (Average Draft Position). 
*Draft Analyzer*
See how you performed after each draft to identify your strengths and weaknesses.
*Draft Assistant (Live Sync)* (MVP/HOF users only)
Sync with your live draft to get expert advice on who to pick for each round, while your draft unfolds in real-time. Drafted players will be automatically tracked for you. 
*Draft Assistant (Manual)* (PRO/MVP/HOF users only)
Enter draft pick selections from your real draft to get expert advice on who to pick for your team.
Assistant Notes:
1. Both the Manual and Live Draft Assistant features support the following league hosts: Yahoo, RT Sports, Fantrax, NFBC, and CBS Leagues. 
2. ESPN leagues can be imported into the app, but only the Manual Draft Assistant is supported. Use our Chrome extension on web for ESPN live sync support.
3. Auction Draft Assistant is not available in the app.
4. Our app will not make the draft picks for you, selections must be made in your host's draft room interface.
*Draft History*
Review past draft grades to fine-tune your draft strategy. Pause or save an unfinished mock draft to pick up where you left off later.
*Auto-Pick*
Let our algorithm make the picks for you so you can sit back, relax, and analyze the draft results.
*Custom Draft Configuration*
Configure your own league settings, select the number of teams, players, positions, and scoring system.
*Import League Settings*
Simulate your real draft by importing league settings from your favorite league host.
*Keeper League Support* (MVP/HOF users only)
Track your league's keepers for each team so you can mock draft with settings that are close to your real thing.
*iPad Split View Support*
Use Slide Over or Split View multitasking on iPad to use Draft Wizard alongside your league draft.
---

bluejetty:00162245:ios.description:
2018'den beri en beğenilen ezan vakti uygulamalarından biri!
Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı ile %100 uyumlu vakitlerle namazınızı eda edin; 2027 Ramazan İmsakiyesi ile iftar ve sahurunuzu güvenle takip edin. Türkiye'den Almanya'ya, Hollanda'dan ABD'ye 148 ülkede en hassas vakitler şimdi cebinizde.
İmsak, iftar ve sahur vakitlerini Diyanet hesaplamalarına uygun olarak 148 ülkede ve 2200'den fazla şehirde takip edebilirsiniz. İnternet bağlantısı gerektirmeden 30 günlük namaz vakitlerini görebilirsiniz.
Öne Çıkan Özellikler:
-> Namaz ve Ezan:
• Diyanet uyumlu tam vakitler
• Ezan Alarmı ve namaz öncesi hatırlatıcı
• Kerahat vakti uyarısı
• Bir sonraki vakte kalan süre gösterimi
-> Ramazan Özel:
• 2027 Ramazan İmsakiyesi
• İftar ve sahur vakitleri (İftara ne kadar kaldı?)
• Günlük Ramazan duaları ve mukabele takibi
• Ramazan-ı Şerif'e özel içerikler
-> İslami İçerik ve Araçlar:
• Kur'an-ı Kerim (Ayet, Meal ve Hızlı Arama)
• Liste veya mushaf görünümü
• Kıble Yönü Pusulası (Kabe Açısı Hesaplama)
• Kıble Saati
• Zikirmatik ve Esmaü'l Hüsna
• Kaza Takibi (Namaz ve Oruç)
• Resimli Cuma ve Dini Gün Mesajları
• Hadis Listesi ve Hadis Arama özelliği
• Cuma hutbeleri (Diyanet, DITIB ve fazlası)
-> Kullanım Kolaylığı:
• Kilit Ekran ve Ana Ekran Widget (Araç Takımı) desteği
• Apple Watch akıllı saat uyumu
• 20'den fazla farklı ezan ve uyarı sesi
• Otomatik konum güncelleme
• Sade arayüz, internetsiz kullanım
Desteklenen şehirlerimizden bazıları: İstanbul, Ankara, İzmir, Hamburg, Konya, Adana, Bursa, Diyarbakır, Gaziantep, Cologne, Stuttgart, Antalya, Frankfurt, Rotterdam, Berlin, Munich, Paris, Vienna, London, Amsterdam, Brussels ve dünya genelinde 2200+ konum.

IslamiQ çatısı altında sunduğumuz modern teknoloji ve ezanvaktinamazvakitleri.com güvencesiyle ibadetlerinizi kolaylaştırın.

bluejetty:00041043:ios.description:
Simple Calisthenics offers the most personalized and customizable calisthenics workout programs. Whether you want to build Muscle, Gain Strength, achieve impressive Calisthenics Skills, improve your Mobility, or other goals, Simple Calisthenics has you covered! Suitable for all levels and continuously adapting the program to progress together with you!
PERSONALISED WORKOUT PROGRAMS
-> Based on your current level, whether you are a total beginner or an advanced athlete
-> Optimized to achieve your goals, such as gaining strength, building muscle, or learning calisthenics skills such as Handstand, Muscle Up, Front Lever, Planche, and many more
-> Tailored to your personal schedule: Define how often and when you want to work out
-> Using your available equipment: Train with weights, in a gym, at home or while traveling
-> Highly customizable: you can edit each workout in detail to fit your exact preferences

-> Audio- and Video Instructions: focus on your workout while always knowing what to do

-> Record your Workouts and Exercises to analyze your form and correct mistakes without switching apps.

-> Exercise Library with over 1.000 exercises: a large database of Calisthenics Exercises with progressions for all levels
-> Detailed Exercise Guides about execution, tips, and common mistakes for all Calisthenics exercises, and progressions.
-> Basic Lectures: learn about important topics such as Nutrition, Regeneration, Rep Ranges, Intensity, and more
STATISTICS ABOUT YOUR TRAINING
-> Analyze your progress using detailed statistics from your workouts
-> Track your improvements in Repetitions and Weights over time with charts that plot your progress
-> Save logs of every single Workout to jump back in time and see how your workouts have changed
-> View previous Workout Recordings to learn how your execution of exercises has improved and where you can still improve on
-> Learn about your records in repetition and weights for every exercise or your average values
WORKOUT BUILDER
-> Create your own workouts exactly to your preferences in minor detail
-> Edit existing workouts to fit your preferences
-> Select exercises from a large database or create your own exercises
Start your Calisthenics Journey now or bring your current training to a whole new level!

bluejetty:00127324:ios.description:
Hinfo is the digital compendium designed for guests staying at a member property.
Access all property information, services and local area details instantly, anytime, anywhere.
Get started in three simple steps:
1. Check into a property that uses the Hinfo service.
2. Download the free Hinfo app.
3. If the property you are staying at does not automatically load, please search for the property via the 'Current Location' or 'Search via Name' button.
Hinfo is a useful directory during your stay:
Property Details: View details on the property itself, including but not limited to check in/out times, parking, Wi-Fi details, how to use various appliances etc.
Near Me: Discover what there is to do nearby including restaurants, supermarkets, local attractions and more.
Local Services: Have immediate access to local doctor details and more including phone numbers and directions there.
Be sure to keep Hinfo installed on your device after you depart the property, so all you need to do at the next property you stay at, is search for the next property you are staying at, to access their information.
Hinfo is available in English, Chinese (Traditional and Simplified), Japanese, Malay, Hindi, Spanish, French, Korean, German, Portuguese (Brazil), Italian, Dutch, Swedish, Indonesian, Māori, Thai, Filipino and Vietnamese which is subject to details supplied by each property.
We strongly advise that you should not download the Hinfo app on your iPhone or iPad, from any 3rd party website with all downloads and updates coming from the Apple App Store directly.
For full details on our 'App Privacy' section below, please visit the privacy section on our website for more details.

bluejetty:00088149:ios.description:
Are you ready for the craziest safari ever? Then Animal Master: Hardcore Safari is for you. Summon your animals and begin a hunt after the cruel poachers, who come to disturb peace in the animal kingdom. Defeat the invaders in an animal fighting game and show who is the real king of the jungle. Let the animal evolution begin!
MERGE ANIMALS
The stronger is your mutant animal army, the faster you’ll devastate the enemies. Freak out in the super power game and let your imagination run riot. Merge animals with different DNA’ s to strengthen your mutant squad. Summon units from different orders: birds, mammals, fish, etc. Birds never work alone, they’ll attack the poachers in a team pecking them with a beak. Lions and bears can frighten anybody with their loud roar. Elephants and rhinos will destroy everything on their path. Choose the strongest units from the animal collection in mutant lab and you will succeed in Animal Master: Hardcore Safari.
LOCATIONS & NATURAL ELEMENTS
In Animal Master: Hardcore Safari you can fight in different locations. Irresistible jungle, quicksand deserts or blue waters of the ocean? Your animals will fight wherever you want. 
POWER BOOST MODE
There is a special game mode in Animal Master: Hardcore Safari. Activate it and the golden power will come to mutant animals. Whoever appears on a mutant animal's path, they better look out.
Why you will love Animal Master: Hardcore Safari:
- Supercool animation
- Many difficult tasks
- Action-packed gameplay
- Beautiful 3D graphics
- Online & offline game modes
- Intuitive controls
- Simple interface
So, why are you still here? Let's begin the crazy safari. Download Animal Master: Hardcore Safari and enjoy an animal game.

bluejetty:00129693:ios.description:
Welcome to Adventure Island Merge, the perfect combination of merge challenge and island adventure! Embark on an epic adventure, the moment you get on the island the adventure begins. The road ahead is blocked with weeds and branches, remove these obstacles to find a small house in front of you, clean it up and stay here for the night! Go out and find food and water and some essential supplies . You may also find treasure behind the bushes! Roll up your sleeves, pack your bags, and come uncover the mysteries of the island, immerse yourself in a fantastic adventure, and complete an amazing adventure on this island!
Features：
- Merge Challenge: Drag and drop identical items together to merge them, complete missions to unlock new items and tool rewards, and open up new lands to advance your journey! 
- Fantastic Adventure: Traverse this magical island with new friends and explore the mysteries of the island, there is always something new to discover.  
- Plenty of plot: Every area of the island is full of mystery, surprises and fun, with interesting characters and animals to take you on a journey to discover the island's untold secrets! 
 - Plenty of rewards: As you explore this wonderful island, you'll gain access to treasure chests, mined deposits and lots of new living resources.
- Easy to learn: Anyone can master this simple game, and we have a very detailed guided process.
- Experience relaxation: Despite having an amazing number of item combinations and hundreds of challenging puzzles, enjoy the pleasant atmosphere and this island will keep you entertained.  
We will continue to update and continue the storyline, and introduce new characters, missions and challenge mechanics. Please believe that Adventure Island Merge will give you an island adventure like no other! The adventure is about to begin, so pack your bags, download now, and explore the mysterious world of Adventure Island Merge with me!

SCAN AND SOLVE
Snap a photo of your question and get answers in a second with step-by-step explanations.
WRITE EFFORTLESSLY
Say goodbye to the writing struggles and hello to a world of effortless creativity. SANTA AI
Experience the joy of learning with Santa AI, your personal AI chatbot. Ask questions, engage in interactive conversations, and get assistance tailored to your needs. Santa AI makes learning fun and effective.
WEB SEARCH
Find the most relevant and accurate information instantly. With built-in web search, Nerd AI ensures you have access to the answers and resources you need to excel in your studies.

Save time and grasp the key points of any YouTube video in seconds. Nerd AI extracts and presents concise summaries so you can stay informed without watching the entire video.

Too busy to read? Let Nerd AI convert audio to text for you. Simply upload or record any audio, and Nerd AI will transcribe it into clear, readable text. Perfect for those who prefer reading over listening, or need to capture details from audio content quickly and efficiently.

TRIVIA QUEST
Knowledge is power, and Nerd AI loves to challenge your intellect! Engage in stimulating trivia quests covering a wide range of topics.

bluejetty:00177199:ios.summary:

How to Play: 
- Game modes: 2 players (1
bluejetty:00177199:ios.description:
The classic board game comes to your iPhone/iPad now! 
Known to others as "Sequence", "One Eyed Jack", "Jack Foolery", "Wild Jacks" or "Crazy Jacks". Try to make sequences of five with your cards. 
How to Play: 
- Game modes: 2 players (1v1) and 3 players (1v1v1).
- Each player selects one from six cards in hands and places a chip on the matching card on the game board.
- Two Eyed Jacks (Clubs/Diamonds) can be placed anywhere on the board
- One Eyed Jacks (Spades/Hearts) can remove any of your opponent's chips unless that chip is already a part of a sequence.
- The 4 corners are wild and belong to all players and can be used as a chip in a sequence.
- The goal is to create a sequence of 5 chips either horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. One sequence is required for 2 players, while two sequences for 3 players.
Features:
- HD Graphics / sound effects
- Smooth animation
- Online mode / Practise mode
- Automatically match opponents
- 2 or 3 players supported
- Hints
You can play online with your friends now!
1. Click the "With Friends" button in the title screen to play in friend mode.
2. Input a room password and your name, and then click "Join Room".
3. Share the password to your friends.
4. Your friend enters the the same password to join in your room.
5. Start to play!
Both modes of 2 players (1v1) and 3 players (1v1v1) are supported. Enjoy!

Goat Simulator 3 Mobile gives you the same open world to explore and destroy as the PC and console versions of the game. Headbutt civilians, drive without a license, or join a yoga class! It’s just like in real life.
You can invite a friend in multiplayer mode, cause mayhem together, or become enemies while playing any of the seven mini-games.
If you don’t have a friend, you could get the game on two devices and just pretend. We won’t tell a soul.
The giant sandbox island of San Angora is in the palm of your hoof!
KEY FEATURES:
– Goats! Tall goats, fishy goats, goats with hats, there's a goat for your every need
– An open world to explore, with an ‘ok amount’ of quests, challenges, and secrets to uncover
– Bring chaos together with a friend in multiplayer mode
– Break off that friendship for good with seven different mini-games
– Dress up your goat in a wide range of different gears to unleash its true powers
– Ragdoll physics that slap Newton in the face
Minimum device requirements: iOS 16 or newer and 4GB of RAM

bluejetty:00069507:ios.description:
Experience RECOIL on the iPad
This app gives you the ability to purchase individual RECOIL’s iPad editions or subscribe annually. 
RECOIL is a new firearms lifestyle publication dedicated to the modern shooting enthusiast. Every issue will feature the latest guns, gear, accessories, technology, plus reviews and buyer’s guides. The gear and accessories RECOIL will cover goes beyond the typical products seen in other firearm magazines, everything from watches and survival equipment to vehicles that appeal to the modern shooter’s lifestyle will be covered. RECOIL will also include interviews of industry leading manufacturers and top competitive marksmen, so readers will be able to have a glimpse inside their world and find out what drives them.
---SUBSCRIPTION AVAILABLE--- 
**1-year subscription for $19.99 
**1-month subscription for $1.99 
Your subscription will be billed to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew until cancelled.
---SUBSCRIPTION WILL AUTO-RENEW--- 
The subscription will include the current issue if you do not already own it and subsequently published future issues. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. This Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period, your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. The cost of the renewal will match the initial subscription price.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
You may turn off auto-renewing subscriptions by going to your user’s Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during your active subscription period.
You can view our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use here: 
https://www.recoilweb.com/privacy
https://www.recoilweb.com/terms

bluejetty:00155328:ios.description:
Your story lives in the Illinois Quad-Cities. From reporting on all of your favorite teams to the news that matters most, we cover it all. Get in-depth stories from the region and beyond – including news, sports, opinion, obituaries, entertainment, and politics.
Easily access the very latest news in an app built for you. Read, see, and hear exclusive commentary, stunning photography, video updates, and binge-worthy podcasts. 
Plus, subscribers have the ability to upgrade to News+, our premium ad-free experience! That means faster-loading pages and an uninterrupted reading experience. 
Our app features:
* Your Stories – personalize your experience by selecting the local news topics that matter most to you
* Get notified – stay in the loop by selecting alerts for news, sports, weather, and more
* Easy navigation – see all the latest local stories by simply swiping up/down, and left/right.
* Read stories your way – either in the News Feed or via the E-edition
* Breaking news updates – top banners let you know what’s happening right now
* Follow author – get notifications whenever your favorite writers post a story
* Bookmark for later – save stories to enjoy at your leisure
* Listen to articles – press the play button to listen instead
* Customize your text size – make the content bigger or smaller in your profile settings
* Weather where you are – hourly, 10-day forecasts, and frequent video updates
Free to download. Subscribers enjoy unlimited access.
https://qctimes.com/terms

bluejetty:00064393:ios.description:
Color a flower garden, one number at a time.
Wonder Color is a relaxing color by number coloring book for adults. Pick a picture, tap the numbered areas, and watch roses, songbirds, butterflies and snowy Christmas scenes come to life. No drawing skill needed: if you can tap, you can paint.
CHRISTMAS IS HERE
880+ Christmas and holiday pictures to color this season: Santa, snowmen, Christmas trees and cozy winter scenes.
FLOWERS, BIRDS AND EVERYTHING THAT GROWS
• 640+ flower pictures: roses, sunflowers, tulips, lilies, orchids and bouquets
• 530+ bird pictures: cardinals, robins, owls, peacocks and hummingbirds
• 460+ butterfly pictures, from monarchs to tropical wings
• 540+ nature pictures: gardens, forests, mountains and all four seasons
COLOR BY NUMBER, MADE SIMPLE
Every area has a number. Tap a color at the bottom, then tap the matching areas. That is the whole game. No timers, no scores, no wrong moves.
EASY ON THE EYES
Large, clear numbers. One-tap controls and no tiny buttons. Zoom in with two fingers to color the smallest petal comfortably. Press and hold any spot to pick its color, and let a hint circle the tiny areas you missed.
30+ MORE COLLECTIONS
Animals, mandalas, famous paintings, mosaic, marine life, hearts, unicorns, places, fashion, food, tattoo art, pixel art and more. Over 12,000 pictures in all, with new ones every day.
MORE TO ENJOY
• Rare pictures: real painted artwork appears as you color
• Stories: color illustrated stories, chapter by chapter
• A free daily gift, a 7-day coloring streak and achievements that reward hints
• Collections that track your progress and reward you when complete
• Replay any finished picture as a time-lapse video and share it
COLOR ANYWHERE
Progress saves by itself. Once a picture has loaded, you can keep coloring it without an internet connection: on a plane, in the garden, anywhere.
WONDER COLOR PREMIUM
Wonder Color is free to play with ads. Premium removes all ads, gives unlimited hints and magic, and unlocks every Rare picture. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan may include a free trial), or a one-time Forever purchase.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends.
• A free trial, if offered, turns into a paid subscription when it ends unless cancelled before.
• Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/tig-studio-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00093568:ios.description:
Predictive triathlon coaching and training sessions are delivered daily to your personal training calendar. No more generic training PDFs, static downloads, or plans that burn you out.
AltaBrio's coaching software is based on your needs, skills, recovery, races, and energy. Each session adjusts to empower you to meet your training and racing goals.
PERSONALIZED TRAINING
Advanced PT (Predictive Training) based on your needs, skills, recovery, races, and energy. Each session adjusts moment by moment to empower you to meet your goals.
IN-DEPTH VIDEO INSTRUCTION
There are many skills, tips, and tricks when it comes to triathlons. We teach you all the pro tips for learning triathlons from the ground up.
ANALYTICS THAT EMPOWER
You are complex. Your data proves that. Measuring, analyzing, and adjusting each session based on your data is what you need to be successful.
ALTABRIO AI SOFTWARE
Syncing and updating your workout can be automatically imported or manually updated. The more details you add to your completed workout data, the easier it is for the AltaBrio AI engine to automatically adjust your workouts to your needs.
AltaBrio was built for you. Tailoring the AI software to your needs can take up to 14 days to tailor AltaBrio to your specific needs. All guesswork will be removed from your day-to-day training needs.
ADD ALL YOUR RACES
Most often, your training has a purpose. That is, you are training toward a specific goal or race in mind. This means that your training needs to adjust based on when your race is on the calendar, how far it is away, and how long it is.
AltaBrio’s AI training software will adjust each workout for each day so you are building accurately toward your goal. When it comes to triathlons, there is no one size fits all. You are unique and your training should be too.
Full membership to AltaBrio:
Artificial intelligence daily workouts
- Access to a detailed workout diary
- Personalized workouts for each sport
- Advanced taper plans for unlimited races
- Weekly strength routines
- Hundreds of drills & technique videos
- Earn activity badges
- Auto import Garmin, Polar, Strava, Wahoo, Suunto, and Apple data/workouts
- Auto-export your workouts to your device of choice
Every user receives a 14-day free trial of the complete coaching software. Nothing is hidden behind a Premium barrier. After 14 days, AltaBrio Membership subscription is available through Apple In-App Purchases. The one-month Membership subscription is a one-time payment of $34.99. The one-year Membership subscription is a one-time payment of $349.99. One-on-one coaching is also available. The one-month Coaching subscription is a one-time payment of $299.99.
Terms of Use: https://altabrio.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://altabrio.com/privacy-policy

Bank from almost anywhere.

 => Find our nearest branches and ATMs.
 => Secure instant messaging with our Support Team.

bluejetty:00182424:ios.description:
Sengoku Fubu recreates epic conflict across ancient Japan, the upheaval throughout regional lords. All of them rise to fill the vacuum of weakened central authority of Emperor of Japan.
Combining turn-based campaign of conquest with gripping real-time strategy battles, Sengoku Fubu redefines the history in an age of heroes and legends. 
Come and play Sengoku Fubu with global players in one server!
A TRUE GAME OF SENGOKU EXPERIENCE
• Become a Lord of Sengoku: develop your terrain to conquer the map and unify the state
• Choose wisely: over 150 legendary characters from Sengoku period can be recruited
• Behold the beauty of authentic Ukiyoe: hundreds of cities and heroes in this floating world have been reproduced
CONQUEST WITH POWERFUL HERO
• Each Hero has their own skills and abilities
• Create powerful officer teams to conquer the map
• Deploy different type of troops to counter different enemy
BATTLE LIKE AN EMPEROR & BATTLE AS THE EMPEROR
• Raise your army and master strategy to rule the battlefield and live out your own fantasy in Sengoku period
• Defend your cities and protect the source of resources
• Win the match and establish your own state
• Build school and help your men
JOIN THE COMMUNITY AND FIGHT WITH THEM
• Win the victory together with your friend
• Send reinforcements and clash against rivals
Will you win a stunning battle with your ally, or fight alone to against the whole world, or fall victim to the other great lords of Sengoku in this RTS game? The choice is up to you. Remember, only best strategy will rule the battlefield.
Download Sengoku Fubu today!
Find us! 
•Friend Us on Facebook – https://www.facebook.com/sengokufubu.en/
•Chat with Us on Discord – https://discord.gg/FKC2k6f
•Contact Us in Game – Tap Help Button on Top Right Corner

bluejetty:00140947:ios.description:
CYCLE & PERIOD TRACKER!
Meet a completely new approach to tracking your cycle. Everyday tips, opportunity to send REMINDERS about the beginning of cycle, pms, ovulation.
In PERIOD TRACKER, you will find multiple capabilities: 
* Forecasting your cycles and menstruation periods
* Tracking your menses dates
* Customizing individual menses duration, the length of cycle for irregular menses
* Including specific moods and symptoms
* Tracking your intimate life
* Notifications for fertility periods and menses
You can log your symptoms, including the intensity of secretions and your mood.
A personal card in the profile will let you know the date of the beginning of cycle.
Period Calendar is used for recording and forecasting your period, fertile, and ovulation days.
Note: Due to individual differences, such as menses cycle, regularity of periods, etc., Period Calendar might not always forecast accurately. Therefore, it can be used for tracking your personal data, but not as the only method of unwanted pregnancy prevention.

bluejetty:00175459:ios.name: Lose It! – Calorie Counter
bluejetty:00175459:ios.summary: Lose It! Is your personal calorie counter, diet planner, nutrition-focused food tracker and weight loss progress tracking app that helps you build healthy eating habits, stick to your diet program and reach your weight loss goals! Set your
bluejetty:00175459:ios.description:
Lose It! Is your personal calorie counter, diet planner, nutrition-focused food tracker and weight loss progress tracking app that helps you build healthy eating habits, stick to your diet program and reach your weight loss goals! Set your weight loss goal, get a personalized calorie budget, and track the food you eat, exercise, nutrients, macros, protein, carbs, and progress all in one place.
We’re more than just a free calorie tracker. Complete your profile, and we’ll calculate a personalized daily calorie budget and weight loss schedule. Easily log and track your food, weight, activity, nutrition intake, macros, net calories, and intermittent fasting schedule—all in one place. Learn more about your nutrition needs, set achievable goals, manage your daily nutrition, and celebrate your progress with a personalized weight loss guide that helps you stay on track.
SIMPLIFY YOUR WEIGHT LOSS JOURNEY
Lose It! makes weight loss manageable using the proven principles of calorie counting, calorie deficit, diet tracking and nutrition awareness. Set your weight targets, log healthy meals, discover nutrient dense foods to eat, and track nutrients to build healthier eating habits.
NEW—GLP-1 SUPPORT 
Log your medication, view estimated GLP-1 levels, and see how each phase may align with your hunger and eating habits—all alongside your nutrition, weight, and activity tracking.
AI VOICE & PHOTO MEAL LOGGING
Quickly and accurately log healthy meals using your voice or a photo. Just speak into your phone or tap the camera icon to track food and count calories in seconds. Snap a photo, log a meal and simplify your nutrition and weight loss journey!
LOSE IT! FREE BASIC FEATURES
• Calorie Tracking – Utilize the calorie counter to make it easy to track meals and exercise and chart the data, directly from your phone
• Weight Loss Plan – Build a weight loss plan based on your unique body composition, activity level and habits
• Community Support – Add your friends and join support groups to stay motivated
PREMIUM PLAN FEATURES
• Photo Meal Logging – Log meals by taking a picture
• AI Voice – Say “I had 2 eggs, toast with butter and jam” to log your meal
• Barcode Scanner – Scan food barcodes or search our database of items and recipes
• Advanced Tracking – Track macronutrients like protein, carbs, fat, sugar; as well as nutrition, vitamins, minerals, and other health goals and metrics, including blood pressure, glucose, cholesterol, body measurements, sleep cycles and more
• Intermittent Fasting - Set your fasting plan and track your fasts where you track your food
• Meal Planning & Targets – meal targets help you calculate suggested nutritional content including macro, carb, protein and overall calorie intake.
• Weight Loss Diet Plans – Identify what meals, fruits, lean meats, grains, and recipes are hindering or helping your weight loss progress.
• Fitness App Syncs – connect fitness trackers, workout apps, and devices like Fitbit, Misfit, Garmin, Withings scales, Google Fit, Healthkit, and more to maximize your weight loss, gain or maintenance goals
Since our launch in 2008 we have been featured in The Wall Street Journal, The Today Show, Men’s Health, Women’s Health, CNET, Buzzfeed, CNN, Shape, Good Morning America, and more.
Lose It! has helped over 57 million users lose more than 150 million pounds. With a global food database of 56+ million items and recipes, tracking what you eat is simple and accurate. Choose from over 25 health goals and start seeing results in just three days of consistent tracking.
The Premium subscription purchase will be charged to your iTunes account. The yearly subscription will automatically renew unless the auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the subscription period ends. Your premium subscription auto-renew can be turned off or managed in your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of the free trial is forfeited after purchase.
--
Full terms:
http://loseit.com/terms

bluejetty:00086716:ios.description:
Sensações únicas. Playlists épicas. Instrutores magnéticos.
Velocity é muito mais que uma aula de bike indoor.
É uma experiência revolucionária, que conecta corpo, mente, alma e música. Diariamente, nos studios de todo o Brasil, nossos alunos encontram prazer no movimento: liberam estresse, queimam calorias, tonificam os músculos, descobrem seus potenciais e transformam suas vidas. As aulas da Velocity têm 45min e incluem cardio de alta intensidade, movimentos ritmados e exercícios para os braços com pesos. Nós dançamos, cantamos, curtimos. É como uma festa... ou uma terapia em movimento.
O app oficial da Velocity torna a reserva de aulas muito mais fácil e simples, on the go. Também te permite salvar aquelas aulas que você sempre costuma fazer, facilitando seus agendamentos recorrentes. Quer saber em qual bike você está na aula? Veja todas as suas reservas com um só toque. Tenha todo o universo da Velocity em suas mãos.
RECURSOS ESPECIAIS DO APP
Reserve suas bikes
+ Navegue facilmente pela agenda de horários para encontrar e reservar aulas
+ Filtre aulas pelos studios, professores e faixas horárias que você prefere, para reservar mais rápido
+ Compre créditos de maneira simples e ágil, de qualquer lugar no app
Aulas freqüentes
+ Salve em uma lista suas aulas recorrentes para facilitar os próximos agendamentos
+ Com esta lista, você não precisará buscar estas aulas na grade toda vez que quiser reservá-las
Descubra novas aulas e instrutores
+ Navegue facilmente pela agenda de um studio específico
+ Encontre e conheça instrutores, e também veja a agenda de aulas de cada um separadamente
Celebre sua VeloJornada
+ Acompanhe seu histórico e quantidade de aulas realizadas
+ Veja sua próxima meta de aulas e outras conquistas
Salve seus favoritos
+ Favorite os studios e instrutores que você mais ama
+ Veja as principais novidades, acontecimentos e promoções dos seus studios favoritos
Nos vemos no studio!

bluejetty:00185820:ios.description:
Set out on an adventure through a vast world filled with Bulu Monsters!
Become a Bulu Monster Trainer and begin a journey to rescue your precious friend, Rania. Travel across diverse regions, meet unforgettable characters, discover new Bulu Monsters, and grow stronger with every challenge.
Find new partners, build a team of your favourite monsters, and begin your journey toward becoming a great Trainer!
[Meet and Collect Bulu Monsters]
Bulu Monsters of all shapes, types, and abilities can be found throughout the world.
Battle wild monsters, capture the ones that catch your eye, and add them to your growing collection. Every new region offers opportunities to encounter Bulu Monsters you have never seen before.
Find your favourite partners and create a team that is truly your own!
[Train and Evolve Your Partners]
Take your Bulu Monsters into battle to help them gain experience and become stronger.
Develop their abilities, learn powerful skills, and help them evolve into impressive new forms. Every monster has its own strengths and potential waiting to be discovered.
Raise your favourite Bulu Monsters and watch them grow into dependable partners.
[Build Your Ultimate Team]
Each Bulu Monster has its own type, abilities, skills, and battle style.
Choose the right monsters for each challenge, take advantage of their unique strengths, and make tactical decisions at the right moment.
There is no single perfect team. Experiment with different combinations and discover a battle strategy that matches your style as a Trainer.
[Explore the World of Bulu Monster]
Your adventure will take you through lively towns, deep forests, mysterious caves, towering mountains, ancient ruins, and many other unique locations.
Meet new characters, complete quests, challenge Trainers, and uncover secrets hidden throughout the world.
New monsters, unexpected encounters, and greater challenges await wherever your journey takes you.
