bluejetty:00130814:ios.description:
Pe Școala Rutieră găsiți cele mai noi chestionare auto, actualizate constant conform cu ultimele modificări ale Codului Rutier.
Această aplicație nu este afiliată, asociată sau aprobată de nicio instituție guvernamentală. Este un produs educațional independent. Platforma noastră NU reprezintă o instituție publică.
Școala Rutieră este cea mai complexă și utilă aplicație mobile/web pentru cei ce vor să obțină permisul de conducere din prima încercare. Pe Școala Rutieră găsești tot ce ai nevoie pentru a obține permisul de conducere. Toată informația necesară, mai bine explicată și mai bine organizată decât în orice carte de legislație.
Învață în 4 pași simpli și vei avea succes garantat!
În „Pasul 1 - Legislație și teorie” găsești toată legislația și teoria structurată pe 5 cursuri, cel mai important fiind cursul de legislație rutieră explicat audio-video prin animații 3D.
În „Pasul 2 - Indicatoare și marcaje” găsești toate indicatoarele și marcajele rutiere explicate pe înțelesul tuturor.
În „Pasul 3 - Mediu de învățare” găsești cele mai noi întrebări de la examen, verificate și explicate Audio-Video prin animații 3D de către profesioniști, pentru a le putea înțelege mult mai ușor.
În „Pasul 4 - Chestionare” îți vei testa cunoștințele acumulate deja din primii trei pași de învățare. Iar în caz că vei răspunde greșit la unele întrebări, la final de chestionar le va afișa pe acestea la care ai greșit, împreună cu variantele corecte, explicațiile Audio-Video și articolele de lege actualizate la zi.
Spor la învățat și succes la examen!

Not everyo
bluejetty:00128092:ios.description:
This is an emergency announcement! The disaster level is... UNPRECEDENTED.
Don't even think about running and hiding! Collect popular heroes, powerful monsters, and fight your way through the Dark Matter Thieves Arc and beyond!
Not everyone needs to train to the point that their hair falls out, and what you are capable of doesn't just mean physical strength. What's more important is to assemble a team that can maximize synergy among heroes! 
The officially licensed One-Punch Man mobile idle strategy card game One-Punch Man: Road to Hero 2.0 is here!
Unique abilities and strategic formations! Abundant offline rewards! And a myriad of game modes and challenges await!
You don't need to do 100 push ups, 100 sit ups, and 100 squats to become strong.
Unique Play Styles
Story Mode - Battle your way through the city and take down those enemies that allowed Saitama to make a name for himself!
Extreme Trial - Overcome your limits as you challenge the endless tower. Could the you of tomorrow beat you today? Instead of giving in, move forward!
PvP Tournament - If you don't want to get bossed around or mocked by the people around you... you need to get stronger! Prove your worth against other players in the Fight Arena!
Road of the Strong - Choose the path that will reward you with random buffs and abundant rewards in this roguelike game!
Battle Will - We human beings are strong because we are capable of changing ourselves! Your top five heroes will inspire others to become just as great! No need to train them when they train themselves!
Exploration - What is evil? What is justice? Explore the labyrinth and find the answer for yourself while also enforcing justice.
Dynamic Battles
This wouldn't be a superhero game if there weren't epic battles and signature moves such as Mumen Riders Justice Crash or Puripuri Prisoners Angel Rush! Mix and match heroes and mysterious beings in countless formations to create unbeatable combos!
Character Cultivation
The more the merrier! All the extra cards can be used to level up your characters! Do not fight alone!
For the latest news and updates, follow the link: 
https://www.facebook.com/OnePunchMan.Game2.0/
Find other Heroes: 
https://discord.com/invite/Bp975fb
Trying to find a game strategy? Wanting to join a Guild? Please follow our Reddit:
https://www.reddit.com/r/OnePunchMan_RtH2/
About Subscriptions and Apple WebsiteSubscriptions
1. Pricing & Billing Cycle 
Enable Subscription (Weekly)" within the gamefor $0.99 a week, which will be billed weekly
(every 7 days). (Price may vary depending onyour location.)
Enable " Subscription (Monthly)" within the
game for $2.99 a week, which will be billed everynatural month (every 30 days). (Price may varydepending on your location.)
2. Automatic Subscription Renewal
The App Store subscription is auto-renewed withpayment confirmed via your iTunes Account.
Users can manage the auto-renew manuallythrough the iTunes/Apple ID Settings Manager.The subscription will auto-renew for the
assigned billing period if the auto-renew featureis not turned off 24 hours before the current
subscription expires.
3. User Agreement and Privacy Policy
User Agreement https://profile.nata-sky.com/static-page/terms-of-service-en.html
Privacy Statement https://profile.nata-sky.com/static-page/privacy-policy-en.html
4. Subscription Cancellation
If you would like to cancel your subscription, goto 'Settings' on your iOS device --> 'iTunes &App Store' --> tap 'Apple ID' and then 'ViewApple ID'. Enter 'Account Settings; tap
'Subscriptions' --> 'Manage' and select thesubscription for ' One-Punch Man:Road to Hero 2.0' to cancel it.

bluejetty:00073707:ios.description:
Once — Not Another Dating App
Looking for a meaningful connection without the hassle of endless swiping? Looking for a chatting social app for mindful conversations? Look no further than Once!
Once is not another dating app — it's a social app for engaging conversations. No pressure, no fear of rejection, no awkward small talk. We bring you one new connection every day, someone who shares your interests and vibe, making it easier than ever to chat, connect, and build special bonds.
Why You'll Love Once
Once gives you the flexibility to choose how you chat and connect. Whether you're here to make friends, find someone special, or simply enjoy deep conversations — we've got you covered. Here are the top features you'll fall in love with:
PERFECT MATCH FEATURE: Chat with someone special every day who shares mutual vibes with you. Let this classic Once feature delve deeper and spark a new connection!
PUR PUR CARDS GAME: Break the ice with this fun game in each chat. Answer a number of questions, some basic and some funny, to get closer to your connection. It's great for meaningful conversations — you'll never run out of topics!
Ready to Chat with Someone Who Gets You?
Enjoy these awesome features:
- 1 Perfect Match per day
- 1 boost after registration
- 10 likes a day
- Starting 5 chats before the first message from your partner
- 50 Gems to unlock special perks
Unlock More with Our Subscription:
- 3 Perfect Matches per day (instead of 1)
- Unlimited likes
- Unlimited chats with all users, except the popular ones
- View who liked you
- View your visitors
- Sending and viewing of photos and Pur Pur Cards in a chat
- 45 Gems when purchasing and renewing a subscription
- 10 Gems daily when logging in
- 1 Boost daily when logging in
- View the read statuses
Gems Give You Even More:
- Send messages, photos, and Pur Pur Cards.
- View photos and Pur Pur Cards
- Send gifts to anyone
- Buy a boost
Join Once to Chat Worldwide
Whether you're looking for new connections, deep conversations, or pleasant companionship, Once is your go-to social app for easy talk without pressure. Once is not another dating app — find someone special with our chatting social app.
We respect all users in the Once app and ask you to follow our Community Guidelines. Users are responsible for their own messages. If you encounter inappropriate behavior, harassment, or suspected fake profiles, please use our reporting and blocking tools. We review reports and take appropriate action.
Need Help?
Got feedback or need assistance? Reach out to our team at support@getonce.com. We're here to help!
Privacy policy: https://www.getonce.com/policy/?mobile=true

This is the famous Zhongyuan Mahjong (Solitaire)! This is a game that you purchase only once but can play all you life.
This game demands huge observations, great patience and challenging spirit! Although only 10% people can finally complete the game, yet tens of thousands of people are challenging and enjoying it every day! 
Here are a few user reviews: 
◉If there was only one game on my iPad, it would be Zhongyuan Mahjong without hesitation. 
---by Mockie, Aug 20, 2011 
◉Once I start playing, I can't stop! I have a lot of mahjong games on my iPad, but this is by far my favorite one. 
---by katieandron Sep 17, 2011 
◉Me encanta!!!!!!! 
---from Spain Store, Jan 16, 2012 
◉The tetris of all mahjong games! 
--- from Belgium Store, by Grovonion, Jan 18, 2012 
◉ Really love this puzzle game! Thank you for creating it!!! 
---by KJMB007 Feb 10, 2012 
***Demo of How to Play in Youtube 
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j4lgXnHV0_M 
----------------------------------------------- 
***Game goal 
Clear the board by removing two same tiles each time as quickly as possible. 
***How to remove 
Condition 1: If two same tiles are on the same row or column and there are no other tiles between them, tap to remove them directly. 
Condition 2: If one tile can be moved to a new position where Condition 1 can be met by this tile and the other same tile, move this tile first and then tap the other to remove these two same tiles. 
****Game features 
The game proceeds with no hints, no help and no re-try. There is no any assistance to you but your hard observation. You can press the “End” button to see remaining removable pairs, but the game will end at the same time.
****Licensed Application

****Banner Ads
In order to support feature improvement and sustainabity, banner ad is introduced. However, users can still play at offline mode and report offline scores to Game Center. 
Inn order to enable users to remove ads at a reasonable amount payment, auto-renewable subscription is inntroduced.

bluejetty:00043665:ios.summary:
TNW Tickets – Your App for Public Transport Tickets in Basel & NW Switzerland
The official TNW Tickets app for the TNW network (Tarifverbund Nordwestschweiz) and TriRegio. Buy your public transport tickets for Basel and the region – whether
bluejetty:00043665:ios.description:
TNW Tickets – Your App for Public Transport Tickets in Basel & NW Switzerland
The official TNW Tickets app for the TNW network (Tarifverbund Nordwestschweiz) and TriRegio. Buy your public transport tickets for Basel and the region – whether for bus, tram, or train. «TNW Tickets» is Switzerland's first smartphone app for network tickets: fast, simple, and secure way to buy tickets for public transport.
Functions of the app:
- Assortments: buy the following assortments easily, quickly and securely:
- Short-distance tickets, zone tickets, day tickets, multi-trip cards and special TNW tickets.
- TriRegio tickets for cross-border travel
- RVL connection tickets in combination with the U-Abo or GA travelcard
- Multi-trip cards: secure wallet for unlimited number of multi-trip cards
- Securing and restoring multi-trip cards: Securing multi-trip cards by one-time registration via SMS: Protection of multi-trip cards in case of loss or change of mobile phone.
- Transfer of multi-trip cards: With the "Send" and "Receive" functions, multi-trip cards can be easily transferred to another smartphone.
- Means of payment: TWINT, Visa, Mastercard Postfinance Debit Card, Apple Pay.
- Disruption messages: Associated disruption messages are displayed for the selected departure stop.
- Favourites: Save ticket preferences with number of tickets and class selection for quick selection.
- Locate-Me: Automatically determine the current departure location and departure stop.
- Passengers: Take up to 7 friends with you on the journey; a total of 8 tickets per journey possible.
- Search: Find the destination stop with the "Search by place/stop" function.
- Route: All possible connections, including via connections, are displayed for selection.
- Fare: The app automatically calculates the correct fare from the departure to the destination.
- Short trips: Alphabetical listing of short trips from the departure stop.
- Security: Optionally secure the purchase process with a password (incl. Face ID support).
- Receipt: Send the purchase receipt via email.
- History: Saves the tickets in the ticket memory for 10 days.
- Integration Half-Fare Card: With the registration of the SwissPass Half-Fare Card, the control information is displayed directly in the purchased ticket. You only need to show your smartphone while ticket inspection.
Download the TNW Tickets app now and buy your next ticket for Basel public transport and all of Northwestern Switzerland conveniently on your mobile!

bluejetty:00076042:android.description:
Resume builder and CV creator is a very useful and user-friendly tool to help you in creating a Curriculum Vitae & job resume for a professional level in just a few steps. 
Resume generator is a professional resume builder app that is a simple resume making app for both freshers & experienced.
Résumé is the very first thing during job hunting. CV writing is the foundation for this purpose. CV writing app will assist you to generate, manage & share CV resume quickly.
A perfect resume format for the job is compulsory when you apply for any job or go for an interview. The resume maker & resume generator app will help you a lot to achieve this goal.
How to use CV builder app:
1. Fill out all the required fields in the personal information section. Also provide details regarding education, projects, work experience, and other skills, etc. You cannot go further if any data is missing.
2. Select Format for resumes like Freshers or Experienced format. Then select any resume template.
3. Download resume CV in PDF/JPEG format.
4. You can also email the résumé directly.
Online resume maker deals below functionalities to make your CV or curriculum vitae:
- Objective
- Education details
- Projects details
- Work experience
- Skills both Non-technical/Technical
- Known Languages
- Other activities, and achievement & awards
- Customizable résumé sections
- hobbies/ Interests/ curricular activities
- Photograph & Sign
Resume builder app can simply change the CV designs to any format you select e.g., reverse-chronological, functional, or combination CV formats, etc.
CV creator had created the résumé app with specialized resume building templates & CV templates which are built on research and the modern styles in different firms in the world. This will improve your Curriculum Vitae PDF concentrates on what global hiring executives expecting. 
Cover Letter for Resumes builder is Coming soon:
The upcoming version of the CV Maker app will soon add the feature of resume cover letter maker along with Simple resume templates according to the trends. Our team is currently working very hard to add various cover letter templates & resume templates for different fields such as engineering, IT, business & management, teaching, medical, graphic designing, banking, etc. The resume creator will add the feature for cover letter to download it separately from the app.
If you have any queries with this Resume builder & Resume creator app, please contact the team-developed applications via mail e-mail: gareoyster@gmail.com. If you like the CV maker app, please help us with 5★ ratings as it is the best encouragement for our team. Thanks for using Resume maker.

bluejetty:00064132:ios.name: Sonic Forces: PvP Race
bluejetty:00064132:ios.summary: Speed into action with Sonic Forces — the ultimate real-time multiplayer racing game from SEGA! Race and battle against real players from around the world in thrilling 4-player PvP matches packed with speed, strategy, and nonstop excitement
bluejetty:00064132:ios.description:
Speed into action with Sonic Forces — the ultimate real-time multiplayer racing game from SEGA! Race and battle against real players from around the world in thrilling 4-player PvP matches packed with speed, strategy, and nonstop excitement.
Run as Sonic the Hedgehog, Shadow, Knuckles, Amy, Tails and many more legendary Sonic characters. Dash through stunning 3D worlds inspired by the Sonic universe, dodge dangerous obstacles, attack rivals with powerful abilities, collect rings, and race to victory in fast-paced multiplayer battles.
Sonic Forces takes endless runner gameplay to the next level by combining high-speed racing with competitive real-time PvP action. Every race is an adrenaline-fueled challenge where quick reflexes, smart strategy, and perfect timing can make the difference between victory and defeat.
Race across iconic Sonic-inspired tracks including Green Hill Zone, Golden Bay, and more. Sprint through vibrant environments filled with traps, hazards, boosts, and surprises as you battle opponents and fight for first place.
Unlock and upgrade your favourite runners, discover unique powers and special attacks, and build the ultimate racing team. Every character brings different abilities to the track, creating endless ways to play and compete.
Take part in exciting limited-time events, seasonal content, and blitz challenges to unlock exclusive rewards, rare characters, and valuable collectibles. Climb the leaderboards, earn trophies, and prove you have what it takes to become the fastest racer in the Sonic universe.
NEW FEATURE CLANS & TEAM REWARDS
• Create or join a Clan with friends and players worldwide
• Team up to earn exclusive rewards and powerful bonuses
• Compete together and rise through the Clan leaderboards
• Join Clan events and cooperative multiplayer challenges

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
Can you beat the clock? Take casual cooking up a notch, and play the classic cooking and time management game, Diner DASH Adventures! 
 Cook delicious dishes, match customers to orders, serve food and renovate the town! Enjoy cooking games with time management challenges to give you a fast-paced cooking experience. Think you have what it takes? Serve and cook food as quickly as possible as you battle against a flurry of orders to keep customers happy. Take Diner DASH Adventures with you wherever you go.
 Reveal the heartwarming story of our hero, Flo, as she returns to her hometown to help a unique cast of citizens and adorable animals of DinerTown. Stop Mr. Big and his mischievous goons as they cook up their evil plans!
 Serve hundreds of unique foods to customers. Design DinerTown YOUR way to #savetheday!
 FUN COOKING ACTION
 • Get cooking fever with hundreds of fast levels.
 • Fun cooking games with hundreds of customizable foods, recipes and menus.
 • Cook up fun: Donuts, burgers, milkshakes…from breakfast to dinner and more!
 • Crush cooking competitors: Team up with the top chef in town, Cookie, to beat Mr. Big and other rivals.
 RESTAURANT SIMULATION MANIA
 • Simulate cooking with fast-paced gameplay in unique locations. Manage your own restaurant, cafe, bakery, food truck and more!
 • Server, master chef and designer - control all aspects of your restaurant and town.
 FAST-PACED TIME MANAGEMENT GAMEPLAY
 • Tap to cook food, serve customers, and manage your restaurant.
 • Match food to customer orders.
 • Hundreds of fun levels with challenges, boosts, mini-games, and puzzles!
 • Classic and casual puzzle play for fans of challenging and fun franchises.
 DECORATE. RENOVATE. EXPLORE.
 • Design and remodel restaurants, gardens, houses, cruise ships, mansions, and more.
 • Renovate an entire town and choose your favorite decorations.
 • Choose from thousands of design and decor combinations.
 • Cute pets can be yours to collect.
 • Adventure awaits! Discover the Diner DASH story filled with colorful characters.

Oclean Care 4.0: AI-Driven Professional Oral Care Makes Its Debut
In the field of oral care, the integration of professionalism and intelligence is leading a new development trend. As an innovative oral care application, Oclean Care relies on Oclean's self-developed oral care AI large model, serving as your exclusive personal oral care butler to unlock a new era of intelligent oral health.

Powered by advanced artificial intelligence and digital technology, Oclean Care enables detailed analysis and tracking of every oral care session once you connect your Oclean digital toothbrush to the app. From brushing duration, frequency, and pressure to the cleanliness of each oral area, Oclean Care records and analyzes data comprehensively, providing you with scientific and accurate oral care insights.

Day or night, Oclean Care stays online 24/7 to guard yours and your family’s oral health.
You can now view Oclean’s oral care data through the Apple Health App. Simply connect to Apple Health within the Oclean Care App, and you’ll be able to check your brushing data directly in the Apple Health application.

bluejetty:00062657:ios.description:
Do you want to improve your English speaking, listening, pronunciation and vocabulary? The award-winning Say It: English Pronunciation makes pronunciation visual and interactive, so you no longer have to guess how to say a word in English. The free version includes 100 example words, covering all 44 sounds in standard English.
Say It is like a personal pronunciation teacher on your device! Includes British and American accent dictionaries (36,000+ entries each).
HOW IT WORKS 
1. see the soundwave, syllables, and which are stressed (strong) 
2. touch and drag to listen to the pronunciation slowly 
3. tap the phonemes (IPA symbols, British/American English) 
4. record your pronunciation, compare to the Oxford model 
5. share your voice recording and soundwave directly from the app 
6. regular notifications with pronunciation tips and suggested words to practise - please allow notifications in the app to receive these
RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT
In research at the University of the West of England, international students predominantly rated all features of Say It - range of vocabulary, phonetic alphabet blocks, stress markers, interactive soundwaves - as ‘very useful’. The majority of respondents agreed that using Say It over a longer period would enable them to:
* Perform better academically in English
* Increase their enjoyment of living in the UK and interacting with native-English speakers
Developed by our team of language teachers and pronunciation experts, Say It includes 70,000+ recordings from Oxford. The unique visual interface allows you to analyse the model audio and your recording, pinpointing difficult areas and improving quickly.
FEEDBACK
"Great app, great support. The app functionality is very good and intuitive. The tests and sound wave graph helps you perfect the emphasis as well as pronunciation. Thanks for this useful app." Farhad K
"I have tried lots of pronunciation apps. Your app is unique and amazing. The sounds are very clear and you can see all details of pronunciation on the screen. After I recorded my voice and compared it with the native one I could easily find my mistakes and correct them." Abid, Turkey
- Improve Business English skills, for your work or career; feel more confident in meetings and when networking in English 
- Covers 75%+ of the Academic Word List; ideal for university study, preparing for IELTS, OET, TOEFL, Cambridge First (B2), Advanced (C1), or Proficiency (C2) 
- Downloaded in over 130 countries, by professionals, students and teachers 
Winner of the 2016 English Speaking Union President's Award for New Technology in ELT.
Research shows practising your English pronunciation also improves your: 
* Speaking 
* Listening 
* Reading 
* Writing 
* Grammar 
Try Say It FREE for 7 days - access the full range of content and tests. If you find it useful, subscribe! Payment will be charged to your iTunes account on confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled 24 hours prior to the end of your current subscription. To cancel your subscription at any time, go to the iTunes Store and manage auto-renewal settings. 
A TEACHER'S VIEWPOINT 
“This is a fantastic learning tool for really getting students to work on the specific sounds in words as well as taking into account stress and intonation. The visualisation is a very useful way to illustrate areas that need more attention and can be practised again and again. As an ESL teacher, I have recommended it to all my students so that they can work on their pronunciation skills at home and have used it in class on many occasions.” Anna D, Bristol, UK 
Say It offers large American and British English dictionaries - they can take a few minutes to download, depending on your WIFI access.
Connect with us!
* Email: info@phona.co.uk 
* Facebook: /sayitpron 
* Instagram: /sayit_pronunciation
* YouTube: Say It: English Pronunciation

Do you want to improve your English speaking, listening, pronunciation and vocabulary? The award-winning Say It: English Pronunciation makes pronunciation visual and interactive, so you no longer have to guess how to say a word in English. The free version includes 100 example words, covering all 44 sounds in standard English.

Say It is like a personal pronunciation teacher on your device! Includes British and American accent dictionaries (36,000+ entries each).

HOW IT WORKS 
1. see the soundwave, syllables, and which are stressed (strong) 
2. touch and drag to listen to the pronunciation slowly 
3. tap the phonemes (IPA symbols, British/American English) 
4. record your pronunciation, compare to the Oxford model 
5. share your voice recording and soundwave directly from the app 
6. regular notifications with pronunciation tips and suggested words to practise - please allow notifications in the app to receive these

RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT
In research at the University of the West of England, international students predominantly rated all features of Say It - range of vocabulary, phonetic alphabet blocks, stress markers, interactive soundwaves - as ‘very useful’. The majority of respondents agreed that using Say It over a longer period would enable them to:

* Perform better academically in English
* Increase their enjoyment of living in the UK and interacting with native-English speakers

Developed by our team of language teachers and pronunciation experts, Say It includes 70,000+ recordings from Oxford. The unique visual interface allows you to analyse the model audio and your recording, pinpointing difficult areas and improving quickly.

FEEDBACK
"Great app, great support. The app functionality is very good and intuitive. The tests and sound wave graph helps you perfect the emphasis as well as pronunciation. Thanks for this useful app." Farhad K

"I have tried lots of pronunciation apps. Your app is unique and amazing. The sounds are very clear and you can see all details of pronunciation on the screen. After I recorded my voice and compared it with the native one I could easily find my mistakes and correct them." Abid, Turkey

- Improve Business English skills, for your work or career; feel more confident in meetings and when networking in English 
- Covers 75%+ of the Academic Word List; ideal for university study, preparing for IELTS, OET, TOEFL, Cambridge First (B2), Advanced (C1), or Proficiency (C2) 
- Downloaded in over 130 countries, by professionals, students and teachers 

Winner of the 2016 English Speaking Union President's Award for New Technology in ELT.

Research shows practising your English pronunciation also improves your: 
* Speaking 
* Listening 
* Reading 
* Writing 
* Grammar 

Try Say It FREE for 7 days - access the full range of content and tests. If you find it useful, subscribe! Payment will be charged to your iTunes account on confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled 24 hours prior to the end of your current subscription. To cancel your subscription at any time, go to the iTunes Store and manage auto-renewal settings. 

A TEACHER'S VIEWPOINT 
“This is a fantastic learning tool for really getting students to work on the specific sounds in words as well as taking into account stress and intonation. The visualisation is a very useful way to illustrate areas that need more attention and can be practised again and again. As an ESL teacher, I have recommended it to all my students so that they can work on their pronunciation skills at home and have used it in class on many occasions.” Anna D, Bristol, UK 

Say It offers large American and British English dictionaries - they can take a few minutes to download, depending on your WIFI access.

Connect with us!
* Email: info@phona.co.uk 
* Facebook: /sayitpron 
* Instagram: /sayit_pronunciation
* YouTube: Say It: English Pronunciation

bluejetty:00138113:ios.description:
We provide a strong application that uses AI-powered picture recognition technology to correctly identify any coin in seconds! The identifying procedure is rather basic. All you need to do is take a picture of your coin (or upload one from your phone's gallery), and our app will compare the image to the information in the huge database to provide a reference result. Each identification provides a thorough analysis of the coin, including its name, country of origin, year of issuance, coin populations, and other details.
In addition, the app includes a coin grading feature and provides a reference price for each coin. You can also record and store your collections directly within our app, ensuring that you never lose track of your collections and are always aware of their value. We also allow you to organize your coin collections by value & series.
Key features:
- Quickly identify coins from all around the world.
- Provide reliable identification results.
- Identify rare and mistaken coins.
- Grade coins with photographs.
- Estimate the price of detected coins to determine the worth of your coin.
- Keep up with contemporary coin collecting series.
- Record and store your collections directly in the app.
- Keep track of the overall value of all your coins.
- High-resolution photographs

bluejetty:00083382:ios.summary:
Welcome to Screw Garden, a casual game designed to release stress! In this creative and fun world, players will experience unprecedented relaxation and happiness through a series of simple but challenging mini-games.
Main gameplay:
Players
bluejetty:00083382:ios.description:
Welcome to Screw Garden, a casual game designed to release stress! In this creative and fun world, players will experience unprecedented relaxation and happiness through a series of simple but challenging mini-games.
Main gameplay:
Players need to click on the flowers screws to “remove” the board.Match 3 “flowers” of the same color to complete the elimination. Remove all the boards to pass the game.
Features:
Rich Patterns: Levels are made up of different layers of boards stacked together to form different shapes, with the flowers acting as “screws” in the middle.
Difficulty: Players need to dismantle the “flowers” within a limited space, and need to plan the sequence wisely.
Pass the time: by disassembling the “screws” and removing the boards layer by layer, the user's anxiety is replaced by concentration and gradually feels a sense of inner peace in the process.
Various collectibles: Each time you pass a level, you can get a collectible, which covers all aspects of life and has an ornamental value.
Soothe your heart and gain a sense of peace of mind, come and plant your “Screw Garden”!

bluejetty:00135038:ios.name: The Walking Zombie 2: Shooter
bluejetty:00135038:ios.summary: The world after the zombie apocalypse is a grim place. You were born into it, so you will have to struggle to survive and fight against many kinds of zombies, bandits and dangerous boss monsters. You will go on important story quests and ma
bluejetty:00135038:ios.description:
The world after the zombie apocalypse is a grim place. You were born into it, so you will have to struggle to survive and fight against many kinds of zombies, bandits and dangerous boss monsters. You will go on important story quests and many side quests, level up your skills and perks, sell and buy equipment, and communicate with the (un)lucky survivors.
SURVIVAL RPG AND FIRST-PERSON SHOOTER
Walking Zombie 2 is a good old FPS with story, with dozens of quests and a lot of shooting stuff with different weapons. Your main enemies are zombies who already control the world. They are everywhere, in many different kinds and - most importantly - in great numbers. You will be using guns with different ammo, grenades or melee weapons to finish them off. Meanwhile, you will be able to heal yourself with medkits and food. As you complete more and more quests, your character will become stronger with better equipment, enhanced skills and gained perks. Are you going to get more hit points, a better chance when lockpicking locks or a lower fuel consumption while driving across the world map?
FEATURES
• Good old single player post-apocalyptic FPS
• Attractive modern polygon graphics style
• Karma system - good and bad deeds create new options and encounters
• Dozens of story and side quests
• Many weapons, protective gear and other equipment
• Weapon skins
• A variety of enemies - zombie walkers, bandits, and huge boss mutants
• Traders in settlements
• Fun mini games and sniper missions
STORY OF THE CHOSEN ONE WITH A TRAGIC PAST
Can your story end happily after such a tragic beginning? Because of the circumstances surrounding your birth, you are the only one who can save the world. You are immune to the effects of the virus that turns people and animals into zombies. That also makes you a perfect weapon against the undead masters of the planet and the symbol of hope for a better tomorrow. Together with friends that you will make on your path, find out the whole truth about your origin and search for the way to create a cure, despite the dangers lurking behind every corner.

SURVIVAL RPG AND FIRST-PERSON SHOOTER
Walking Zombie 2 is a good old FPS with story, with dozens of quests and a lot of shooting stuff with different weapons. Your main enemies are zombies who already control the world. They are everywhere, in many different kinds and - most importantly - in great numbers. You will be using guns with different ammo, grenades or melee weapons to finish them off. Meanwhile, you will be able to heal yourself with medkits and food. As you complete more and more quests, your character will become stronger with better equipment, enhanced skills and gained perks. Are you going to get more hit points, a better chance when lockpicking locks or a lower fuel consumption while driving across the world map?

FEATURES
• Good old single player post-apocalyptic FPS
• Attractive modern polygon graphics style
• Karma system - good and bad deeds create new options and encounters
• Dozens of story and side quests
• Many weapons, protective gear and other equipment
• Weapon skins
• A variety of enemies - zombie walkers, bandits, and huge boss mutants
• Traders in settlements
• Fun mini games and sniper missions

STORY OF THE CHOSEN ONE WITH A TRAGIC PAST
Can your story end happily after such a tragic beginning? Because of the circumstances surrounding your birth, you are the only one who can save the world. You are immune to the effects of the virus that turns people and animals into zombies. That also makes you a perfect weapon against the undead masters of the planet and the symbol of hope for a better tomorrow. Together with friends that you will make on your path, find out the whole truth about your origin and search for the way to create a cure, despite the dangers lurking behind every corner.

bluejetty:00122828:ios.description:
The Hawthorn Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Hawthorn Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Hawthorn Bank App, you must be enrolled as an Hawthorn Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

Our programming changes lives. Let us make a believer of you!

bluejetty:00091159:ios.description:
Dive into the World of Building! Immerse yourself in a captivating 3D puzzle experience! This game offers a unique opportunity to assemble intricate models by searching for the right pieces among many. Designed by construction set enthusiasts for fellow builders, it guarantees unforgettable moments of creativity and satisfaction.
Key Features:
Diverse Building Sets
Construct everything from classic cars to breathtaking architectural wonders. Each set presents a fresh challenge!
Hundreds of Pieces
Dig through a scattered pile to find the essential elements for your model. Every piece matters!
Shake to Shuffle
Simply shake your device to rearrange the pieces, making it easier to spot what you need.
Stunning 3D Graphics
Enjoy high-quality visuals that bring your models to life with remarkable detail.
Realistic Physics & Sound
Experience true-to-life interactions with satisfying sound effects and dynamic physics.
Atmospheric Music
Let the soothing soundtrack enhance your focus and creativity as you build.
How to Play:
* Search for the required pieces in the pile.
* Follow step-by-step instructions to assemble your model.
* Tap and interact with pieces to fit them into place.
* Shake your device to shuffle the pile and find missing elements.
Download the game now and start your 3D puzzle adventure! Build, explore, and enjoy the process alongside a community of passionate creators!

bluejetty:00073588:ios.name: 90 Day Challenge
bluejetty:00073588:ios.summary:
The 90 Day Challenge App is the perfect workout tool in your pocket and provides you with everything you need to start your own fitness journey. Get your own 90 day programs based on your goals, level, and training style.
Stan Browney has
bluejetty:00073588:ios.description:
The 90 Day Challenge App is the perfect workout tool in your pocket and provides you with everything you need to start your own fitness journey. Get your own 90 day programs based on your goals, level, and training style.
Stan Browney has done many 90-day transformations with family, friends, and strangers. After seeing their results, so many people requested to help them with their fitness journey. Because it would be impossible to guide everybody personally, we designed this app. Now, you will be able to have your own 90 Day Transformation!
Start your 7-Day Free Trial now.
OVER 45 TAILORED 90-DAY PROGRAMS
Check out the 90 Day Challenge App and pick from over 45 awesome workout programs made just for you! Whether you like to exercise at home, hit the gym, or get moving outside, there’s something for everyone. You can choose to lift weights, use machines, do bodyweight exercises, or mix it up. Set your own goals to build muscle, get stronger, shed pounds, or bulk up. It’s super easy and fun, great for both beginners and experienced people.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
The 90 Day Challenge App has a complete in-app tracking system that allows you to track your weight, reps, personal records, everything! You can easily see your progress for every exercise to know you’re on track to reach your goals. For every 90 day program, you will have monthly strength tests to see the progress you make each month. Additionally, there are fun weekly challenges to keep you active but also help you to see yourself get stronger over time!
SEE YOUR BODY CHANGING
Within the 90 Day Challenge App, you can take progress pictures with the in-app progress picture tool. You can also create your own “Before and After” that you can share with others. Besides visual changes, you will be able to track your weight, and see your weight changing over time.
ALWAYS STAY MOTIVATED
Keep your fitness journey fun and rewarding with our daily streaks and achievement badges! Each day you log a workout, you’ll keep your streak going—making it exciting to see how long you can keep it up. With these streaks and badges, you’ll always have a reason to stay motivated and never feel like giving up.
As you move along, you'll unlock cool badges for different milestones and challenges. These badges are more than just fun—they celebrate the progress you’re making towards your health and fitness goals. Whether it’s finishing a 90-day challenge, hitting a new personal best, or maintaining a routine of working out three times a week, each badge highlights your enjoyment and commitment in a super fun and easy way.
CHALLENGE OTHERS
Working out can even be more fun when you do it together with a friend. That is why the 90 Day Challenge App has a built-in feature where you can challenge others to join the exact program that you have. This way you can workout together and keep each other accountable to keep hitting your workouts!
CALCULATOR
The 90 Day Challenge also has you covered when it comes to diet! With the in-app calorie calculator you can calculate your calorie needs for losing weight, maintaining weight, or gaining weight. You can also determine your macronutrient split and form your own diet goals.
RECIPES
Within the app, there is an entire library of recipes that are both healthy and delicious that will help you to build muscle and lose fat! These recipes are explained in great detail including the ingredient list and the cooking instructions.
LEARN EVERYTHING ABOUT FOOD AND FITNESS
You will get access to a library filled with high quality videos explaining everything about working out, recovery, losing or gaining weight, tracking calories, and more!
DOWNLOAD NOW FOR A 7-DAY FREE TRIAL
Start your own fitness journey with the 90 Day Challenge App. Download now and get your first 7 days for free.
Start your 90 Day Challenge today!
By creating an account you agree to the Terms of Service which can be found here: https://the90dc.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00157107:ios.description:
Did you know that your rent payments aren’t automatically reported to the credit bureaus? 
Boom makes it easy to build credit with your rent. Join the tens of thousands of renters who use BoomReport to report ongoing payments, past payments, or both. Boom reports to all 3 major credit bureaus - Experian, TransUnion, and Equifax - so you see the maximum impact of the largest payment you make every month.
BUILD & TRACK YOUR CREDIT
On average, Boom customers see an average credit score increase of 28 points
Some users see increases of over 105 points
Reporting your rent payments can help give you a credit score if you do not already have one 
See your new rental tradeline on your credit report in as little as 10 days 
Access your credit score for free in the Boom app to track your progress
HOW IT WORKS 
Enroll in as few as 5 minutes via the Boom app 
Available for anyone who pays rent via a digitally-tracked method, such as a rental portal, bank account, check, ACH, or payment apps (e.g. Venmo, PayPal)
Report ongoing payments and up to 24 months of prior rent history 
You can even report old leases too, as long as you moved out within the past 12 months 
SECURITY
Your security is a top priority. Sensitive user data is stored with our verification partners, which are bank-grade, highly-encrypted services. Our verification partners perform similar services for trusted companies such as PayPal, Robinhood, Coinbase, Venmo, Chime and more. Your data is never stored on your device. We do not sell your personal information to any third parties.
Still reading? What are you waiting for? Download Boom and supercharge your rent today. 
Chat our team at www.boompay.app or via the in-app support feature in the Boom Pay app if you have any questions, suggestions, or feedback.

bluejetty:00123869:ios.description:
Drive your car through a zombie apocalypse in this massive follow-up to the chart-topping hit Earn to Die!
An evacuation ship is waiting on the other side of the country. The only thing that stands in your way: city after city overrun by zombies . With only a run-down car and a small amount of cash you face a familiar situation... to drive through hordes of zombies in order to survive!
BRAND NEW STORY MODE
Earn to Die 2 introduces a massive new Story Mode, five times longer than its predecessor. The game departs its familiar desert setting and delves into the depths of cities infested by zombies. 
MULTI-TIERED LEVELS:
Levels are now multi-tiered! Drive across decayed highway overpasses, via underground tunnels, or smash through epic zombie filled factories. Whichever path you choose to take, you won't be able to escape the zombie hordes - your only choice is to smash through them!
BUILD A ZOMBIE-SLAUGHTERING MACHINE
Unlock and upgrade 10 different vehicles, including a sports car, a fire truck, and even an ice-cream van. Each vehicle can be equipped with a range of upgrades, such as armored frames, roof-mounted guns, boosters and more. Those zombies will stand no chance.
DESTRUCTIBLE VEHICLES
Vehicles are now fully destructible. Hang on for your life as your vehicle gets smashed to smithereens if you aren't too careful.
MORE ZOMBIES. MORE DESTRUCTION. MORE MAYHEM.
What are you waiting for? That rescue ship isn't going to wait forever! Prepare yourself for a wild ride - and seriously, there is nothing like smashing through zombie-filled factories!

bluejetty:00162622:ios.description:
The Ultimate Sports Tracking App for Outdoor Adventures and Fitness Improvement
Track your running, cycling, hiking, and over 90 other sports with precision and ease. Sports Tracker combines GPS tracking, performance analysis, and route discovery tools to help you enjoy the outdoors even more – while reaching your fitness goals.
DISCOVER NEW ROUTES AND STAY ON TRACK
• Explore and find routes anywhere with Heatmaps.
• Choose your favorite map type (terrain or satellite) to plan the perfect workout.
• Find popular trails for your sport – trail running, cycling, mountain biking, cross-country skiing…
Plan, Save, and Share Routes:
• Plan routes, save them for future workouts, and share them with friends.
• You can also import routes (GPX) from other services.
TRACK YOUR WORKOUTS RELIABLY AND ACCURATELY
Track key stats like duration, distance, pace, calories burned, heart rate, and more.
• Analyze and compare your performance over time.
• Monitor your progress with weekly, monthly, and yearly training summaries.
• Set weekly goals to stay motivated.
Versatile Tracking Features:
• Track duration, distance, speed, elevation, heart rate, steps, and more.
• Customize your workout view to display the stats that matter to you.
• Voice feedback keeps you updated on distance, speed, and duration during workouts.
• Auto-pause stops tracking when you take a break.
• Night mode/dark mode makes evening workouts more comfortable.
Broad Activity Support: Track over 90 sports, from running and hiking to yoga, dancing, and martial arts.
APPLE WATCH INTEGRATION
• Standalone Apple Watch app for tracking sports and custom workouts.
• Includes maps and route navigation.
• Monitor wrist-based heart rate, speed, steps, ground contact time, stride length, and calories with your Apple Watch.
• Customize sport screens to show exactly what you want.
• Sync workouts automatically between your watch and the Sports Tracker app.
GET INSPIRED AND STAY MOTIVATED
• Analyze your performance, compare past workouts, and celebrate progress.
• Access your training history across devices, even when switching phones.
EASY WORKOUT SHARING
• Share your workouts, routes, and stats on WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, or X.
• Customize what you share or keep workouts private as a personal fitness diary.
SAFE AND SECURE DATA
• Your training data stays safe and transfers automatically when you switch devices. Once registered, your progress is always within reach.
Ready to take your outdoor sports and fitness to the next level?
Download Sports Tracker today and join millions of users who trust the app to track their journeys and inspire their progress!

bluejetty:00131828:ios.description:
SSTP Connect is a VPN client that supports these protocols:
- SSTP (MS-SSTP)
- SoftEther VPN
This is only a VPN client. No VPN service is included. You need to specify the server you are connecting to.
• Native
Only iOS native libraries are used in the core function, including the TLS stack. No OpenSSL.
Connections are saved natively so that you can start a connection from the system settings.
• Simple
VPN clients ought to be small and simple. No ads, analytics or other 3rd-party SDK are included.
• Privacy
No data is collected from you. Connection log only exists in the memory and is never saved to the device.
• Complete
Support all password and certificate-based authentications available in Windows 11.
Support authenticating by password and certificate at the same time with TEAP (EAP chaining).
Protocol details below.
• Security
Passwords and certificates are stored in the iOS keychain. SSTP Connect never saves them locally for convenience.
• IPv6 Ready
Support both IPv6 connections and stateless IPv6 configuration in the VPN tunnels. (DHCPv6 not supported)
• More than TCP
Support NAT traversal (NAT-T) and UDP acceleration just like the official SoftEther client.
• Easy Import and Export
Not only from SSTP Connect, reading connection settings from SoftEther Client Manager is also a piece of cake.
• Routing
Accept static routes pushed from the server or add your own entries.
SSTP Authentication Methods
- PEAP
- EAP-TTLS
- TEAP (EAP chaining)
- EAP-TLS
- EAP-MSCHAPv2
- MSCHAPv2
- CHAP
- PAP
SoftEther Authentication Methods
- Password
- RADIUS / NT Domain Password
- Certificate
- Anonymous
Supported Server Platforms
• Microsoft Windows Server 2008 and later
• Microsoft Azure P2S VPN
• MikroTik RouterOS*
• SoftEther VPN Server
• VPN Azure
* Servers configured without certificates are not supported.
SSTP Connect is a third-party implementation based on Microsoft Open Specifications and SoftEther VPN source code. We do not have any affiliation with either Microsoft Corporation or SoftEther Corporation.

bluejetty:00027181:ios.name: Coverage? Lite
bluejetty:00027181:ios.summary:
Directly overlay and compare cellular carrier coverage maps! Perfect for travelers - research where you're covered across the USA (and now Canada!!) 
** Follow our Facebook page to get update alerts: http://www.facebook.com/CoverageMapApp,
bluejetty:00027181:ios.description:
Directly overlay and compare cellular carrier coverage maps! Perfect for travelers - research where you're covered across the USA (and now Canada!!) 
** Follow our Facebook page to get update alerts: http://www.facebook.com/CoverageMapApp, or check our support page**
Coverage? focuses on helping mobile bandwidth junkies find cell signal as they roam. Save time looking up coverage on the carrier's websites, compare their claims head to head and better plan your travels to stay connected. 
** The carrier's maps in your pocket: This app contains regional level maps based off of each major carrier's data map - as of our last update. Quickly overlay the carriers you use to create your own personalized coverage map on your device. 
** No internet needed: Our proprietary compressed coverage maps are stored within the app on your device - no downloading needed! Quickly access where you're supposed to get a signal, even when you have none. 
** Urban and rural areas: Maps are at a regional level, and cover the entire continental USA, Canada, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.
** Carriers included: AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, Dish/Boost, US Cellular.
** Canadian Carriers: Bell, Telus, Rogers (optional unlock)
** Know where to roam: view 5G, LTE, and roaming areas as overlays, focus on finding the coverage type you desire. 
Check http://www.twostepsbeyond.com/apps/coverage for a quick video demo.
We created this app because we are full time 'technomads' ourselves who rely on mobile data to work remotely. Keeping this app updated is a priority for us, as we depend on it ourselves!
--------------
Coverage FAQ: 
Q: Why aren't the maps more detailed or released more often? 
A: Our map updates require a lot of meticulous labor intensive processing. The optional HD maps are updated quarterly.
Q: What makes 'Coverage?' unique? 
A: There are great apps out there that collect user submitted signal reports - we recommend them and use them ourselves. However, those apps are only useful in markets with an active user base. We took a different approach with Coverage? - we needed a tool to at least give us an idea of where signal should be - urban, rural, and out in the boonies.
--------------
Named 'Essential Tool' by Wired Magazine
** Winner - 'Most Useful App' - iOSDevCamp 
"this app can be indispensable" - Lifehacker.com
--------------
The maps in 'Coverage?' are provided in partnership with Ookla, and represent proprietary interpretations of the coverage reported by each carrier. You should not rely on the maps in Coverage to be perfectly precise or absolutely timely. 
Ongoing map updates have been free - but to support the ongoing development costs, we now allow customers to subscribe to higher resolution maps that will be updated more frequently. 
Coverage does not report or predict signal strength (there are great apps out there for that!). We can make no promises as to where you'll *actually* get signal.. there are too many variables - towers, device, terrain, weather, etc.
So… Got Coverage?
Additional information about The HD Maps Subscription:
This is an auto-renewable subscription, with a duration of one year. 
The subscription fee will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase, and will automatically renew each year unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period.
Current subscriptions may not be canceled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: http://www.twostepsbeyond.com/privacy/

What makes this decorating game special?
•Are there games like Toca but for designing princess worlds?
Yes! Place hundreds of furniture items anywhere, with resizing and rotating just like real interior design
•Can you actually use the decorated spaces?
Host tea parties in your parlors, read in your libraries - every space becomes playable

•You can build all the cool places

•No stressful rules or timers
•Soothing ASMR sounds while creating

•open-ended princess world builder
•decorating game where creations stay

bluejetty:00061519:ios.description:

bluejetty:00015074:ios.description:
Stay connected to your student’s school life anytime, anywhere. Campus Parent puts important academic information at your fingertips, with real-time access to announcements, assignments, attendance, grades, schedules, and more.
TO LOGIN:
1. Download the app
2. Search for your District Name and State – select your district from the list
3. Enter your Username and Password, provided by your school
4. If using a secure, private device, mark Stay Logged In to receive mobile push notifications, if enabled by your school
5. Click Log In!
NOTIFICATIONS:
Parents and guardians can set and receive alerts for grades, assignment scores, attendance changes, and more. 
SUPPORT:
Due to privacy concerns, Infinite Campus does not maintain individual login information. Contact your school or district if changes are needed. For other questions, visit https://www.infinitecampus.com/support/parents-and-students.
PLEASE NOTE:
Your district must use the Infinite Campus Student Information System, and an active Infinite Campus account is required.

bluejetty:00145966:ios.description:
AI penpals that feel like native friends. Tutor-level feedback on every single message. That's Sylvi.
You can even pick a penpal with the exact accent you want to have.
French (France and Canada)
Spanish (Spain, Mexico, Colombia, Puerto Rico, etc)
German
Italian
Portuguese (Portugal and Brazil)
English (UK, US, Australia)
More languages coming soon - follow our journey on @sylvi_app
Too shy to talk to a native speaker? Practice with AI penpals who know you well enough to ask about your day. Every message you send is corrected and explained in real time - not just flagged, but actually taught, so when the real moment comes, you're ready for it.
- Learn the phrases you need, for the life you lead
Build your vocabulary by saving words important to you. Test yourself daily to memorise them.
- Stay accountable with friends
Practice with your friends regardless of what language they're learning or what level they're at.
"I've used a lot of different language apps... but Sylvi has been the one I've been having the most success with growth-wise. At least from what my tutor tells me."
Can't bear to lose your streak?
We won't tell. If you've got a streak you can't bear to lose, message us at support@sylvi.ai and we'll transfer it straight to Sylvi.
Try us free for 1 week, then pick a subscription that works for you.
"I know grammar. I know all of these vocabularies, but you're kind of stuck in the middle of like - how do I become comprehensible? Then I found Sylvi" - Amira, UK
"I could say, 'I'm going to the cinema today'. Then if I do Sylvi tomorrow, my penpal will come back and say, 'so what film did you see at the cinema?'. I love the continuity. It's so clever." - James, US

bluejetty:00149052:ios.description:
Whisper of Shadow is a roguelike strategy idle game. In Whisper of Shadow, you will march through dangerous dungeons, face random events, summon heroes and fight against devils. 
In ancient times, gods promised to protect the human world. But humanity always seemed to find a way to drag the world into the abyss of corruption under the guise of noble pretenses...
The obsession with power and malevolent forces drove humanity to madness, engulfing homes in the flames of war, opening the gates of hell, and shattering the old order...
As the savior, you awaken in this dark world. Brace yourself to embark on a journey with heroes, uncover long-buried secrets, rescue humanity, and put a stop to this era of darkness!
*** The Pure Roguelike Dungeon Adventure ***
Whisper of Shadow provides everything you need for a roguelike dungeon adventure! Follow the storyline and march through the dangerous dungeon. Defeat the devil, find a way out and cliam your rewards! Remember, every decision you make during the adventure could bring you either rewards or curses. Be careful of what you wish for!
*** A Vast Open World of Darkness ***
From Magma Temple to Boreal Furnace, venture through the vast world of darkness. Experience a rich storyline and encounter hundreds of heroes. As the savior, you fight alongside with the heroes and save the day! Whisper of Shadow offers a huge amount of artistic and astonishing scenes & maps. Make sure to join in!
*** Use Your Wisdom ***
Summon, collect & grow with hundreds of heroes, forge your exclusive gear and create the perfect lineup! Customize your powerful squad through Whisper of Shadow's various build systems and ensure your great victory!

* See the current weather including description, icon, "feels like" temperature, wind speed, wind direction, humidity, precipitation, the day's high and low, and sunset and sunrise times.

* Switch between a 12-hour and a 24-hour clock.
* Uses heat mapping colors to beautifully showcase temperatures throughout the day and week.
* Easily add unlimited cities or locations anywhere in the world and see their weather details, including the local date, time, and time zone.
OTHER FEATURES INCLUDE:
* See each or all of your saved locations on a map!
* Reveal your local weather with a touch of the GPS icon.
* Quickly switch between Imperial and Metric units.
* Change wind direction based on personal preference
* Supports some Accessibility features including Larger Text.

bluejetty:00070548:ios.description:
Here is the English translation:
Welcome to Max it!
A redesigned app to be simpler, faster, and tailored to your needs. An optimized experience to make your daily life easier, with streamlined journeys and smoother access to your services. Whether you are an Orange customer or not, Max it is your everyday companion.
What's new:
Simple Mode / Advanced Mode: Choose the interface that suits you for a personalized navigation experience! Smooth Navigation: Swipe from one universe to another with a single gesture. Voice Assistant: Talk to Max it and let Tontoo guide you through your essential operations. Max Store: Access our partners' services all in one place through convenient mini-apps. Simplified Orange Money Registration: Open your account in just 3 quick steps! Transfer with Purpose: Easily add a reason to your money transfers for greater clarity. Organized Merchants & Billers: Finding your favorite services has never been easier! Simplified Pass Purchase: Top up your phone credit and buy your passes in the blink of an eye. Visual Data Tracking: Get a full overview of your phone usage at a glance. Quick Search: Find your services in just a few clicks. Enhanced Favorites: Save your preferred contacts, merchants, and cards for instant access during your transactions.
Your Orange offers
Top up credit and buy Passes for yourself or your loved ones. Enjoy exclusive 5G offers. Activate your options: roaming, international passes... Track your usage in real time: calls, SMS, internet. Home internet: fiber offers, Flybox passes, usage tracking, and complaints.
Your Orange Money wallet
Transfer money within Senegal and across UEMOA countries at the lowest rates on the market. Scan and pay for your purchases using QR Code. Pay your water, electricity bills, and much more with our many partners. Track your balance and transaction history in real time.
Your Orange Bank digital banking
Tik Tak Loan: borrow from 5,000 to 500,000 FCFA* at any time. Tik Tak Savings: save at your own pace, gross rate 3.5% excl. tax.
Your online store
Best prices on phones and mobile accessories. Netflix, PlayStation gift cards and many more.
Your TV content
Local and international content, live, pay per view on Max it TV. Never miss the best football championships available.
Great deals, exclusive offers, and Ibou and Tontoo always there 24/7.
*The loan approval decision and amount are at the sole discretion of Orange Bank.

bluejetty:00019060:ios.summary:

DragonVale is the original dragon-breeding park builder, raise mythical creatures from egg to elder and build a floating island paradise in the clouds. Fifteen ye
bluejetty:00019060:ios.description:
Breed two dragons. Find out what hatches. Then do it hundreds of times over!
DragonVale is the original dragon-breeding park builder, raise mythical creatures from egg to elder and build a floating island paradise in the clouds. Fifteen years on, players still haven't hatched everything.
---- BREED & DISCOVER ----
Every pairing is a question. Combine two dragons, wait for the egg, and find out what their elements produce together. Some results take minutes. Some take seasons. A few have taken the community years to crack.
• Hundreds of dragons to uncover, from common hatchlings to legendary rarities
• Elemental combinations that reward experimentation, not memorization
• The Dragonarium tracks every dragon you have bred, hatched, and raised
• Team up in the Cooperative Breeding Cave for dragons you cannot get alone
• Rare and limited dragons return only during specific events — miss one and you wait
• Twin and rift dragons for players who want the deep end of the collection
---- RAISE THEM ----
A dragon is not finished when it hatches. Feed it, level it, and watch it change.
• Grow and harvest Dragon Treats on your own farms to feed your collection
• Every dragon transforms through baby, juvenile, adult, and elder stages
• Each stage is drawn by hand — no recolors, no reused models
• Enter your dragons in races and send them on quests for treasure and Dragon Cash
• Higher-level dragons unlock better breeding results and bigger rewards
• Elder forms take real dedication and look like it
---- BUILD YOUR PARK ----
Your islands float above the clouds, and the layout is entirely yours.
• Expand across dozens of islands, each with its own habitats and terrain
• Match habitats to elements — fire, water, air, earth, lightning, and far stranger
• Decorate with hundreds of items, from topiaries and fountains to full attractions
• Rearrange anything, anytime — your park is never locked into one design
• Explore beyond the sky and chase Galaxy Dragons among the stars
---- SOMETHING NEW EVERY SEASON ----
DragonVale has run live events continuously for over a decade, and the calendar never repeats itself.
• Seasonal events bring new dragons, decorations, habitats, and activities
• Limited-time challenges with rewards you cannot get any other way
• Regular updates with genuinely new content, not just maintenance
• Returning favorites for players who missed them the first time around
---- PLAY WITH FRIENDS ----
• Visit friends' parks and see what they have managed to hatch
• Send gems and gifts to help each other along
• Share your rarest finds and compare Dragonariums
• Breed cooperatively for results neither of you could reach alone
---- MADE BY HAND ----
Every dragon in DragonVale started as a sketch on someone's desk.
• Spectacular visuals, sparkling animations, and eggs worth staring at
• Every egg, baby, juvenile, adult, and elder drawn frame by frame by our artists
• Each creature imagined by a person before a single line was ever drawn
• An original soundtrack composed and recorded by our award-winning composer
• Fifteen years of craft from a studio that has never taken the shortcut
Legend says dragons are fierce, fire-breathing monsters. DragonVale says otherwise. From cuddly hatchlings that fit in your hand to massive, time-bending elders that reshape the sky, these are creatures worth raising — and the park you build for them is worth showing off.
Whether you have five minutes to harvest treats or an afternoon to redesign an entire island, there is always something waiting. Start with two dragons and an empty stretch of sky. See where it goes.
Your park. Your dragons. Your DragonVale.
Download free and start hatching. Your first egg is already waiting.
_________________________________
PLEASE NOTE! Some game items can be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases. DragonVale requires an internet connection to play.

Your islands float above the clouds, and the layout is entirely yours.

• Expand across dozens of islands, each with its own habitats and terrain
• Match habitats to elements — fire, water, air, earth, lightning, and far stranger
• Decorate with hundreds of items, from topiaries and fountains to full attractions
• Rearrange anything, anytime — your park is never locked into one design
• Explore beyond the sky and chase Galaxy Dragons among the stars

---- SOMETHING NEW EVERY SEASON ----
DragonVale has run live events continuously for over a decade, and the calendar never repeats itself.

• Seasonal events bring new dragons, decorations, habitats, and activities
• Limited-time challenges with rewards you cannot get any other way
• Regular updates with genuinely new content, not just maintenance
• Returning favorites for players who missed them the first time around

---- PLAY WITH FRIENDS ----
• Visit friends' parks and see what they have managed to hatch
• Send gems and gifts to help each other along
• Share your rarest finds and compare Dragonariums
• Breed cooperatively for results neither of you could reach alone

---- MADE BY HAND ----
Every dragon in DragonVale started as a sketch on someone's desk.

• Spectacular visuals, sparkling animations, and eggs worth staring at
• Every egg, baby, juvenile, adult, and elder drawn frame by frame by our artists
• Each creature imagined by a person before a single line was ever drawn
• An original soundtrack composed and recorded by our award-winning composer
• Fifteen years of craft from a studio that has never taken the shortcut

Legend says dragons are fierce, fire-breathing monsters. DragonVale says otherwise. From cuddly hatchlings that fit in your hand to massive, time-bending elders that reshape the sky, these are creatures worth raising — and the park you build for them is worth showing off.
Whether you have five minutes to harvest treats or an afternoon to redesign an entire island, there is always something waiting. Start with two dragons and an empty stretch of sky. See where it goes.

Your park. Your dragons. Your DragonVale.

Download free and start hatching. Your first egg is already waiting.

Monitor the status of your locks and manage your home's access seamlessly from anywhere at any time.

Our goal is to provide you with the utmost convenience, trust, and safety for your smart living experience.
The Kwikset App is compatible with all Kwikset Halo and Kwikset Aura smart locks.

bluejetty:00183744:ios.description:
The new generation digital wallet Paycell and its advanced technologies are with you so that you can safely perform all your transactions, from shopping to money transfer, from QR code transactions to paying bills. Use Paycell to earn points while making your transactions, find instant solutions to your cash needs with the advantage of Ready to Use Limit, and benefit from special perks for all your financial needs!
Paycell's Special Advantages for You
● Opportunity to start using it without dealing with the application process.
● The fast-shopping experience for everyone regardless of operator and age limit.
● The ability to make bill payments from anywhere, anytime, without waiting in line.
● Freedom to shop from anywhere with Paycell, a ready-to-use virtual card with a prepaid card feature.
● Shopping experience with individually defined limits at contracted Paycell points.
● Advantageous shopping everywhere with hundreds of different campaigns.
● The practicality of transferring money to IBAN or mobile phone numbers anytime, anywhere.
● Ease of making the next purchases faster by saving all the debit and credit cards you use. 
● Opportunity to load balance to IstanbulKart; TL and packages to your Turkcell line. 
● Being able to gift yourself or your friends by quickly getting gift cards from dozens of different brands.
Earn As You Spend with Paycell
You can earn points for all transactions you make with Paycell. By saving the points you earn, you can turn them into an internet package via Hediye Dünyam.
Customized Ready Limit (Hazır Limit)
A special limit is granted for you in the digital wallet Paycell. You can use the granted Ready Limit whenever you want. Paycell Ready Limit is always with you from shopping to cash needs. One app for Samsung, LG, VIZIO, Sony, TCL, Fire TV...

bluejetty:00066113:ios.description:
100+ featured game layouts, 21 backgrounds, 6 tile sets, and all FREE!!!
Mahjong Unlimited now dynamically adjusts difficulty of game generation engine according to players' game stats. Manual difficulty switch is also provided for individual preference.
Mahjong Unlimited is a classic but addictive matching game. The goal of the game is to clean all tiles out of the board by selecting pairs of tiles with the same drawing.
Mahjong Unlimited is able to generate almost unlimited number of games from any layout with solutions, not just shuffling tiles based on limited number of preloaded game sequence or simply randomize tiles to generate a game that may not be solvable. We guarantee that all the game generated by Mahjong Unlimited are solvable. Mahjong Unlimited's solitary game has no time limit. Just take your time and enjoy the game.
Mahjong Unlimited also provides comprehensive game stats for serious players. Game stats will be consistently uploaded to Game Center. You can judge your skill level by comparing your numbers to other players' game stats in Game Center.
Except regular solitary games, Mahjong Unlimited now provides both online & local match modes for you to play online with other players in the world or play locally with friends on different iOS devices.
Mahjong Unlimited features:
* iCloud support
* Game Center support for online game match, leaderboard, and achievements.
* Local match game.
* In-game puzzle generation, not just shuffling tiles from limited game templates. 
* Game generation engine designed for both senior players and beginners, unlimited numbers of games can be produced from the same layout. You can hardly play the same game.
* It is guaranteed that all the puzzles can be solved even without shuffle.
* Shuffle function.
* Demo mode to demonstrate the solution of every puzzle.
* Undo/Hint without penalty.
* Dynamic difficulty adjustment based on players' game stats. 
* Easy layouts for beginners.
* "Visual aid" option to highlight free tiles.
* High quality tile/background pictures.
* Tile sets without Chinese characters.
* Designed from the ground up for the iPad, iPhone, and iPod Touch.
* Fully unleash the power of Retina high quality displays on iPad/iPhone/iPod Touch.
* All the contents/functions of Mahjong Unlimited are free to play.

bluejetty:00123665:ios.description:
Bring your friends and dive into the adventure for even more rewards! 
In AFK Arena: Companions, you'll get 1,000+ summons, join the "Get All Heroes" event, borrow top-tier heroes from friends, take on tougher new campaign challenges, try out new co-op modes, explore the upgraded beast system, and discover tons of other new features.
Meanwhile, the original AFK Arena's most popular modes and challenges are making a triumphant comeback! Your classic server heroes are ready to join the fight in AFK Arena: Companions. There's no better time than now to rejoin the adventure!
【Get All Heroes】
No more worries about missing out on your favorite heroes! The "Get All Heroes" event is live. Progress through the campaign mode to unlock all your beloved heroes.
【1,000+ Summons】
 Log in now for a chance of 10 summons every day, with a total exceeding 1,000. No more diamond worries. Just summon to your heart's content!
【Share Heroes with Friends】
Skip the grind. In AFK Arena: Companions, you can borrow strong heroes from your teammates, streamline your resources, and win faster with less effort.
【Enhanced Beast System】
Discover, capture, and train beasts to unlock a variety of powerful abilities. Combine their unique attributes to craft your own beast and turn the tide of battle!
Join us now in AFK Arena: Companions and embark on your delightful adventures!
About Subscriptions and Apple Website Subscriptions
1. Pricing & Billing Cycle
Enable “Subscription (Weekly)” within the game for $0.99 a week, which will be billed weekly (every 7 days). (Price may vary depending on your location.)
Enable “Subscription (Monthly)” within the game for $2.99 a week, which will be billed every natural month (every 30 days). (Price may vary depending on your location.)
2. Subscription Content
Subscribers will be eligible for certain perks during the subscription period, including:
- Team Bounty Quests +1
- Increases AFK Rewards Gold Quantity By +10%
- Increases King’s Tower Mercenary Uses By +1
- Increases Faction Tower Mercenary Uses By +1
- Increases Campaign Mercenary Uses By +1
- Guild Coin Drop Quantity +10%
- Labyrinth Token Drop Quantity +10%
3. Automatic Subscription Renewal
The App Store subscription is auto-renewed with payment confirmed via your iTunes Account. Users can manage the auto-renew manually through the iTunes/Apple ID Settings Manager. The subscription will auto-renew for the assigned billing period if the auto-renew feature is not turned off 24 hours before the current subscription expires.
4. User Agreement and Privacy Policy
User Agreement https://afk-artworks.lilithgames.com/en/service.html
Privacy Statement http://www.lilithgames.com/privacy_lilith.html
5. Subscription Cancellation
If you would like to cancel your subscription, go to ‘Settings’ on your iOS device --> ‘iTunes & App Store’ --> tap ‘Apple ID’ and then ‘View Apple ID’. Enter ‘Account Settings’, tap ‘Subscriptions’ --> ‘Manage’ and select the subscription for ‘AFK Arena’ to cancel it.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: http://www.lilithgames.com/privacy_lilith.html
