bluejetty:00138254:ios.summary:
O GRANA É A SOLUÇÃO DE IR recomendada pela B3 que recebeu investimento da própria Bolsa brasileira.
O QUE O GRANA FAZ:
- Preenchimento automático da sua Declaração de IRPF
- Cálculo mensal de DARF
- Verificação de pendências desde 2020
bluejetty:00138254:ios.description:
O GRANA É A SOLUÇÃO DE IR recomendada pela B3 que recebeu investimento da própria Bolsa brasileira.
O QUE O GRANA FAZ:
- Preenchimento automático da sua Declaração de IRPF
- Cálculo mensal de DARF
- Verificação de pendências desde 2020 
- Ferramenta para redução legal do seu IR.
Além disso, com o Grana, você acompanha gratuitamente:
- Seus dividendos detalhados
- A rentabilidade consolidada dos seus investimentos
- Sua performance comparada à de outros investidores
- Seu lucro ou prejuízo não realizado
E mais: só no Grana, você descobre se a sua rentabilidade foi maior ou menor do que a de outros investidores.
QUEM USA O GRANA
Gustavo Cerbasi, Professor Mira e milhares de investidores usam e aprovam o Grana.
TESTE GRÁTIS por 7 dias, sem precisar cadastrar o cartão de crédito.
SAIBA MAIS: Declaração Automática Grana
Declare seus investimentos na bolsa em menos de 5 minutos com nossa ferramenta de preenchimento automático do IRPF 2025. Veja como funciona:
1. O Grana importa seus dados diretamente do sistema da B3, de forma oficial e segura.
2. O Grana gera um arquivo para você importar no programa oficial do IRPF 2025.
3. Você importa o nosso arquivo no programa do IRPF e pronto! Seus dados de investimentos da bolsa estarão preenchidos e você poderá seguir com a entrega da sua declaração.
SEGURANÇA
Nosso sistema foi homologado pela B3, o que garante que cumprimos os altos critérios de segurança exigidos para o processamento dos dados.
Além disso, a B3 recomenda nossa solução e investiu no Grana por considerar que o app traz uma solução relevante para os investidores brasileiros, especialmente em relação a Imposto de Renda.
TUDO AUTOMÁTICO
Ative a importação automática dos seus dados da B3 e pronto! Você não precisa carregar notas de corretagem nem preencher dados manualmente.
O Grana é a única calculadora de IR do Brasil que automatiza todas as etapas do IR da bolsa: cálculo, pagamento e declaração.
O cálculo do seu IR mensal é atualizado diariamente a partir dos dados que nosso sistema recebe da B3, com a sua autorização, e o pagamento do DARF pode ser feito direto no app, via Pix ou cartão de crédito – vantagem exclusiva do Grana.
Sua declaração de investimentos da bolsa também pode ser preenchida de forma automática a partir da importação direta do nosso arquivo no seu programa da Receita Federal.
REDUÇÃO DO SEU IR
Quando o sistema identifica que suas operações geraram lucro tributável, o Otimizador de IR sugere operações que podem reduzir o imposto devido por meio da isenção legal, sem alterar a composição da sua carteira.
Esta funcionalidade é exclusiva do Grana.
ATIVOS CONTEMPLADOS
O Grana calcula o Imposto de Renda de Ações, FIIs, ETFs, BDRs, Opções e Mercado futuro (IND, WIN, DOL, WDO, BIT e CCM).
PLANOS
Mais Grana Anual:
É o nosso plano mais completo. Inclui a Declaração Automática Grana, o Otimizador de IR, a IA do Grana e todas as demais funções do aplicativo.
Grana IR Anual:
Inclui relatório com todos os seus dados do IR da bolsa para você copiar e colar no programa da Receita Federal, mas não inclui a Declaração Automática Grana. Também inclui o cálculo de IR Mensal retroativo desde janeiro/2020 com opções de pagamento via Pix ou cartão, mas não inclui o Otimizador de IR nem a IA do Grana.
Grana IA Anual:
Inclui as funcionalidades de IA do Grana: Diagnóstico de riscos da sua carteira, criação de alertas personalizados e outras funcionalidades de consolidação de carteira que estão presentes nos demais planos pagos, mas não inclui as soluções de IR.
Baixe agora e resolva gratuitamente seu IR deste mês – aproveite nosso período de 7 dias de teste grátis.

bluejetty:00021332:ios.name: CalPrint for iPhone
bluejetty:00021332:ios.summary: Print your Calendar and Reminders from your iPhone. You can print your Day, Week, Month and custom list calendar views to ANY printer, not just AirPrint. Email your calendar or reminders as a PDF file to share with others. Print out your mo
bluejetty:00021332:ios.description:
Print your Calendar and Reminders from your iPhone. You can print your Day, Week, Month and custom list calendar views to ANY printer, not just AirPrint. Email your calendar or reminders as a PDF file to share with others. Print out your monthly calendar and stick it to the fridge or office wall. Print out a shared family reminder shopping list.
Full support for Shortcuts eg. "Print today", "Print tomorrow", "Print this week", "Print this month" 
Print maps and driving directions for appointments.
Add, delete and edit your appointments inside CalPrint and print them out straight away. Choose from a range of print options, including layout, mini calendar inserts, text size, single page and more.
Create a list view of upcoming appointments for the next week, month or any date range you choose. Each appointment is itemized and printed in a list.
There is no need to setup calendars as CalPrint uses your existing calendar on your iPhone or iPad. Google Calendar, Exchange and other calendar formats are all supported.
FULL CALENDAR FUNCTIONALITY
• Choose which calendars to display and print
• Email your calendar views as PDF files
• Search for events and print the results
• Easy scroll the week view
• Quickly zoom to a day in month view
• Easily create new appointments
• Print event maps and driving directions
• Print your calendar as a PDF for use in other apps
• Utilizes existing calendars, no new calendar setup needed.
• View and Print by Day/Week/Month and a custom list view
REMINDER FUNCTIONALITY
• Choose which reminder lists to display and print
• Print your shopping list, to do list, or other lists shared with your family
• Filter by scheduled and completed
• Search for text in reminders to filter results
• Email your reminder lists as PDF files
FULLY FUNCTIONAL PRINTING
• Print to ALL printers (Network/WiFi/USB/Bluetooth) via your Mac or PC or direct to most WiFi printers without additional software. Also print to Apple AirPrint printers.
• USB & Bluetooth printers can be used with free print server software (Windows & Mac)
• Print remotely via 3G/4G
• Print using ALL the same document formats to ALL printers used by your Mac/PC

Pic.Vid : AI Photo Video Maker is a powerful AI-based application that transforms your photos into stunning, high-quality videos with realistic motion, effects, and animations. Designed for creators, social media users, and anyone who loves visual storytelling, Pic.Vid makes it easy to convert static images into engaging AI-generated videos in just a few taps.

You can upload photos from your gallery or capture new images directly within the app. After generating your video, easily preview, edit, and fine-tune the output to match your style. The app ensures fast processing while maintaining excellent visual quality.

Features
- AI-powered photo to video conversion
- Realistic motion and gesture effects
- Trending AI video templates and styles
- Easy photo upload and instant results
- High-quality video output
- Simple and user-friendly interface

bluejetty:00131933:ios.description:
**Features the latest, 20th Edition Content**
The most trusted brand in medical content delivered on a concise, easy-to-navigate platform. 
Derived from the best-selling internal medicine reference in the world, Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, this popular reference delivers fast, to-the-point guidance on the clinical problems seen in everyday practice. The Manual also includes abundant quick reference tables, plus concise text―providing rapid access to bedside information when decisions need to be made quickly. This feature-rich summary guide covers all diseases and conditions commonly seen in inpatient general medicine, so you can be sure to find invaluable content directly to your workflow and practice.
Harrison's Manual of Medicine for Mobile + Web features:
• Latest 20th edition 
• Quick reference tables, and charts
• Highlight and make notes within any entry
• Detailed diagnostic guidelines
• Up-to-date treatment recommendations
• Improved index for more straightforward navigation on your device
• Universal Index and Full Text Searches guarantee you find topics quickly

Editors: J. Larry Jameson, MD, PhD; Anthony S. Fauci, MD; Dennis L. Kasper, MD; Stephen L. Hauser, MD; Dan L. Longo, MD; Joseph Loscalzo, MD, PhD

bluejetty:00019499:ios.description:
IMPORTANT 
DOES NOT support: iPhone 5S, iPad Air, iPad Mini 2 & 3 and iPod Touch
Interpret the law as you see fit in This Is the Police 2, sequel to the acclaimed noir drama This Is the Police! Run the sheriff’s department, manage your cops, investigate, interrogate, and incarcerate. Make tough decisions – and try to keep out of prison yourself! – in this story-driven mixture of adventure, strategy, and turn-based tactical combat.
Is it a simulation? A management game? A tactical challenge? A visual novel? A puzzle? It’s all of these, and more!
Dive into one-of-a-kind -story-driven experience.
Welcome to Sharpwood, a cold and harsh border town riven with violence, where no one is completely innocent. Smugglers, gangs, and screaming populists call this town their home. To maintain peace and order, the young sheriff Lilly Reed (Sarah Hamilton) will have to team up with fugitive criminal Jack Boyd (Jon St. John), and pray that her dangerous plan doesn’t spiral out of control.
Take charge of the Sheriff’s department.
Your subordinates aren’t just some resource; they are living people with their own strengths, weaknesses, fears, and prejudices – and you'll have to reckon with all of them in order to survive. Is one of your guys drinking too much? Or always coming up with excuses for not coming to work? Or does he refuse to follow orders? You’ll have to show a steady hand if you want to impose discipline on this department.
Engage in tactical combat.
During your most dangerous operations, the game will switch to turn-based combat. Gather a team of your finest cops. Carefully study the terrain, adapt your plans, stealthily approach your suspects and use non-lethal weapons and equipment – if the situation allows. True, sometimes gunfights are almost impossible to avoid, but be careful: This Is the Police 2 doesn’t have hit points. A single bullet can cost a cop their life.
Become a true detective.
Collect evidence, study case materials, interrogate suspects and send the criminals to court. And if the suspect was innocent? Perhaps it's time to find out if any Sharpwood judges can be bought.
Thank you for playing ‘THIS IS THE POLICE 2’!

bluejetty:00086588:ios.description:
Quiz Crush: Trivia, Fun & Friendship!
Join the next generation of trivia games with Quiz Crush! Answer thousands of fun questions, use superpowers to gain an advantage, and make new friends along the way. Quiz Crush is more than just a trivia game—it’s a platform where you can test your knowledge and build friendships!
Trivia and Friendship 
Quiz Crush combines the excitement of trivia with a social experience. Not only do you answer questions, but you also meet new people and make friends. Every question can be the start of a new conversation, where you can showcase your knowledge and build connections!
Swipe to Choose Your Opponent, Let the Fun Begin!
Quiz Crush's innovative swipe feature allows you to choose your opponents and start the competition! Swipe to select your rivals and open the door to both competitive fun and new friendships. Enjoy the thrill of competition with your opponents and experience the joy of matching—"It's a Match!"
Meet Crush Mode!
In Crush Mode, test your knowledge while making new friends. In this turn-based mode, defeat your opponents with challenging questions and outsmart them with superpowers. Show off your smarts and build fun friendships!
Stand Out with Super Invite!
Want to show someone you really want to play with them? Use the "Super Invite" feature to make them stand out and grab their attention! Super Invite shows how eager you are to compete with them and helps you create more interactions.
Exciting Gameplay with Superpowers 
While answering questions, use superpowers to challenge your opponents and gain an edge! Positive powers boost your score, while negative powers like mud or ice give you the upper hand. Trivia has never been this strategic and fun!
Invite Friends and Compete Together 
Create your own room and invite your friends for a fun trivia showdown. Whether it’s a one-on-one match or a group competition, Quiz Crush guarantees unlimited fun! Test your knowledge and enjoy quality time with friends.
Knowledge Across All Categories 
Test your knowledge across General Culture, Cinema, TV, Football, Literature, Science, and more. Quiz Crush offers an educational and entertaining trivia experience for everyone. Stay sharp and expand your knowledge with diverse and up-to-date questions!
Climb the Ranks and Make Your Name Known! 
Join the leagues and show your knowledge to the world. Earn titles like Genius, Scholar, and Professor, and reach the top of the leaderboard. Every victory brings you closer to higher ranks and new rewards!
Why Play Quiz Crush?
-Test your knowledge with thousands of up-to-date trivia questions.
-Make new friends while enjoying the game.
-Use superpowers to outsmart your opponents and enjoy the game.
-Swipe to choose your opponents and start playing immediately.
-Stand out with Super Invite and show how much you want to play.
-Climb the ranks and become the genius of the game.
-Create your own room and compete with your friends.
Quiz Crush: Showcase Your Knowledge and Friendship Skills! Download now and take your place in the world of trivia and fun!

bluejetty:00036129:ios.description:
Tired of swiping with no results? Flit is dating done differently.
Discover people near you and start real conversations — not just collect matches that go nowhere. With Flit, every conversation starts with your approval and every first impression counts.
HOW IT WORKS
You decide who gets to talk to you. Every conversation starts only when you accept. Then you take turns — a short intro of a few messages each — so both sides get a genuine first impression before the full chat opens up.
MULTIPLE WAYS TO BREAK THE ICE
Not everyone connects the same way. Flit gives you different formats to start a conversation:
• STICKERS & EMOJIS — skip the awkward "hey" and let fun stickers do the talking
• PHOTO MESSAGES — share a moment, a vibe, a smile — one photo says it all
• VIDEO INTROS — record a short clip to show your personality and stand out
• CLASSIC TEXT — when you know exactly what to say
WHY PEOPLE LOVE FLIT
• No endless swiping — browse profiles and start a conversation when you feel a connection
• People near you — meet singles who are actually in your area
• You're in control — no one writes to you unless you allow it
• Fresh and fun — multiple ways to connect keep things interesting
FLIT uses auto-renewing subscriptions — a subscription is required to access all features.
• Weekly, monthly, and annual plans are available
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Auto-renewal can be canceled anytime in Apple Store settings

Astonishing Football is just like football, but on your smartphone or tablet. Become the manager of your own football team, and lead your players to the ultimate reward: becoming the best coach and winning the Football Cup!
The squad of your dreams
Astonishing Football allows you to create the team you've always dreamed of. Make trades with the greedy other teams of the league, or sign free agents during the offseason. Draft talented prospects and elevate them to the rank of all-star during the Legends Contest. You're the coach!

bluejetty:00120398:ios.description:
Learn Salah/Namaz from scratch, memorize surahs of the Quran, learn Dua, and check prayer times. Suitable for beginners.
What is Namaz?
Namaz is the daily muslim prayer, also known as Salat or Salah. It is one of the five pillars of Islam and the best way of worshipping Allah the Almighty.
Description:
This app is an audio player for you to listen to the correct pronunciation of the prayers in Arabic. It will help you to learn the dua-invocations and parts of the Quran that are read inside the prayer. You will also have the texts in English transliteration and some illustrations to help you navigate through the process. All content is in accordance with the rules of the Hanafi school of law.
Important to understand, that this is a companion app, and it is not sufficient to fully learn the prayer on its own. We also strongly recommend that you learn to read Arabic, as English letters and phonemes are not sufficient to convey all sounds found in Arabic. Learning to read Arabic will allow you to perform your prayers in the best way and will give you access to the Holy Quran. The easiest and most effective way to learn both prayer and reading Arabic is to find a good teacher.

bluejetty:00146120:ios.description:
Welcome to the exciting world of Coin Sort, the ultimate coin sorting puzzle game that will put your skills to the test! Are you ready to engage your brain, enhance your strategy thinking, and embark on a captivating coin-sorting adventure? Let's dive in!
Coin Sort offers an addictive and thrilling gaming experience where precision and quick thinking are key. Your task is to sort and merge similar coins in a strategic manner to maximize your rewards and unlock new levels. you must think fast and organize the coins within a specific timeframe. Immerse yourself in the game's user-friendly grid gameplay adorned with captivating graphics and immersive sound effects. As you progress, the variety of coins with distinct colors, numbers, and sizes adds a visual delight to the game.
Explore various sorting techniques to conquer the puzzles. You can drag coins to swap their positions, group them together by tapping, or rearrange entire rows and columns to strategize your moves. Your objective is to create matches of ten coins of the same denomination to collect points and advance through levels. Successfully matched and merged coins vanish from the grid, making space for new coins to cascade from above.
Reap the rewards of your dedication with daily bonuses and achievements. Unlock new levels and showcase your exceptional matching skills.
Get ready to experience the perfect blend of sorting, strategy, speed, and precision in Coin Sort. This game is a haven for puzzle enthusiasts and match gamers alike. Train your brain, enhance your concentration, and challenge yourself to reach new heights. It's time to sort, merge, and emerge victorious! 
Download Coin Sort now and start your coin-sorting journey today
....................................................................................................................
Subscription Terms for Coin Sort
Subscription Availability: We offer a weekly subscription at a cost of US $4.99, which does not need to include a trial period.
Features Unlocked with Subscription: Subscribing unlocks several premium features:
 1-Ad-Free Experience: Enjoy an uninterrupted gaming experience with our Ad-Free feature.
 2-Daily coins: Receive a daily boost of 1000 coins for enhanced game play.
 3-Skip-able Tickets: Access 25 Skip-able Tickets to effortlessly bypass ads and navigate the game at your pace.
Subscription Renewal:
Billing: After confirming your purchase, the payment will be charged to your account.
Auto-Renewal: Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Renewal Terms: The renewal retains the same duration as the original subscription period (weekly).
Renewal Charges: Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, with the renewal cost specified.
Management: Users can manage their subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by accessing their account settings after purchase.
Cancellation Policy: Once subscribed, the current subscription period cannot be cancelled.
Cancelling a Trial or Subscription: To cancel a subscription during its free trial, you must do so through your account in the store at least 24 hours before the trial period ends to avoid charges.
Further Information and Support: For more details,

bluejetty:00091248:ios.description:
Dive into the world of airport management and create your ultimate Idle Airport Empire!
Your journey as an Airline Tycoon is about to begin! In this placement management game, you'll be at the helm of an airport, managing a busy terminal, scheduling numerous flights, serving passengers from all over the globe, and turning a small airport into a bustling international hub. From managing passenger traffic to expanding terminals, create a world-class airline empire where the sky is no longer the limit!
Game Features
 - Building Expansion: Design airports, upgrade facilities and unlock new terminals to accommodate more flights and passengers.
 - Flight Management: Schedule flights, manage flight schedules, improve aircraft turnover efficiency, ensure smooth operations, and experience the fun of real airport operations.
 - Passenger Service: Increase customer satisfaction by adding lounges, restaurants and other facilities.
 - Aircraft Upgrades: Unlock and manage different types of aircraft, including private jets, large passenger jets and cargo fleets, to meet diverse aviation needs.
 - Global Routes: Expand your network by opening up new routes to exotic destinations and expanding your flight paths to increase your airport's visibility and profitability.
 - Idle Revenue: Earn revenue even when you're offline! Make your airports run automatically and have fun managing them.
 - Challenging Events: Participate in special events, complete tasks and unlock exclusive rewards to enrich your gaming experience.
 - Detailed Optimization: Upgrade the terminal halls and build cargo centers to win the praise of passengers with the most meticulous management.
 - Share Glory: Showcase your airport design with screenshots and share your success with friends. Join the vibrant aviation community and write your own airport history!
From building the runway to managing the terminal, you control every detail! Enhance passenger satisfaction, optimize airport operations, and use your intelligence and strategy to make the airport's efficiency reach its peak!
Whether you're a casual gamer who enjoys placement games or a simulation enthusiast with a passion for strategic management, Airline Tycoon: Airport Manager has something for you!
Are you ready to take off and conquer the skies? Download now and start your journey! Embark on your journey to become an aviation tycoon and create the busiest and most efficient airport ever!

bluejetty:00061904:ios.name: iCircuit
bluejetty:00061904:ios.summary: iCircuit is the premier iPhone and iPad app for designing, simulating, and learning analog and digital electronics. Its advanced simulation engine provides real-time, always-on analysis so your circuits stay powered and live, just like work
bluejetty:00061904:ios.description:
iCircuit is the premier iPhone and iPad app for designing, simulating, and learning analog and digital electronics. Its advanced simulation engine provides real-time, always-on analysis so your circuits stay powered and live, just like working with real components.
Use it like a CAD tool: add components, wire them up, and set their properties. But iCircuit is unlike typical CAD apps because it is always simulating. You do not stop to take a measurement or spend time configuring reports. Instead, you just play with the circuit as you normally would, with the power on.
Build circuits with over 300 components, from simple resistors and LEDs to programmable Arduinos (Uno, Nano, Mega, ESP8266, ESP32), Raspberry Pi Pico boards running real MicroPython and CircuitPython, PIC microcontrollers, and 60 4000/7400-series digital ICs (more available with Pro). Connect elements, adjust values, and instantly see the results.
BUILT-IN TEST EQUIPMENT 
• Multimeter: Probe any point to read voltage, current, and power 
• Oscilloscope: Track multiple signals with touch-controlled time scale, stacked/unstacked views, FFT analysis, and Bode plots 
• Gauges: Visualize voltages, currents, and frequencies directly in your circuit 
• Signal generators and configurable sources 
EXTENSIVE COMPONENT LIBRARY 
• Raspberry Pi Pico and Pico 2 running genuine MicroPython and CircuitPython firmware 
• Programmable Arduinos (Uno, Nano, Mega, ESP8266, ESP32) 
• Programmable PIC microcontrollers (assembly and HEX files, more available with Pro) 
• Power: Voltage regulators (78xx, LM317), sources, dependent sources, power jacks, and simulated antennas 
• Analog: Resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, BJTs, MOSFETs, thermistors, triodes, and tetrodes 
• Digital: Logic gates (AND, OR, NAND, NOR, XOR), JK and D flip-flops, and 60 4000/7400-series ICs (180+ available with Pro) 
• ADCs and DACs 
• Sensors and displays: LEDs, 7-segment, NeoPixels, matrix displays, thermistors 
• Electromechanical: Motors, servos, SPST/SPDT and DPST/DPDT switches, push buttons, relays, and speakers 
SPICE, VERILOG, AND VHDL
Import vendor SPICE models and subcircuits and use them as components. Write Verilog or VHDL in the HDL element and wire it to the rest of your circuit.
CREATE CUSTOM ELEMENTS
Build sub-circuits and custom elements to componentize your designs and create reusable modules. Share your custom elements with others via the iCircuit Gallery.
AUDIO SIMULATION
Hear your circuits. Speakers, buzzers, and microphones produce real audio output.
Perfect for students learning electronics, hobbyists prototyping projects, and engineers validating designs, all without burning out a single component.
ABOUT ICIRCUIT PRO (OPTIONAL)
iCircuit is a complete app with a one-time purchase. iCircuit Pro is optional and adds extra components (including more PICs and a larger 4000/7400 IC library) and helps fund ongoing development. Pro is not required for core simulation or everyday circuit design.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00174177:ios.summary:
The soccer referee app that combines timer, notebook and performance tracking into a single, easy-to-use app, which you can use on your smartwatch or phone, letting you concentrate on the match.

bluejetty:00174177:ios.description:
The soccer referee app that combines timer, notebook and performance tracking into a single, easy-to-use app, which you can use on your smartwatch or phone, letting you concentrate on the match.
See your Assignr and Ref Insight matches directly in the REFSIX app!
REFSIX Features:
- Add matches and rosters on your iPhone
- Create matches for 5-a-side to 11-a-side football
- Choose half length from 5 mins to 45 mins as well as the half time interval
- Select if the match has extra time or penalties
- Create templates of matches for different competitions
- Add lineups for the game
- Record match incidents in game on your smartwatch or phone
- Record temporary dismissals (sin-bins) and be notified when the time is completed
- Continuous timer, additional time timer and half time timer
- Record injury time with a tap of the screen
- Optionally record goal scorers
- See all match incidents on your phone after the match
- See your total distance covered
- Track your fitness through the Apple Health and Activity apps
Referee’s Process
- Automatically see your upcoming matches from Assignr and Ref Insight or alternatively you can add them into the iPhone app manually.
- On match day, select the match, add rosters and send to your smartwatch or phone
- During the match you can record all of the key match incidents including goals, cards and substitutions as well as track the game time and injury time
- After the match you can view a match report on your phone
- The results page automatically updates giving you a running record of all of your matches
REFSIX PRO is the advanced version of REFSIX that gives you enhanced analysis of your performance with the ability to see: 
- Your positioning on a heatmap
- The location of your cards on the pitch
- Your heart rate through the match
- The distance covered in each half as well as every 5 minutes
- View distance of walking, running, jogging and sprinting
- View season and career statistics screen including average cards given per match
REFSIX PRO also gives you even more functionality. With REFSIX PRO you'll get every feature in the free tier as well as the ability to:
- Choose up to 3 timers from countup, countdown, elapsed and additional timers
- Select team colours
- Referee games with quarters
REFSIX PRO is available with a monthly or annual subscription (price available in-app). You can subscribe and pay through your iTunes account. Payment will be charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renew may be turned off after purchase by going to the ‘Manage Subscription’ page in settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. The subscription will renew at the same cost. 
Terms of service: https://refsix.com/terms-conditions/
Privacy policy: https://refsix.com/terms-conditions-1/
FAQs
+ Can I use REFSIX without a smartwatch?
Yes, you can use your phone in a match if you don’t have a compatible smartwatch.
+ Do I need my phone with me while refereeing a match if I’m using a smartwatch?
No, we’ve designed the app to work in such a way you only need your smartwatch with you on the pitch. You can sync data between your iPhone and smartwatch before and after the match.
+ Do I need access to wi-fi or an internet connection?
No, on match day no internet connection is necessary. 
+ What if I don't receive teamsheets before a game?
No problem, you can simply select player numbers without player names.

listings.name: Learn Polish For Beginners
listings.description:
Learn the Polish language for travel, study, work and everyday life. Start with the Polish alphabet, build your vocabulary and practice useful phrases at your own pace. Read words alongside English meanings, then listen to the recordings and repeat aloud.

HOW YOU LEARN
1. Choose a chapter, follow 15 Smart Levels or pick a Mini Course: Starter Pack, Travel Basics, Food & Restaurant, Family & Home, or Health & Emergency.
2. Open a lesson and move through its learning cards. Read the Polish word and English meaning, then tap to listen.
3. Choose the Zofia or Filip voice and adjust playback speed. Save words to Favorites and find vocabulary with Instant Search.
4. Review with flashcards, mark words you know, and practice with multiple-choice quizzes, True/False, word matching and typed-answer writing exercises.
5. Return to your saved progress, check in each day and build a routine with streaks and a daily reminder, with notification permission.

26 CHAPTERS, 252 LESSONS
Explore these chapters, with selected lesson examples:

• Foundation: Alphabets; Referential Words; Hello, Goodbye Phrases; Basic Numbering I; Days of the Week.
• Humanity: Body Structure; Facial Features.
• Adornments: Exterior Garments; Shoes & Boots.
• Cuisine: Beverages; Prepared Meals; Eating Establishments.
• Kinship: Kin & Extended Family; Domestic Living.
• Emotions: Sentiments & Moods; Chat & Dialogue.
• Pharmaceuticals: Illnesses & Conditions; Medical Professionals.
• Living Spaces: City Transit; Retail & Purchasing; Currency & Finance.
• Dwelling: Home Furnishings; Cooking Area; Home Improvement.
• Human Endeavors: Workspace; Trade & Shipping; Telephonic Talks.
• Human Tasks II: Media Outlets; Farming & Cultivation.
• Occupations: Corporate Professionals; Customer Service Careers.
• Athletics: Fitness Center; Soccer.
• Learning: Educational Institution; International Tongues.
• Creative Expressions: Film Industry; Written Works & Verse.
• Journey: Journeys & Voyages; Lodging; Outdoor Pursuits.
• Machinery: Digital Device; Online Network & Electronic Mail.
• Vehicles: Aircraft; Rail Vehicle; Flight Terminal.
• Automobiles: Automobile Varieties; Road Symbols.
• Milestones: Festivals & Celebrations; Streets, Paths & Navigation.
• Natural World: Main Compass Points; Marine Bodies.
• Planet Earth: Climate & Atmosphere Conditions; Cold Season & Snowfall.
• Animal Kingdom: Household Pets & Livestock; Aquatic Life & Sea Creatures.
• Plant Life: Blooms & Vegetation; Grain Crops & Seeds.
• Terrains: West European Nations; Urban Areas & Metropolises.
• Varied Topics: Miscellaneous Handy Terms; Descriptive Words & Qualifiers I.

MAKE POLISH PART OF YOUR DAY
Explore nouns and phrases collections. See check-in and learning days on a monthly calendar. Choose light or dark mode and a color theme, including Sunset. Export a manual backup of favorites, progress and included settings, then import a compatible backup when needed. Replay the introduction without losing your learning data.

HELP IS CLOSE BY
Spotted an audio, translation or example problem? Tap the flag on a word to prepare a support email with its chapter and lesson details. For app issues, purchases or suggestions, open Settings > Feedback & Support or email support@dugloapps.app.

No account registration is required. Bundled lessons and recordings work offline after installation. Purchases, ads and sending support email require internet access. The app uses an English interface and English meanings.

Some learning content is available without a purchase. Access to all lessons and premium features requires an in-app subscription or one-time purchase.

bluejetty:00157239:ios.summary: Sonia is an AI built for mental health and emotional support. Whether you're dealing with stress, anxiety, relationship problems, family conflict, low motivation, or just a hard day, Sonia gives you a private, judgment-free space to talk it
bluejetty:00157239:ios.description:
Sonia is an AI built for mental health and emotional support. Whether you're dealing with stress, anxiety, relationship problems, family conflict, low motivation, or just a hard day, Sonia gives you a private, judgment-free space to talk it through. Speak by voice or write by text—whatever feels right.
Sonia is built for long-term emotional wellbeing. It remembers what you share, recognizes patterns over time, and turns reflection into insight, next steps, and a support plan that's actually tailored to you. The more you talk, the more it understands your story—your goals, your habits, and the kind of care and emotional support that actually helps.
How is Sonia built?
Most AI was built for general conversation. Sonia was built specifically for mental health, self-help, and emotional wellbeing. Our AI is trained with expert-guided feedback, cognitive-behavioral principles, evidence-based reflection, mindfulness, and human psychology—so it can help you reflect, process, and build healthier coping strategies.
The team behind Sonia
Sonia is designed with licensed therapists, mental health leaders, coaches, researchers, and engineers from Stanford, MIT, ETH, and beyond. Our team brings psychology, safety research, and AI engineering together into a private support experience you can use any time. We're on a mission to make personalized, high-quality mental health support available to everyone.
What can you use Sonia for?
- Talk through stress, anxiety, relationships, family problems, conflict, motivation, procrastination, or a difficult day
- Speak freely in a private, non-judgmental conversation by voice or text—like talking to an AI coach who actually listens
- Build a personalized support plan based on your goals, patterns, and needs
- Reflect with journal prompts, mindfulness exercises, meditations, and weekly insights
- Get emotional support, life coaching, accountability, encouragement, and perspective when your mind feels loud
- Invite your partner into guided couples sessions to work through relationship challenges together
Research and safety
Sonia is research-informed and actively involved in safety work with universities in the US and around the world. We study how people use Sonia, how conversations can feel more supportive, and how AI systems for mental health and emotional wellbeing can be built more safely and responsibly.
Features
Voice or text: Talk out loud when you need to process, or write when text feels easier.
Personalized memory: Sonia remembers your history, patterns, goals, and the context that matters.
Weekly insights: See recurring themes, progress, and support reflections from your conversations.
Support plan: Build a plan for your mental wellbeing, personal growth, habits, relationships, and next steps.
Mindfulness and reflection: Meditations, journaling, emotional check-ins, and practical self-help exercises.
Privacy-first design: Sonia is HIPAA-compliant and built to protect the conversations you trust us with.
Testimonials
- "Daily use is helpful instead of stressful. I am genuinely impressed with Sonia's ability to challenge me instead of falling into a sycophantic rut."
- "As someone going to therapy I must say Sonia is understanding, validating, and insightful. I felt heard, processed what I was feeling, and learned more about myself."
- "It is so helpful to have an unbiased voice listen whenever I need. I did not realize how much I needed to get off my chest until I started talking."
Sonia is designed for adults 18+. Sonia is AI-based and you are not talking to a licensed human therapist, psychologist, or doctor. Sonia can make mistakes and should not be used as a replacement for professional medical care, diagnosis, or treatment. Interaction with Sonia does not create a medical professional-patient relationship.
Sonia is not designed to be used in crisis. If you are in crisis, please seek out professional help or a crisis line. You can find resources at www.findahelpline.com.

bluejetty:00021168:ios.description:
Find the best meta loadouts for Warzone and Modern Warfare 4 (MW4), compare weapon stats and track your mastery camos with CODMunity, your Call of Duty companion. From Battle Royale and Resurgence to Multiplayer and Zombies, build your classes and stay on top of the meta.
META LOADOUTS & PRO BUILDS
Find weapon rankings and recommended attachments for Warzone and Modern Warfare 4. Explore close-range SMGs, long-range builds and sniper setups tailored to your playstyle. Discover loadouts used by pros and verified creators, including popular builds and attachment pick rates.
WEAPON STATS & TTK COMPARISON
Go beyond the rankings. Compare time to kill (TTK), recoil, aim-down-sight speed (ADS), sprint-to-fire time, bullet velocity and movement. See how attachments affect your weapon and compare builds before your next match.
MASTERY CAMO TRACKER
Organize your camo grind across supported Multiplayer, Warzone and Zombies modes. Track challenges and progress, use filters, grouping and sorting, and find your next camo to unlock.
DMZ HUB & INTERACTIVE HAJIN MAP
Explore MW4 DMZ with the interactive Hajin map, community pins, your personal map and shareable squad plans. Track missions, explore traits, bosses and items, and prepare your builds with the trait and crafting planners. Find guides and news in one place. The DMZ Hub works offline once loaded.
FULL CLASS SETUPS
Explore primary and secondary weapons, perks, tactical and lethal equipment. Looking for a different challenge? Try the random loadout generator.
NERFS, BUFFS & PATCH NOTES
Keep up with weapon balance changes. Browse buff and nerf history and understand how updates affect your favorite weapons and loadouts.
CREATORS & YOUR OWN LOADOUTS
Create your profile, save your builds and follow creators. Share loadouts with friends and export build images for your social channels.
RANKED & ESPORTS
Follow the Warzone Ranked Top 250, Call of Duty League schedules and results, and World Series of Warzone leaderboards.
WARZONE, MODERN WARFARE 4 & MORE
Explore loadouts, weapon stats and camo trackers for Warzone, Modern Warfare 4, Black Ops 7, Black Ops 6 and other supported Call of Duty titles.
Some features require a paid subscription. Available tools and content vary by game and mode.

bluejetty:00156915:ios.name: Siren Connected Boat
bluejetty:00156915:ios.summary: The Siren Connected Boat app is our new, innovative solution to help you keep your boat safe, secure, and ready for boating adventures whenever you are! No matter what kind of boat you have--from sailboats to stern drives, inboards to outbo
bluejetty:00156915:ios.description:
The Siren Connected Boat app is our new, innovative solution to help you keep your boat safe, secure, and ready for boating adventures whenever you are! No matter what kind of boat you have--from sailboats to stern drives, inboards to outboards, the Siren Connected Boat app is for you. Whether you're looking to get real-time information about your boat or wanting to keep track your outboard maintenance, we have you covered. Registered Yamaha outboard owners have access to enhanced features.
With Siren on board, you can see real-time information about your boat at anytime from anywhere, so you never have to wonder if your boat is safe and secure. Connected Boat technology puts your boat in the palm of your hand and gives you the ability to remotely view and monitor your critical systems like battery, bilge, water levels, and more. You can also use our app on your Apple Watch! 
Our app allows you to:
 • Monitor: Remotely monitor your boat’s battery, bilge activity, water level, temperature, engine performance, fuel consumption and more
 • Track: Always know your boat’s exact location and get notified if your boat travels outside a preset security geofence. Create additional polygon geofences to help make sure you don't go into certain areas
 • Control: Remotely control lights, refrigeration, A/C, and other systems. Access digital switching right from your smartphone
 • Secure: Protect your boat with anti-theft entry motion sensors and audible alarms
To use the Siren features, you'll need to install a Siren Marine Main Device on your boat and download this app. There is a wide variety of both wired & wireless sensors you can add on as well, making your boat even more secure!
Siren Connected Boat is your key to peace-of-mind, making every moment of boat ownership a breeze! Download our app now and let us help you fully enjoy your boat ownership experience!

bluejetty:00066300:ios.description:
The time for diplomacy is gone. The time for drastic action is now. Report for duty!
We are calling for the best sniper in the world to join us as we take aim at evil, wherever it hides. Over 130 missions await, taking you to battlefields around the world. This is not a game. There is no room for remorse here, so shoot to kill. 
Take deadly aim with sniper rifles, assault rifles and more! There are many guns, but none is like yours. Personalize your weapon and upgrade your arsenal with new components and weaponry to become a force to be reckoned with!
Let’s move, soldier! Download Sniper Fury now!
SNIPER FURY FEATURES:
FPS BATTLEFIELD
• Over 1000 first person shooter missions.
• Battlefields rendered in 3D graphics that bring you to the near future.
• Soldiers, armored vehicles, air units and many more enemy classes.
• Bullet time effects capture your every snipe and headshot.
• Battlefields with sandstorms, blizzards, rainstorms and other rich atmospheric effects.
• AI behavior makes each enemy uniquely challenging to shoot & kill.
MODERN & FUTURISTIC GUNS
• Shoot sniper rifles, assault rifles, railguns and top-secret weapons.
• Gather components to upgrade your military arsenal.
• Unique weapon personalization.
• iPhone 6s users can enjoy 3D Touch when scoping enemies.
PVP MULTIPLAYER
• Steal resources from other players by breaking down their defenses in PvP Multiplayer mode.
• Build a strong squad to keep your loot safe in PvP Multiplayer mode.
EVENTS & COMMUNITY
• Extra rewards for joining the action in special events.
• Connect to the game community to discover more content, more contests and more rewards!
SNIPER LEAGUES
• Earn a high enough score to enter a league and unlock rewards! 
• See who's top of your league on the Leaderboards.
• Guard your gold and secure your position using the brand-new SHIELD defense system.
ENLIST IN A CLAN
• Join or create sniper Clans.
• Establish a home base, trade and share resources.
• Group Chat to talk strategy and socialize with your allies.
• Unlock perks, including PvP boosts, Tier-10 Squadmates and more.
• Prepare for Clan Wars, where Clans go head-to-head in the ultimate showdown.
• Weaken the opposing clan's Reactor Core, and pillage resources from them!
*IMPORTANT* Sniper Fury requires an iPad 2 (or newer), iPhone 4s (or newer), or iPod touch (5th Generation). iOS 9 and an Internet connection are required to play.
You can download and play this game for free. The game also allows you to play using virtual currency, which can be acquired as you progress, by deciding to watch certain advertisements, or by paying with real money. You will not be asked to re-enter your credit card number or PIN. Once your iTunes account password is entered, your account will allow in-app purchases for 15 minutes. To restrict or disable in-app purchases, you can change the settings on your device.
Please note that this game contains in-app purchases, including paid random items.

bluejetty:00186576:ios.description:
Allow your children to learn about how our world works and discover its beauty through a fun and interactive application full of games, images and animations. 
How it Works? is a very entertaining didactic application that gives the children the opportunity to explore how our world works through animations, small explanations, games and locutions. It includes small lectures that teaches them about the plants, the energies, the volcanoes, the planet and its interior, the water’s cycle and many more natural phenomena. 
What is in the Application How it Works?
=====================================
• Big images to understand the context
• Animations to comprehend the functioning of the phenomena
• Easy to do experiments
• Simple and clear explanations
• Fun games to reinforce the learning
• Locutions to facilitate the comprehension of the non-readers
Download How it Works? and allow your children, grandchildren or students to explore some of the most interesting natural phenomena of our planet. Show them how they work internally and on the outside, satisfy their curiosity and make them participate in how we can make the world better with small everyday actions.
How does it work?
===================
The kids are free to explore the games in the order they want, see images watch videos and read about the thrilling planet Earth! Or they can play games and challenge their knowledge!
With How it Works? the little ones discover how the world works at their own pace and according to their own interests. We believe that you will find, nevertheless, that when they play How it Works?, that they are intuitively drawn to learn about things they never thought to explore.
How it Works? is a game that makes the learning and even better, the comprehension, of how some phenomena develops more fun and mild. It is full of curiosities, contents, images, applications and games to reach all kind of children. The kids have access to a broad range of contents of interest about the planet, everything in only one app!
• Without third party advertising
How it Works? is the perfect application to install in your device when you make a long trip in car, plane, train or bus. Enjoy your time, while allowing your children to have fun and learn in an exciting way for them.
ABOUT LEARNY LAND
At Learny Land, we love to play, and we believe that games must form part of the educational and growth stage of all children; because to play is to discover, explore, learn and have fun. Our educational games help children learn about the world around them and are designed with love. They are easy to use, beautiful and safe. Because boys and girls have always played to have fun and learn, the games we make - like the toys that last a lifetime - can be seen, played and heard.
At Learny Land we take advantage of the most innovative technologies and the most modern devices to take the experience of learning and playing a step further. We create toys that could not have existed when we were young.
Read more about us at www.learnyland.com.
Privacy Policy
We take Privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your children or allow any type of third party ads. To learn more, please read our privacy policy at www.learnyland.com.
Contact us
We'd love to know your opinion and your suggestions. Please, write to support@learnyland.com.
Terms of Use: http://learnyland.com/terms-of-service/

• Start with a 7-day free trial and experience the full power of Physics Solver AI. After the trial, subscribe for unlimited access to advanced problem-solving features.

bluejetty:00126753:ios.description:
Looking for a flexible and lucrative job? Join the team of Yassir drivers, the leading on-demand ride-hailing application. 
Increase your income and control your working hours by transporting our customers on their daily rides.
Why should you become a Yassir driver?
• No commission during your first week (depending on your country of residence)
• Rides are available 24/7, ensuring a steady flow of income.
• You'll receive a discount on your car insurance with our insurance partner (depending on your country of residence)
• You'll receive special offers and surprises as one of our drivers.
What sets the Yassir driver app apart from other ride-hailing apps?
• You can easily indicate your availability as a driver with an On/Off button.
• You can use your preferred map app while driving.
• You have access to all your ride and revenue history.
• You can pay your monthly commission through the app using local payment cards.
• You can track your performance through the analytics section.
How can you become a Yassir driver?
• Sign up at chauffeur.yassir.com.
• Download the Yassir Driver app and finalize your registration
• Join our training sessions. 
• Accept your first ride, and you're ready to go!
Do you need help or have any questions?
• Our customer service department is available 24/7. You can reach us via social media.
Yassir's on-demand ride-hailing service is available 24/7 in many cities in Algeria, Tunisia, Morocco, and Senegal.
Visit yassir.com to see the list of countries where our services are operational.
Join the Yassir driver team today at chauffeur.yassir.com and start earning money on your own terms!

bluejetty:00018659:ios.description:
Join the FullyRaw Revolution! FullyRaw by Kristina is the ultimate guide to living a cleaner and healthier lifestyle through the consumption of organic raw foods. Offering over 500 recipes (including juices, smoothies, salads, desserts, and main dishes) with instructional videos, grocery shopping lists, challenges, educational videos, and exclusive content from Kristina! FullyRaw has everything you need to make living a fully raw lifestyle easy and enjoyable! Whether you are looking to be fully raw or just trying to get more fruits and vegetables in your diet, Kristina wants to help you get there!
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS AND EXCLUSIVE CONTENT
• Unlimited access to Kristina’s Videos and Vlogs as well as exclusive content
• Watch Kristina’s latest videos for Tips + Tricks on how to stay healthy and keep up with the fully raw lifestyle 
• Curated playlists and featured videos 
RECIPES WITH INSTRUCTIONAL VIDEOS & SHOPPING LISTS
• Over 500 recipes ranging from juices, smoothies, salads, soups, desserts, dips, snacks, and main dishes (included with a premium subscription)
• All recipes come with step-by-step instructions with high-resolution images and instructional videos
• Shopping list feature that allows you to directly add ingredients from any recipe and customize your shopping list to include additional items
• Ability to save your favorite recipes 
• Recipes can be searched by tags
• Badges allow you to easily identify recipes that are Seasonal, App Exclusive, Premium, etc.
SAMPLE RECIPES: 
• Carrot Cake
• Rainbow Buddha Bowls
• Chocolate Pecan Pie
• Chocolate Covered Strawberries
• Creamy Lemon Garlic Pasta Alfredo
• FullyRaw Caesar Salad
• Cauliflower Wings
• Cream Cheese Recipe
• Anti-Aging Superfood Smoothie
• FullyRaw Vegan Carrot Bacon
• Mac n' Cheese
• High Protein Veggie Salad
• Lasagna
• Jungle Juice
• Juice for Clear Skin
CURATED MEAL PLANS WITH PROGRESS TRACKING
• Stay motivated by completing challenges ranging from 3-21 days
• Choose the right meal plan for you based on desired categories including Beginner, Detox, and Weight Loss, etc.
• Set a reminder alarm for your meal plans to help you stay on track
• Track your progress throughout your challenge
ABOUT THE FULLYRAW PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
To use the FullyRaw app with no limitations, you need a subscription, charged on a monthly or yearly basis.
FullyRaw Premium subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. There is no increase in price when renewing. Payment will be charged through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. 
Your subscription may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00095761:ios.name: Fire Truck Rescue Firefighter
bluejetty:00095761:ios.summary: Get ready to step into the action with Fire Rescue Truck Firefighter Game — a thrilling fire truck simulator and emergency rescue game where every second counts! Experience the ultimate firefighter simulator 3D as you take control of powerf
bluejetty:00095761:ios.description:
Get ready to step into the action with Fire Rescue Truck Firefighter Game — a thrilling fire truck simulator and emergency rescue game where every second counts! Experience the ultimate firefighter simulator 3D as you take control of powerful fire engines, rescue trucks, and ambulances to handle intense fire emergencies and save lives across the city and offroad areas. Your mission is to respond fast like a real first responder, drive carefully, and extinguish dangerous flames using advanced firefighting equipment, water cannons, and high-pressure water balloon systems.
Enjoy a complete emergency rescue simulator experience with realistic fire rescue missions, ambulance driving, and paramedic support in multiple rescue scenarios.
Experience realistic rescue gameplay through three exciting modes that test your driving simulator, targeting, and firefighting rescue skills:
Open World Mode
 Explore a fully open world fire rescue city simulator filled with unpredictable fire emergencies. Receive urgent calls from city buildings, schools, supermarkets, highways, and offroad accident spots. Follow the mini-map navigation, rush to the scene, and rescue trapped civilians. Use fire hoses, fire extinguishers, rescue tools, and coordinate with ambulances and medical teams to treat injured people and transport them safely to hospitals. Feel like a real firefighter hero in this open-world emergency response game.
Water Balloon Mode
In this unique firefighting simulation, use high-pressure water balloon launchers mounted on your fire trucks. Aim and shoot balloons at long-distance fires from helicopters, sea boats, oil tanks, and remote disaster areas. Master precision and timing in this innovative fire truck shooting game and control massive fire outbreaks in challenging rescue missions.
 Extinguisher Mode
Equip your fire extinguisher and handle close-range fire scenes. Drive your fire engine, ambulance, or rescue vehicle to the emergency zone and fight the flames up close. Show your firefighter teamwork, quick reaction, and emergency rescue skills to save every life in danger.
Each mission is packed with realistic visuals, responsive vehicle controls, and challenging fire rescue operations. Choose from multiple fire trucks, ambulances, paramedic vans, and rescue vehicles, customize your water cannon machines, and prove your skills as the city’s ultimate firefighter and rescue hero in this fire rescue driving simulator.
Game Features:
Realistic fire rescue missions in city & offroad environments
Multiple modes: Open World, Water Balloon, and Extinguisher Simulator
Variety of fire trucks, ambulances, emergency vehicles, and rescue tools
Dynamic water cannon, fire hose, and water balloon mechanics
Mini-map for navigation and real-time emergency call tracking
Immersive firefighting simulator environment with realistic smoke & flame effects
Smooth driving simulator controls and detailed fire animations
Gameplay Controls & Driving System
Brake & Accelerator Buttons
 Control your speed like a real fire truck driver. Accelerate to rush toward emergency calls and use brakes to stop safely at rescue zones.
Steering & Control Buttons
 Use the steering controls to navigate through city roads and offroad rescue areas. Experience precise handling in this fire rescue driving game.
Water Hose Pipe Button
 Activate the fire hose system to spray high-pressure water and extinguish burning buildings, vehicles, and accident spots.
Pick Up Injured People Button
 Rescue trapped and injured civilians by picking them up and transferring them to ambulances and hospitals as part of your paramedic rescue gameplay.
Water Balloon Shoot Button
 Launch high-pressure water balloons to hit long-distance fires, helicopters, boats, and hard-to-reach emergency zones in this unique firefighting shooting simulator.
Fire Extinguisher Button
 Use the fire extinguisher for close-range fire control and indoor rescue missions.

bluejetty:00147267:ios.description:
Presearch is a private search engine that protects your privacy. Enjoy unbiased results with no tracking, no data collection, and no profiling of your searches
Our Key Differentiators:
Community Project
Community members can actively participate in the project using Presearch community chat groups, contributing open source packages to our source code repository, or simply as users or promoters helping build usage and awareness
Decentralized Platform
Presearch is now preparing to release its first decentralized technology – a new search engine experience that runs on node servers operated by Presearch community members.
Better Search Results
The new Presearch Engine offers results that are as good as the world’s top search engines. It also provides an additional layer of data through community packages which makes those results even better. For example, you can search Presearch for “Bitcoin” to see what the crypto package looks like. Over time, there will be additional results provided by a user-curated supplementary index.
Privacy
In addition to better results, Presearch also protects your privacy because it does not track you or store your searches, and queries are handled by a decentralized network of node servers processing anonymized queries.
A New Kind Of Advertising Model
In addition to offering users a great search experience, Presearch is dedicated to creating significant value for marketers who would like to reach Presearch users. Advertisers can stake their PRE to a keyword, and whichever advertiser stakes the most tokens will have its ads displayed when a user searches on the term selected. Advertisers confer the most external value on PRE, so their success is very important to the ecosystem.
The Presearch Privacy Browser is a fork of a popular privacy brower. Many of the designs and functionalities are the same, but allows the user to use Presearch on a mobile device.

bluejetty:00145857:ios.description:
Entre os fundadores sempre foi colocado em prática os ensinamentos de seus pais, que é trabalhar com dedicação, honestidade e determinação. Além disso, o respeito mútuo e a união, pois foi o que lhes deu força para expandir com sucesso. 
No fim de 1999, estrategicamente foram vendidas as seis unidades de Mogi das Cruzes. Posteriormente o Grupo retomou as atividades através da aquisição de supermercados existentes e abertura de novas lojas, juntamente com os irmãos Kimoto. 
As unidades localizam-se nas cidades de Caçapava, Caraguatatuba, Itaquaquecetuba, Jacareí, Taubaté, Biritiba Mirim, Mogi das Cruzes, Ferraz de Vasconcelos, São Sebastião, Aparecida, Pinda, São José dos Campos, Suzano, Poá e São Miguel, totalizando 28 (vinte e oito) lojas.
Além do ramo de supermercados, a rede atua também no segmento casa e presentes, com cinco unidades e Shopping na cidade de São José dos Campos, com 150 lojas no total e 100 já inauguradas.

bluejetty:00126733:ios.description:
Multi-Stopwatch extends your normal stopwatch with many useful additional functions.
Multiple stopwatches
• Stop several times simultaneously
• Use the 2 modes "Normal" and "Sprint". In "Normal" mode the stopwatches run in parallel. In "Switch" mode only one stopwatch runs at a time. If another stopwatch is started, the previous one pauses automatically.
Sprint Mode
• You want to track many runners, swimmers? Then the sprint mode is perfect for you
• The large buttons and the haptic feedback help to operate without having to look at the iPhone
Platforms
• In addition to the iPhone app, Multi-Stopwatch is now also optimized for your iPad
• Use Multi-Stopwatch now on your Apple Watch
Customizability
• Adjust the multi-stopwatch exactly to your needs
• Need a bigger toolbar? Do you want the times to be displayed to the nearest second? You can set it now
• You want to show the number of rounds and the last round, hide the name for it? You can set it now
• When you tap on the stopwatch, you don't want to stop the time but see details? You can set it now
Of course, the stopwatches also run in the background with millisecond accuracy.
Perfect e.g. for sports teachers, doctors, time recording, DLRG, races and much more.
Subscription terms:
- The subscription auto-renews at the end of each term.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.

Connecteam’s employee management app is the most simple, capable, and affordable solution to manage non-desk employees from one place!
See what our customers say about Connecteam’s employee app:
- "We learned how to use this software in 1 day! Great product and highly recommend it to everyone.", Sarah (Dentist Clinic Owner, 10 emp.)
- "It is easy to communicate and use! Everyone on the app loves it!", Jennifer (Manager, 35 emp.)
- "Connecteam’s employee app has solved every problem I've had without paying over 2x as much for other apps" - Nyla (Owner, 50 emp.)
WORK SCHEDULING:
Employee scheduling made easy. Quickly and easily schedule shifts and dispatch jobs with the only scheduling app that offers full shift collaboration. Our work schedule is easy to use and packed with tons of time-saving features! Use the auto-scheduling tool to easily create employee schedules in just one click.
• Create single, multiple, or team shifts
• GPS status updates for visual job progress
• Job info: location, shift details, file attachments etc.
EMPLOYEE TIME CLOCK:
Track and manage employee work hours on jobs, projects, customers, or anything else you need with Connecteam’s time clock. Our employee time clock is easy to use for smooth implementation:
• GPS location tracking with Geofence and maps display
• Jobs and shift attachments
• Automated breaks, overtime, and double time
• Automated push notifications and reminders
• Easy to use and manage employee timesheets
• Integrations with leading payroll software
• Easily clock in from any device
INTERNAL COMMUNICATION PLATFORM:
Make your company’s internal communication simpler than ever before! Communicate the right content at the right time to every single employee, with amazing tools for employee engagement to strengthen your company’s culture and employee connectivity. We offer multiple communication tools to enhance your day-to-day business routine and employee engagement:
• Live chat - 1:1 or group conversations
• Chat API to connect external data sources to your company chat
• Directory for all work contacts
• Posts and updates with comments and reactions
• Employee feedback surveys
TASK MANAGEMENT:
Take any procedure that’s done by pen and paper, spreadsheet, or verbally, and easily create a fully automated process that can be used from anywhere. Our employee app includes multiple features to manage day-to-day tasks and enhance on-the-job compliance with advanced checklists:
• Daily checklists with auto-reminders
• Online forms, tasks, and checklists with read & sign options
• Allow users to upload images and report geolocation
• Go paperless and automate daily procedures
• 100% customizable and easy to use, now with live mobile preview
EMPLOYEE TRAINING & ONBOARDING:
With Connecteam, your employees don’t have to be in the office or carry papers in order to have direct access to information, policies, and training materials. Now, they can access everything right from their phone:
• Easy access to files and all media types
• Premade template for any industry
• Professional courses
• Quizzes
INTERNAL TICKETING SYSTEM - HELP DESK:
• Solve any issue in a snap with the right help desk
• One central hub for all team requests
• Full management oversight on all issues within the business
DIGITAL EMPLOYEE ID CARD:
• Easy, accessible, and secure work IDs
• Instantly issue cards to staff across locations without the administrative hassle
• Enable QR features to manage access and unlock doors
Have any questions? Want to schedule a live demo?
Contact us at yourapp@connecteam.com and we'll be happy to help!

listings.name: iWeather - Forecast App
listings.description:
iWeather turns the forecast into an almanac: warm paper tones, clear type and one colour for every kind of sky. Open it and you know what the day has in store at a glance.

THE DAY AT A GLANCE
• A short sentence sums up the weather: "Cloudy and mild. Rain returns tomorrow afternoon."
• Current temperature, high and low, feels like, humidity, wind and UV in one view.
• Every city has its own colour and symbol, so your list reads like a page of an almanac.

RAIN IN THE NEXT HOUR
• Know when rain starts and stops, minute by minute, where available.
• Hour-by-hour forecast for temperature, rain chance and wind, with a ribbon you can scrub through.
• 10-day forecast with a detailed page for every day.

LIVE WEATHER MAPS
• Precipitation, temperature, wind and cloud layers on a full-screen map.
• See all your saved cities on the map at once.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Choose which modules to show and in what order: next hour, hourly, 10 days, map, UV, sun, moon, clouds, wind, precipitation, humidity, feels like, pressure, visibility, air quality, climate and how today compares with the average.
• Celsius or Fahrenheit. Wind and pressure follow your region's units.

METEO AI
• Ask in your own words: "Do I need an umbrella tomorrow?" or "When is the best day for a trip to the coast?"
• Answers come from the real forecast for your cities, powered by Apple Intelligence: on your device, or with Private Cloud Compute for longer questions.
• Dictate your question if you prefer.

WEATHER ALERTS
• Official severe weather alerts for your cities, when they are issued.

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
• iPhone, iPad and Mac, each with a layout made for its screen.
• Designed for iPhone Duo: open, the list and the full detail sit side by side; closed, everything fits the cover screen.
• Apple Watch: your cities, the next hours and Meteo AI on your wrist.
• Widgets in every size for the Home Screen, including Extra Large on iPad and widgets on Mac.
• Siri and Shortcuts: ask for the weather, the rain or the alerts without opening the app.

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
• No account and no sign-in.
• Your cities and settings sync through iCloud across your devices.

Weather data provided by Apple Weather. Meteo AI requires a device compatible with Apple Intelligence.

Welcome to the mesmerizing world of the animated series "Hotel" with the "Wallpaper HD" app! This app is designed to immerse you in the captivating atmosphere of the show by providing a unique collection of high-resolution wallpapers dedicated to the enigmatic character Alastor.
"Hotel " is a series full of mystique, magic, and unexpected plot twists. known as the Characters" is one of the most mysterious and intriguing characters in this universe. He possesses his own unique style, charisma, and aura of mystery, making him one of the most intriguing characters for fans.
Our "Wallpaper HD" app offers you the opportunity to dive into this captivating world by offering a wide selection of wallpapers inspired by Alastor's character and atmosphere. From the details of his costume to his expressive gaze and mystical aura, each image in our collection conveys the unique energy of this character.
One of the features of our app is the high quality of the wallpapers provided. We pay special attention to details and image resolution to ensure that each wallpaper looks stunning on your screen. Additionally, we regularly update our collection, adding new wallpapers and reflecting the latest events and plot twists related to the character of Alastor.
By choosing wallpapers from our collection, you will not only transform the appearance of your device but also immerse yourself in the world of "Hotel wallpapers," feeling its atmosphere and mystical influence on every screen. Keep your device fresh with new wallpapers to stay up to date with the latest events and further enjoy the magic of this amazing world.
Enjoy all these features completely free of charge, thanks to our ad-supported model. The advertisements displayed help us maintain the quality and updates in the app. We strive to provide you with maximum comfort and enjoyment when using "Wallpaper HD," so our ads are minimally intrusive and do not affect your overall experience.
Let " Wallpaper HD" be your reliable and stylish companion in the world of "Hotel," bringing you inspiration and aesthetic pleasure at every step.

bluejetty:00066026:ios.description:
In this Visual Novel, live the adventure of Lyla, a high schooler, who finds love. Mysteries and secrets away you in this interactive novel! In this light novel, live an exciting romance where friendship, humor, passion and... super stars come together!
A Romance Begins
She's beautiful and popular, he's reserved and almost unpleasant. They are total opposites, and yet an attraction is definitely present between Lyla et Henri.
The mystery that surrounds Henri hides a secret, but... will love withstand this secret?
Strong Points
- Colorful and endearing characters in this love story game.
- A moving visual novel, full of humor.
- An interactive novel where your choices allow you to access bonus scenes!
- Unique illustrations for each chapter. 
- Special scenes with new dialogues.
- A true love story with animated characters.
- Exclusive, romantic and electric music and songs!
Creators' Comments
“Henri and Lyla are an integral part of my life... Writing their story was deeply moving! I hope that you will enjoy the discovery as much as me!” Nineland - creator, writer and illustrator. 
""With this game, we wanted to offer high quality content, notably through the scenario, illustrations, music and animations!"" Jean-Philippe Tessier - Beemoov Co-founder
“Interpreting the voice of Jay for this Visual Novel game was a very enriching experience for me"" Charly Sahona - Vocalist for Jay's songs.

Beemoov is an international free web and mobile games production company. Beemoov develops otome games and fashion games such as My Candy Love, Eldarya, Moonlight Lovers, and Like a Fashionista. 
The teams are committed to offer players original and unforgettable experiences.

Beemoov: https://us.beemoov.com/
Contact
Questions? Suggestions? Need technical support? Contact us anytime at support@beemoov.com.

bluejetty:00090281:ios.description:
About this app
Start your own online commerce business in Iraq today without any risks.
Start your own online commerce business without the need for capital, technical, operational or marketing knowhow. Fedshi is a mobile application that offers you a wide variety of popular products at wholesale prices. It allows you to market the products to your community and network at retail prices without buying them. Instead, you take orders from your customers via social media (e.g. Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, Tiktok) and instant messaging apps (e.g. Whatsapp, Telegram, Messenger) and submit them via Fedshi. We store, fulfill and ship the order to your customers as well as collect the cash from them. You earn a profit, which is the difference between retail and wholesale prices, and we transfer those profits shortly after collection.
Fedshi removes the risk of starting your own online commerce business by removing the upfront costs and reducing the operational work required. All you have to do is to market Fedshi’s products, offered to you at wholesale prices, and let Fedshi do the rest. Avoid the risks and costs of buying stock, warehousing, fulfilling, delivering, cash collection and returns that come with e-commerce. Let us do the work and then send your profits.
Why use Fedshi?
1. Wide range of products at low wholesale prices
Fedshi offers you a large assortment of popular products at the lowest wholesale prices that you can find in Iraq. Our research team makes sure to pick the most attractive products that are requested by customers. We source such products directly from suppliers and manufacturers and can thus attain the lowest prices. We offer the products to you at fixed wholesale prices and suggest a customer price for you to market the products at.
2. No upfront costs
Fedshi relieves you of the cost and risk of building inventory. You do not have to pay any upfront costs to Fedshi to be able to market our products to your customers. You simply share the products with your network through social media and instant messaging apps. You take their orders via social media and instant messaging apps and place the orders on behalf of them on Fedshi’s app.
3. Full services
Fedshi relieves you of the cost and risk of building a warehouse, fulfilling and delivering the products. We pack your orders in our warehouse and deliver them directly to your customers. We collect the cash from your customers directly. Our delivery is fast, we usually deliver within 24-48 hours.
4. Instant earnings
The difference between the customer price and wholesale price is your profit. As soon as possible after collecting the cash from customers, we transfer your profits to you.
5. Favourable policies
We offer your customers a 7-day free return policy, where they can return the products and get their full refunds or exchange them to anything else that they want.
6. Exclusive promotions and campaigns
We run continuous promotions and campaigns, offering you further discounts on our already low wholesale prices or free delivery to offer to your customers.
7. Marketing support
You want to start your online commerce business but do not know how to market the products to customers? Fedshi will provide you with the creative materials (videos, photos, content) and instructions on how to promote and market products to your network on social media applications.
How to use Fedshi?
1. Register
Download the application and register your profile with Fedshi, we will be in touch with you to teach you how to start selling.
2. Share
Browse Fedshi’s large assortment of products offered at wholesale prices and share with your network via social media
3. Order
Take orders from your network via social media platforms and place the orders on their behalf using Fedshi’s application
4. Relax
Fedshi will deliver the order to the customer, collect the cash from the customer and transfer your profits to you directly

bluejetty:00069071:ios.description:
ACT iCoach is a comprehensive app that covers all aspects of Acceptance Commitment Therapy
Learn and practice ACT skills using video lessons and fun animations which helps you to remember skills longer. Features over video lessons and easy to read content from some of the leading ACT Practitioners and researchers in the world. You can also take notes on these lessons for future use.
User friendly tools to track your mood, emotions, journal and ACT measures. Summary screens to check your progress. Analytics to get insight into your own behavior as you learn new skills. Ability to share with therapists and care team.
Track your progress on how you are doing and get motivated to obtain new skills. Get awards for tasks done towards obtaining new skills or keeping up with one you already know.
Complete exercises and practice ideas that are similar to worksheets in actual ACT Therapy. There are over 100 exercises. Each of the exercise link directly to lessons.
Over 1000 meditations ranging across multiple themes from some of the best teachers in the world.
Favorites list to save skills and meditations you use frequently.
Weekly and Daily ACT Measure tracking.
Finally, the app integrates with a clinician app. If your therapist is signed up and you are set up to share your diary card and exercises then you don’t have to share via email every week. Your therapist can engage with you in real time.
The app also integrates with Apple's HealthKit to record your meditation minutes to Health Kit mindfulness.
 Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
*You have a choice of being billed monthly for $9.99/month or a discounted price of $49.99 every six months. 
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy:https://www.resiliens.com/privacy
Terms of use: https://www.resiliens.com/terms
DISCLAIMER:
This is not a substitute for a Therapist or a Medical Professional. It works best when you use as a companion app along with your ACT Therapist / Counselor.
