bluejetty:00178245:ios.name: Bird Sort - Color Puzzle Game
bluejetty:00178245:ios.summary: Bird Sort - Color Puzzle is a fun and relaxing game that will help bring a smile to your face. This game is an updated version of a classic water sort puzzle game, with stunning graphics and helpful features to keep you entertained for hour
bluejetty:00178245:ios.description:
Bird Sort - Color Puzzle is a fun and relaxing game that will help bring a smile to your face. This game is an updated version of a classic water sort puzzle game, with stunning graphics and helpful features to keep you entertained for hours. With tricky levels in Color Bird Sort Puzzle, you can sharpen your brain while having a relaxing time.
HOW TO PLAY
- This Color sorting puzzle is definitely easy to play. You will start with branches with different types of birds.
- Simply tap and make the birds fly from one branch to another to unify the colors of birds on one branch
- You will win the level when you finish sorting all the birds
- Keep in mind that you can only move one bird to the branch with the bird of the same color, and there is still room in that branch
- Strategize your moves carefully, because you can't go back
- Try not to get stuck. If you get stuck, use some stunning and helpful boosters to pass the level more easily
- Find your own way to finish the levels, and level up yourself to the next level
FEATURES
Bird Sort Color Puzzle is a new version of classic sorting puzzle game. Thus, it's packed with many great and unique features
- Beautiful graphic designs of birds. The design of this game will please your visual
- Relaxing ASMR sound. Thanks to this, Color Bird Sort will calm and relax your mind after a stressful day
- Play with one hand, one finger control
- Thousands of challenging levels, various theme options
- Free and available offline. No wifi needed
- No time Limit
What are you waiting for? Let's join the adventure in Bird Sort Color Puzzle and have a great time

bluejetty:00069877:ios.description:
Perfect relaxing fan sounds / white noise app to help you sleep.
The soothing relaxing sound of the app will help you to calm your mind, concentrate, relax, fall asleep, focus better while you study or while you're working, block out background noise such as music, phones, conversations, chatter, noise, traffic, pets, and neighbors.
It can also work wonder as a soothing sound for babies to sleep or as a spa / massage sound.
It will also help you if you have insomnia, tinnitus or have sleep deprivation.
Our customers around the world:
"My fan at home is a turbo fan. When I travel I always have a fan to cover up noise. Love it, Fcsandy"
"This is one of the best sound machine apps out there. We use it every night and sleep great!"
"Exactly what I was looking for, thank you! Looking forward to more updates."
" Cannot sleep without it! Use it every night. The timer is amazing."

Thank you, sleep fan! I don't know what I would do without you!"
Features:
* 28 Soothing Fan Sounds / White Noise (We're adding more of them over time)
* Fall Asleep Faster
* Running in background
* Configurable Sleep Timer
* Sleep Timer With Soft Fade Out
* Bedtime Reminder
* White noise fan sound works fast
* Intuitive Spinning Fan animation
* Many more amazing features will be updated over time
Many people rely on the white noise sound of their fan to help them fall asleep. The problem is that you can't always bring your fan with you!!! 
But, you have your iPhone or iPad with you all the time. So if you download this FREE app then you have the white noise of your fans with you wherever you are, whenever you need! 
Get a better sleep with Sleep Fan
Good night!

bluejetty:00092018:ios.name: Pokebattler Raid Party
bluejetty:00092018:ios.summary:
**Now with access to thousands of Global Raids daily including Minpoke, Pokenav and Nexus raids! The fastest and easiest remote raid coordinator, raid counter guide, and group raid party simulator for Pokemon Go **
Host and join raids all o
bluejetty:00092018:ios.description:
**Now with access to thousands of Global Raids daily including Minpoke, Pokenav and Nexus raids! The fastest and easiest remote raid coordinator, raid counter guide, and group raid party simulator for Pokemon Go **
Host and join raids all over the world so you can raid anytime, anywhere! 
Know whether you and your group can defeat a Raid Boss and the best counters to use instantly! 
Free to use, ad-free, safe, accurate, and super easy to use tool to plan and play raids and beat bosses faster and more easily. 
Raid Party features global and private friend raids from all over the world. Share friend codes and coordinate over discord and catch those Pokemon! 
The Raid Party lets you see the best generic counters or the best custom counters from your Pokebattler account, share your counters with your friends, and find out your chances of beating the current raid bosses in Pokemon GO together. 
Use your custom raid number to invite friends to your Raid Party and know ahead of time what counters everyone is using so you know your exact chances to defeat your chosen boss. 
Take your Pokemon Go raiding to a new level with this user-friendly and data-driven app! 
Optional subscription options allow for an optimized experience with larger Pokeboxes and more accurate simulations. 
** Full Feature List **
• Global raid lists from within the app and pulled in from popular Discord servers
• Automatic Discord integration so you can coordinate with your fellow raiders 
• Easy to use User Interface 
• Generic Counters available to anyone for free
•Easy to share links 
•Discord Bot integration to invite friends 
• Custom Counters available for subscribers. 
• Add or Delete Pokemon fast 
• Custom Raid Simulations based on what your whole group is using 
• Data Points include Time, Time to win, TDO, Estimator, Deaths, and Deaths to Win. 
- Time -
 length of the battle until you win or die.
- Time to Win 
How long it will take you to win. If this is longer than Time then you will die. 
- TDO 
Total damage to the raid boss. 
- Estimator 
How many iterations of your Pokemon it would take the defeat the boss. If it’s under 1 - you probably win! If it’s over 1, you’ll probably lose. 
- Deaths 
Number of times you have one (?) Pokemon die during the battle. If this number is higher than the total Pokemon in the battle, you lose. 
- Deaths to Win 
How many deaths it would take of each Pokemon before beating the boss. If this number is higher than the total deaths number, you will lose. 
_________
** Overview **
By the makers of Pokebattler.com, Raid Party uses highly advanced algorithms and Monte Carlo simulations to give trainers highly accurate raid counters.
Save time and potions by quickly and easily entering in your best Pokemon and finding out which to use to beat raid bosses the fastest and most easily. 
Existing Pokebattler.com subscribers will have their previously entered Pokemon from their Pokebox instantly available. 
Each raid party will have a unique number code. Give that code to friends or even invite them through a Discord or text link and they will automatically be added to your Raid Party. See precise data on how hard it will be for you to take down a raid boss together, and what counters your friends may be using. 
Those without an account who don’t want to enter Pokemon will have the top 6 generic counters chosen for them for fast and (mostly accurate) results. 
More features coming soon such as:
In app notifications to friends 
Auto-refresh 
--------------
Learn more at https://Pokebattler.com/RaidParty
Follow us on Twitter @Pokebattler_com 
--------------
DISCLAIMER
Raid Party is not affiliated with the Pokemon brand, Niantic, Pokemon Go, Nintendo, or the Pokemon Company.

bluejetty:00073582:ios.name: Albion Online
bluejetty:00073582:ios.summary: Albion Online is a cross-platform sandbox MMORPG set in an open medieval fantasy world. The game features a player-driven economy where nearly every item is player-crafted. Combine armor pieces and weapons suited to your playstyle in a uniq
bluejetty:00073582:ios.description:
Albion Online is a cross-platform sandbox MMORPG set in an open medieval fantasy world. The game features a player-driven economy where nearly every item is player-crafted. Combine armor pieces and weapons suited to your playstyle in a unique, classless "you are what you wear" system. Explore the world, take on other adventurers in thrilling battles, conquer territories, and build a home.
CROSS-PLATFORM PLAY: Albion Online is a true cross-platform MMO experience. Whether you prefer PC or mobile, one account lets you play on all platforms.
PLAYER-DRIVEN ECONOMY: From basic tools and clothes to mighty armors and powerful weapons, nearly every item in the game is crafted by players, in player-constructed buildings, from resources gathered by players. Buy, sell, and trade at local marketplaces all across the world of Albion. Craft rare and powerful items, then sell them to the highest bidder and grow your fortune.
YOU ARE WHAT YOU WEAR: In Albion Online's classless combat system, the weapons and armor you use define your skills, and switching playstyles is as easy as switching gear. Test out new equipment anytime and change up your weapons, armor, and mounts to suit any situation. Hone your character’s skills by crafting new items, or by simply using your favorite equipment.
PREPARE TO FIGHT: Test yourself against other adventurers in high-risk, high-reward full-loot fights. From solo to small-group to large-scale battles, you'll need strategy, tactics, and skill to prevail. Level your combat specializations, create unique builds with complementary skills, and use every tool at your disposal to emerge victorious. Enter the Crystal Realm and fight 5v5 or 20v20 battles for massive rewards.
CONQUER THE WORLD: Join a guild and carve out your own piece of Albion in massive open-world battles. Claim territories for access to incredible resources, construct guild halls, build Hideouts, and track your progress against other guilds worldwide on the leaderboards. Join a City Faction, climb the ranks, and take part in continent-wide Faction Campaigns.
PUT DOWN ROOTS: Claim a city plot or private island and make it your own. Grow crops to sell or make into food, raise your own livestock and mounts, and build crafting stations for private or public use. Stock your house with custom furniture, trophies, and chests to store your growing collection of loot. Hire and train laborers to keep everything at your homestead running smoothly.
FACE DEADLY FOES: From small scouting bands to massive bosses, the inhabitants of Albion’s open world await your challenge. Take on six different factions, each with unique enemies that require their own strategies. Partake in solo or group Expeditions, or seek out the ultimate thrill by facing demons and other players alike in Hellgates and Corrupted Dungeons.
EXPLORE A VAST WORLD: Explore five vivid biomes, where you can gather raw materials for crafting or cast a line into Albion's waters to catch fish. Seek out solo and group dungeons with powerful foes and lucrative rewards. Enter the Roads of Avalon to discover ever-changing paths between distant zones, and explore the Mists to encounter rare creatures and lucrative treasures.

bluejetty:00135140:ios.name: Think Vitality
bluejetty:00135140:ios.summary:
Energize your body. Clear and calm your mind with simple Qigong practices.
As a Communi Qi member you will enjoy:
• Full Qigong routines (not found on YouTube)
• Classic practices, 30 Days of Qigong, Four Seasons, Qigong for energy, sleep,
bluejetty:00135140:ios.description:
Energize your body. Clear and calm your mind with simple Qigong practices.
As a Communi Qi member you will enjoy:
• Full Qigong routines (not found on YouTube)
• Classic practices, 30 Days of Qigong, Four Seasons, Qigong for energy, sleep, anxiety and more
• A monthly ‘live’ meeting called the “Qi Chat”
• A warm and welcoming forum where you can connect with like-minded people
• Discussions on Qigong and Traditional Chinese Medicine concepts including Five Elements, Yin Yang theory, meridians, acupressure, and tapping
• The “Universi Qi” where you can explore ideas and philosophies to design your own “formula” for wellness
• Mini courses on healthy boundaries, intention, “flow state,” emotions, and related topics
• Meditations
• Q & A 
• Fresh content with new Qigong videos every month 
Becoming a Communi Qi member makes it easy to practice at home, at work, while travelling or wherever you are. You can download the routines to your device and watch them anywhere, anytime!
Easily bookmark your ‘favourites’ so you can find them when you need them.
Being a Communi Qi member makes it easy to practice everyday.
Move at your own pace. Routines are suitable for absolute beginners and those who have practiced Qigong before. Many members have practiced in the past, or are taking a Qigong or Tai Chi class currently, and use the Communi Qi videos “in between classes.”
Qigong uses deep breathing, strengthening and stretching with slow gentle movements that are easy on the body. It’s like a moving meditation.
Qigong is based on the ancient concepts of Traditional Chinese Medicine and can help:
• Increase energy
• Calm the mind
• Improve digestion, sleep, and immunity
• Reduce stress, tension and anxiety
• Cultivate a feeling of calm, clarity and vitality
Qigong (qi gong, chi kung, or Ki gou) is an ancient Chinese exercise and mindfulness practice that looks similar to Tai Chi, but is easier to learn and practice. While Tai Chi was originally a martial art, Qigong was developed to improve health and vitality.
Qigong is an element of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is used to move and build “Qi” or energy in the body. When Qi is stagnant or deficient, there may be pain, fatigue or tension. When Qi is moving freely throughout the muscles, joints, organs and meridians you will feel healthy, vibrant and youthful.
Practice with Jeffrey Chand, RAc, Dipl. TCM 
Registered Acupuncturist, Practitioner of Traditional Chinese Medicine and Qigong Instructor with over 20 years experience.
Join us on your journey to wellness!
To access all features and content you can subscribe to Think Vitality on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://qigongforvitality.vhx.tv/tos
Privacy Policy: https://qigongforvitality.vhx.tv/privacy

bluejetty:00072826:ios.description:
Christmas Color by Number - A Festive Journey into the World of Colors
Introducing Christmas Color by Number, the most joyful and festive coloring game that takes you on a magical journey of creativity and imagination. This game is not just a coloring book, it's a window to a world full of color, wonder, and Christmas spirit.
Christmas Color by Number is a fun, family-friendly game designed for coloring enthusiasts. Whether you are a beginner or a seasoned artist, this game will help you unwind, relax, and experience the calming effect of coloring. It's time to unleash your inner artist, celebrate the holiday spirit, and create your very own Christmas masterpiece!
Immerse in the Christmas Spirit
This game features hundreds of exclusive Christmas-themed designs, from Santa Claus, Christmas trees, snowmen to intricate holiday ornaments. Each image is designed to ignite the festive spirit and immerse you in the joy and warmth of Christmas. As you navigate through the game, you'll embark on a festive journey that will keep you captivated for hours.
Easy and Fun to Play
What sets Christmas Color by Number apart is its simplicity and ease of use. Simply select a design, and start coloring by numbers. You don't need any artistic skills or experience. The game provides a wide variety of color palettes to choose from, and the numbers guide you to complete each artwork flawlessly.
Enhance Creativity and Relaxation
Coloring has been scientifically proven to help reduce stress and promote relaxation. As you color by numbers, you'll find yourself entering a state of calm and tranquility. The game also boosts creativity by allowing you to experiment with different color combinations and bring each image to life in your own unique way.
Share Your Masterpiece
After you've finished coloring an image, you can save and share your masterpiece with friends and family. Spread the Christmas cheer and show off your artistic flair!
Stunning Graphics and Smooth Gameplay
Experience crisp, high-quality graphics that bring each image to life. The game features smooth gameplay, intuitive controls, and a user-friendly interface that makes coloring a breeze.
Regular Updates
We regularly add new images to keep the game fresh and exciting. You'll always have new designs to color and explore.
In conclusion, Christmas Color by Number is an enchanting coloring game that combines the joy of coloring with the magical spirit of Christmas. It's a must-have game for the holiday season that will keep you entertained and relaxed. So, what are you waiting for? Download Christmas Color by Number today, and let the festive coloring adventure begin!
Please note: Christmas Color by Number is a digital coloring game. No physical coloring book or coloring tools are included. Always remember to take regular breaks during gameplay to rest your eyes and hands.
Experience the magic of Christmas like never before with Christmas Color by Number. Happy coloring and Merry Christmas!

bluejetty:00070568:ios.description:
To continue enjoying our app, we kindly request that you log in again after this update.
If you're a subscriber, please take a moment to restore your account to ensure uninterrupted access. You can find the “Restore Subscriptions“ button in Settings under Subscriptions.
Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and giving it a facelift! This faster iOS native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. Users will be allowed to customize the content they want to engage with by selecting the topics they are truly interested in. By going to the “Your News” tab the user can bypass the noise of all that is published and home in on the content they want
Saved Articles:
Save feature that allows users to save articles or other content they are interested in for later reading or reference.Push notifications will remind users to read their saved articles or suggest related content
Custom Push Notifications:
The user can select what topics they want to be notified about which makes for a much less intrusive experience. 
Top Navigation Bar:
 A top navigation bar lets the user switch between sections by swiping or tapping.
Enews in-app:
Desire the newspaper experience? No need to open a separate app! By simply going to Settings and selecting E-News the user can browse the Digital Replica of the day’s paper.
Offline Reading:
This feature allows users to enable offline reading from Settings. Offline “Reading Preferences” can also be customized for Settings. 
Swipe Left:
Instead of going back to the main section to find more articles, users have the option to simply swipe, immediately opening other articles in the Section.
Follow Topics:
A user will be shown articles on topics they are following. To follow select “follow” at the article level and related articles will gain relevancy and be shown more frequently. Just as easily “Unfollow”
Terms of Use:
https://www.medianewsgroup.com/terms-of-use/
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00175285:ios.description:
Decide when and where to surf with Surfline, the most trusted surf forecasting app in the world.
Check live surf cams, expert forecasts, wind, tide, swell data, real-time surf reports and track your sessions at spots around the world.
Since 1985, Surfline has helped millions of surfers make better decisions about where and when to surf. Designed by surfers, for surfers, Surfline combines proprietary forecast models, an expert in-house forecast team, and an exclusive global network of advanced live surf cams.
Find your next session with everything you need to check the surf
- Get the read on today’s conditions from our team of expert forecasters*
- Find your window to surf with hourly ratings, surf height, wind, swell, and tide
- Preview tomorrow’s conditions with footage from similar days
- See what other forecasts miss with our best-in-class nearshore forecast model
- Get alerted when your preferred conditions line up
- Plan your next session or trip with 10-day forecasts, charts, and spot guides
- Make the forecast your own by customizing your setup
- Track your progress and stay motivated with insights and highlights of every session
Know before you go with Premium:
- Watch the surf live with 1000+ ad-free cams around the world
- Rewind the cams to review sets, lulls, and conditions over time
- Capture your waves with clips of rides and wipeouts from your session
- See what our forecasters see with incoming swell analysis, days to watch, and region-specific outlooks*
- Plan your next session or surf trip with 16-day extended forecasts, charts, and spot guides
- Access exclusive offers and giveaways from brands we use and trust
- Follow the action with new, higher-res Action Cam angles that follow the break, available at select spots across Southern California
Get Premium for less with Premium with Ads:
- Unlock everything in Premium — unlimited live cam access, cam rewind, 16-day forecasts, and more — by watching a quick ad each time you view a cam
Get everything you need to score with Premium+, powered by the world’s most advanced surf cam network***
- Track every wave with a timeline of wave height and ridden waves
- See what’s going unridden with insights on wave distribution and crowds
- Track storm and swell patterns with the highest-resolution wave charts available
- Find and share your rides by skipping through ridden waves
Plus, integrate with partner apps and your wearable devices to unlock deeper insights
- Sync with your Apple Watch to log sessions and get clips of your waves sent straight to your phone**
- Link Surfline Sessions with partner apps like Strava, Dawn Patrol, and Garmin
*Local forecasts are region dependent.
**This feature uses HealthKit to monitor and record your calories and heart rate while you surf.
***Premium+ features are powered by Smart Cams, available regionally in the US, AU and UK
Payment for paid Surfline memberships will be charged to your Apple ID Account at confirmation of purchase. All prices exclusive of taxes. Membership plans will automatically renew yearly or monthly, depending on membership plan selection, unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current term. Cancel any time in the App Store; your membership will then cease at the end of the current term. No refund will be issued for the time remaining on your current plan term when you cancel a membership. By using Surfline you certify that you understand and agree to the Surfline Terms of Service (https://www.surfline.com/terms-of-use) and Privacy Policy (https://www.surfline.com/privacy-policy).

bluejetty:00062995:ios.summary: Beat Time plays audio & video and can change the tempo (time stretch) and/or pitch and does note & chord detection. It is aimed as a practice / study tool for musicians and as a helper tool for transcribing audio & video. Play audio & video
bluejetty:00062995:ios.description:
Beat Time plays audio & video and can change the tempo (time stretch) and/or pitch and does note & chord detection. It is aimed as a practice / study tool for musicians and as a helper tool for transcribing audio & video. Play audio & video from your iPod library, dropbox, iTunes file sharing or open from other apps.
Reviews:
"Beat Time! is a gem of an app that's just waiting for musicians around the world to discover it. It's almost to good to be true! You've got to check it out!!" 
Jordan Rudess
Dream Theater/Wizdom Music.
"I've used plenty of slow downer type apps, and this is among the best! It does what it says and does it well" Evp73
"It's amazing how you can hear virtually NO artefacts in the audio! Amazing!" jenius92000
Main app features:
• Time stretch video and audio from 1/4x to 2x without affecting pitch.
• Pitch shift audio and video up to an octave up or down.
• Natural pitch shifting, pitch shift a male voice keeping it sounding male, pitch shift a female voice keep it sounding female.
• High quality, state of the art, time stretching / pitch shifting using DIRAC technology.
• Pitch analysis for note & chord detection.
• Annotate the track with multiple markers.
• Seamless looping of segments in the track.
• Optionally pause between loops.
• Easy file transfer: Open audio/video files from any app that supports iOS "Open In..." menu.
• Play YouTube videos.
• Open tracks from your iPod audio, video library or video camera roll
• Export time stretched / pitch shifted audio or movies.
• Universal application (iPhone/iPod/iPad).
• Supports video and audio formats that are playable using iOS music/video player, including: mp4, m4v, m4a, mp3, WAV, mov, (AVI provided it's mpeg 4 encoded)
See Jordan Rudess playing with Beat Time! at http://bit.ly/GO67NQ

It is aimed as a practice / study tool for musicians and as a helper tool for transcribing audio & video. Play audio & video from your iPod library, dropbox, iTunes file sharing or open from other apps.

Reviews:
"Beat Time! is a gem of an app that's just waiting for musicians around the world to discover it. It's almost to good to be true! You've got to check it out!!" 
Jordan Rudess
Dream Theater/Wizdom Music.
"I've used plenty of slow downer type apps, and this is among the best! It does what it says and does it well" Evp73
"It's amazing how you can hear virtually NO artefacts in the audio! Amazing!" jenius92000

Main app features:
• Time stretch video and audio from 1/4x to 2x without affecting pitch.
• Pitch shift audio and video up to an octave up or down.
• Natural pitch shifting, pitch shift a male voice keeping it sounding male, pitch shift a female voice keep it sounding female.
• High quality, state of the art, time stretching / pitch shifting using DIRAC technology.
• Pitch analysis for note & chord detection.
• Annotate the track with multiple markers.
• Seamless looping of segments in the track.
• Optionally pause between loops.
• Easy file transfer: Open audio/video files from any app that supports iOS "Open In..." menu.
• Play YouTube videos.
• Open tracks from your iPod audio, video library or video camera roll
• Export time stretched / pitch shifted audio or movies.
• Universal application (iPhone/iPod/iPad).
• Supports video and audio formats that are playable using iOS music/video player, including: mp4, m4v, m4a, mp3, WAV, mov, (AVI provided it's mpeg 4 encoded)

See Jordan Rudess playing with Beat Time! at http://bit.ly/GO67NQ

apple-macos:6808028545.name: Finances: Budget & Spending
apple-macos:6808028545.description:
How much can you spend today and still make it to payday? Finances answers with one number and shows how it adds up.
SAFE TO SPEND TODAY
Your account balances minus a protected reserve and every planned payment before your next income. Below it, a daily guide. If payments exceed your money, the app tells you by which date and how much you need to receive to pay everything on time.
LOG IT IN TWO SECONDS
"Coffee 4 from card #work" — the amount, account, category and tags sort themselves out, and "Taxi 12+8" adds up. By voice, by the QR code on a Russian receipt, with Siri, from Control Center or with one tap in a Home Screen widget.
A PLAN THAT RUNS ITSELF
Payments and income with any repeat: daily, on chosen weekdays, every few weeks, quarterly or yearly. Salary in two installments. A payment can record itself, and a limit can carry its remainder into next month. Start the budget month on payday if you like. A Plan calendar and a 3-, 6- or 12-month forecast.
REMINDERS THAT DON'T NAG
"Internet — $15, tomorrow" with a Paid button right in the notification, Received on payday, a day summary, limits running low, a subscription that got more expensive. All of them are opt-in.
GOALS AND A WANT-TO-BUY LIST
Goals with a savings plan: on the day, tap Saved it right in the notification. Next to them, a list of things you want, each showing from which day it won't get in the way of your payments.
LOANS, INVESTMENTS AND NET WORTH
Cards, cash, deposits, loans and money you lent or borrowed, all on one screen, with this month's change. A loan, mortgage or installment plan with its terms: marking a payment Paid in Plan reduces the debt, interest is shown separately, and a prepayment is worked out in advance — how much sooner the loan ends and how much you keep. Brokerage and deposit accounts show their return separately from top-ups, and savings accounts and deposits with a rate calculate interest on each day's balance and record it once a month. Accounts in any currency at central bank rates. Widgets, search and export.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No tracking, no ads, and an account is optional. Your data stays on your device. With sync through your account, records are encrypted on your device, so our server only sees ciphertext. A family budget lives in your iCloud. Face ID lock and hide all amounts with one tap.
WITH A FINANCES ACCOUNT
Everything above works without an account and with no time limit. A Finances account is the same one as in the web version on any computer. If it includes extended access, sign in and these tools open here:
• an assistant for your own numbers: ask in plain words — "how much can I spend per day?", "where did my money go?", "when will my loan be paid off?". It answers from your data, does loan and deposit math, explains money basics and logs transactions for you. It runs right on the device;
• detailed analytics for a month, three months or a year: spending pace, categories and subcategories, subscriptions, where you spend, loans and investments for the period, PDF and Excel reports;
• bank statement import from PDF, Excel and CSV, plus CoinKeeper, Zenmoney and 1Money exports; duplicates and transfers are checked before anything is saved;
• sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac and the web through your account, encrypted on your device, and a family budget.
English, Russian, Spanish and German. iPhone and iPad with iOS 18 or later.

14 LANGUAGES
Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Vietnamese, Tagalog, Nepali, Thai, Indonesian, Burmese, Portuguese, Spanish, French, and English. You type in your own language and KeeKom detects it automatically. You just pick who you are writing to.
SET THE TONE
Casual with friends, polite for work. Keigo in Japanese, usted in Spanish, vous in French. Switch it per message, or lock one tone in Settings.
EMOJI AND KAOMOJI THAT READ THE ROOM
As you type, KeeKom lines up the right emoji and kaomoji, from English or Japanese. Tap to drop one in.
SEE WHAT YOU ARE SENDING
Back translation shows what your message actually says before you send it, so you can trust it even in a language you cannot read.
TYPE IN YOUR OWN SCRIPT
If your language is Japanese, Korean or Chinese, type it in its own script: romaji to kanji, Hangul as you type, and pinyin to Simplified or Traditional characters. One key switches to Latin letters and back.
PRIVACY
Works in every app. No account, no sign up, no ads. Nothing you type is stored. Only the text you translate is sent to convert it, then immediately discarded.
Free plan: the full keyboard, all emoji and kaomoji, both tones, and 10 translations a day, sent in the language you pick from all 14. All 14 languages free for your first 30 days, then you keep one send language.
KeeKom Spark removes the daily limit and lifts the length cap. KeeKom Blaze switches between all 14 languages mid-chat and adds back translation. Both are charged once a year, renew automatically, and can be cancelled any time in Settings. KeeKom Inferno adds blunt and flirty tones, 17+, as a one time add on that never expires.
